records.english: A throwable anti-personnel mine, capable of adhering to most surfaces. Upon deployment, emits lights and sounds which attract nearby hostiles to its proximity-activated detonator.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可投掷式反步兵地雷，能附着在大部分表面。部署后发出光和声音，吸引附近敌人靠近它的感应引爆装置。
englishValues: A throwable anti-personnel mine, capable of adhering to most surfaces. Upon deployment, emits lights and sounds which attract nearby hostiles to its proximity-activated detonator.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可投掷式反步兵地雷，能附着在大部分表面。部署后发出光和声音，吸引附近敌人靠近它的感应引爆装置。

records.english: Capable of firing a suite of space-to-ground indirect fire that can quickly free an entire battlefield from oppression.
records.simplifiedChinese: 能发射一组空对地间接火力，快速解救整个受到压制的战场。
englishValues: Capable of firing a suite of space-to-ground indirect fire that can quickly free an entire battlefield from oppression.
simplifiedChineseValues: 能发射一组空对地间接火力，快速解救整个受到压制的战场。

records.english: Commemorating the bold pioneers who first successfully navigated High Command’s newest tactical mechanisms. The distinctive replication of visor scarring represents a close-range ideological exchange with the Terminid scourge, proving that Managed Democracy shall remain unblinded by fascist aggression.
records.simplifiedChinese: 旨在纪念那些最先成功驾驭最高指挥部最新战术机制的英勇先驱。头盔面甲疤痕的独特复刻，代表着与终结族毒瘤进行近距离意识形态交锋，彰显管理式民主绝不会被法西斯侵略蒙蔽双眼。
englishValues: Commemorating the bold pioneers who first successfully navigated High Command’s newest tactical mechanisms. The distinctive replication of visor scarring represents a close-range ideological exchange with the Terminid scourge, proving that Managed Democracy shall remain unblinded by fascist aggression.
simplifiedChineseValues: 旨在纪念那些最先成功驾驭最高指挥部最新战术机制的英勇先驱。头盔面甲疤痕的独特复刻，代表着与终结族毒瘤进行近距离意识形态交锋，彰显管理式民主绝不会被法西斯侵略蒙蔽双眼。

records.english: Pushing the boundaries of bionic engineering, this armour collects and dispenses a number of vital fluids, several of which are soon to be declassified.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲突破了仿生工程学的极限，能收集并分配多种重要体液，其中几种即将解密。
englishValues: Pushing the boundaries of bionic engineering, this armour collects and dispenses a number of vital fluids, several of which are soon to be declassified.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲突破了仿生工程学的极限，能收集并分配多种重要体液，其中几种即将解密。

records.simplifiedChinese: 副武器拔枪/收枪速度提高<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。
simplifiedChineseValues: 副武器拔枪/收枪速度提高<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。

records.english: Armour explodes <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> after the wearer dies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 盔甲会在穿戴者死后<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>引爆。
englishValues: Armour explodes <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> after the wearer dies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 盔甲会在穿戴者死后<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>引爆。

records.english: A welcome sight in all Democratic neighborhoods, this armour inspires both civil pride and civic obedience.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这款盔甲在所有民主社区都备受欢迎，既能激发公民自豪感，又能促进公民服从命令。
englishValues: A welcome sight in all Democratic neighborhoods, this armour inspires both civil pride and civic obedience.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这款盔甲在所有民主社区都备受欢迎，既能激发公民自豪感，又能促进公民服从命令。

records.english: This ancient, likely allegorical, illustration of Might triumphing over the Anguiform is seen by scholars as a symbol of humankind's supremacy in the art of violence.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这幅可能深藏寓意的古老插图描绘了力量战胜蛇形生物的场景，学者认为这象征着人类在暴力艺术的至高地位。
englishValues: This ancient, likely allegorical, illustration of Might triumphing over the Anguiform is seen by scholars as a symbol of humankind's supremacy in the art of violence.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这幅可能深藏寓意的古老插图描绘了力量战胜蛇形生物的场景，学者认为这象征着人类在暴力艺术的至高地位。

records.english: Based on the uniform of Jackle 6, a veteran of the Viper Commandos who held off an entire Terminid brood on Nublaria in the First Galactic War with nothing but a machine gun, pocket knife, and Orbital Laser Strikes.
records.simplifiedChinese: 以毒蛇突击队老兵“杰克尔六号”的制服为基础设计而成。第一次星系战争期间，这位老兵仅凭机枪、小刀和轨道激光炮就拦下了努布拉里亚的整支终结族大军。
englishValues: Based on the uniform of Jackle 6, a veteran of the Viper Commandos who held off an entire Terminid brood on Nublaria in the First Galactic War with nothing but a machine gun, pocket knife, and Orbital Laser Strikes.
simplifiedChineseValues: 以毒蛇突击队老兵“杰克尔六号”的制服为基础设计而成。第一次星系战争期间，这位老兵仅凭机枪、小刀和轨道激光炮就拦下了努布拉里亚的整支终结族大军。

records.english: An advanced, mostly self-operating prospecting drill fitted into a Hellpod. Handles soil sample extraction, analysis and data upload with minimal necessary input from an operator.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一款安装在绝地喷射舱内的先进自动操作勘探钻机。操作员只需手动完成最基本的操作，钻机就能处理土壤样本提取、分析和数据上传的工作。
englishValues: An advanced, mostly self-operating prospecting drill fitted into a Hellpod. Handles soil sample extraction, analysis and data upload with minimal necessary input from an operator.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一款安装在绝地喷射舱内的先进自动操作勘探钻机。操作员只需手动完成最基本的操作，钻机就能处理土壤样本提取、分析和数据上传的工作。

records.english: A domestic version of this armour is available for citizens who wish to perform efficient home renovation projects.
records.simplifiedChinese: 希望提高住宅装修效率的公民可以购买这套盔甲的家用版本。
englishValues: A domestic version of this armour is available for citizens who wish to perform efficient home renovation projects.
simplifiedChineseValues: 希望提高住宅装修效率的公民可以购买这套盔甲的家用版本。

records.english: A lightly-armoured Fast Recon Vehicle mounted with a heavy machinegun.
records.simplifiedChinese: 轻型装甲快速侦察载具，搭载重机枪。
englishValues: A lightly-armoured Fast Recon Vehicle mounted with a heavy machinegun.
simplifiedChineseValues: 轻型装甲快速侦察载具，搭载重机枪。

records.english: A longer revolver barrel that results in a higher muzzle velocity and lower recoil at the cost of worse handling.
records.simplifiedChinese: 加长版左轮枪管，可有效提升枪口初速并降低后坐力，代价是操控性下降。
englishValues: A longer revolver barrel that results in a higher muzzle velocity and lower recoil at the cost of worse handling.
simplifiedChineseValues: 加长版左轮枪管，可有效提升枪口初速并降低后坐力，代价是操控性下降。

records.english: A powerful dual magazine pump-action shotgun, with limited armour penetration. Ideal for small and fast targets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 强大的双弹夹泵动式霰弹枪，穿甲力有限，这是攻击小型和快速目标的理想之选。
englishValues: A powerful dual magazine pump-action shotgun, with limited armour penetration. Ideal for small and fast targets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 强大的双弹夹泵动式霰弹枪，穿甲力有限，这是攻击小型和快速目标的理想之选。

records.english: A single-use weapon firing a high-yield missile. Discarded after every use.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射大当量导弹的一次性武器。用后即弃。
englishValues: A single-use weapon firing a high-yield missile. Discarded after every use.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射大当量导弹的一次性武器。用后即弃。

records.english: This armour pays tribute to the immoveable heroes of the front line—those who refuse to acknowledge incoming fire, and consider "dodging" to be an abstract concept akin to cowardice.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲旨在致敬那些岿然不动的前线英雄——他们毫不畏惧来袭火力，并将“闪避”视为与怯懦无异的抽象概念。
englishValues: This armour pays tribute to the immoveable heroes of the front line—those who refuse to acknowledge incoming fire, and consider "dodging" to be an abstract concept akin to cowardice.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲旨在致敬那些岿然不动的前线英雄——他们毫不畏惧来袭火力，并将“闪避”视为与怯懦无异的抽象概念。

records.english: A high-calibre submachine gun which can be fired with one hand. Has a relatively low rate of fire.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可单手操控的大口径冲锋枪。射速相对较低。
englishValues: A high-calibre submachine gun which can be fired with one hand. Has a relatively low rate of fire.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可单手操控的大口径冲锋枪。射速相对较低。

records.english: An automated turret with an extremely high rate of fire. Caution: does not check if friendly units are in line of fire.
records.simplifiedChinese: 射速极其高的自动炮台。当心：炮台不会侦测火线内是否存在友方单位。
englishValues: An automated turret with an extremely high rate of fire. Caution: does not check if friendly units are in line of fire.
simplifiedChineseValues: 射速极其高的自动炮台。当心：炮台不会侦测火线内是否存在友方单位。

records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球武装部队大炮：烟雾弹
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球武装部队大炮：烟雾弹

records.english: Helps prevent Helldivers from flinching when hit.
records.simplifiedChinese: 有助于防止绝地潜兵遭受攻击后产生畏缩反应。
englishValues: Helps prevent Helldivers from flinching when hit.
simplifiedChineseValues: 有助于防止绝地潜兵遭受攻击后产生畏缩反应。

records.english: Loaded with jet-assisted rounds, this pistol is calibrated for creating and maintaining tactical distance from encroaching hostiles.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这款手枪装填喷气助推弹，经过特别校准，可在敌人逼近时与其保持战术距离。
englishValues: Loaded with jet-assisted rounds, this pistol is calibrated for creating and maintaining tactical distance from encroaching hostiles.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这款手枪装填喷气助推弹，经过特别校准，可在敌人逼近时与其保持战术距离。

records.english: A heavy-duty submachine gun that fires large-calibre rounds, with a slower rate of fire to manage the high recoil. Ideal for use at close to medium range.
records.simplifiedChinese: 重型冲锋枪，可发射大口径子弹，但由于后坐力较大，射速较慢。适合中近距离使用。
englishValues: A heavy-duty submachine gun that fires large-calibre rounds, with a slower rate of fire to manage the high recoil. Ideal for use at close to medium range.
simplifiedChineseValues: 重型冲锋枪，可发射大口径子弹，但由于后坐力较大，射速较慢。适合中近距离使用。

records.english: A high-damage revolver, which can be reloaded with single rounds. A heavy-hitting and reliable sidearm.
records.simplifiedChinese: 伤害较高的左轮手枪，可以装填单发弹药。此随身武器攻击力强大，相当可靠。
englishValues: A high-damage revolver, which can be reloaded with single rounds. A heavy-hitting and reliable sidearm.
simplifiedChineseValues: 伤害较高的左轮手枪，可以装填单发弹药。此随身武器攻击力强大，相当可靠。

records.english: A stationary ballistic cover with a mounted grenade launcher. Can protect multiple Helldivers from small arms fire.
records.simplifiedChinese: 固定式防弹掩体，架设有榴弹发射器。可抵挡轻型武器的射击，保护多名绝地潜兵。
englishValues: A stationary ballistic cover with a mounted grenade launcher. Can protect multiple Helldivers from small arms fire.
simplifiedChineseValues: 固定式防弹掩体，架设有榴弹发射器。可抵挡轻型武器的射击，保护多名绝地潜兵。

records.english: This cape depicts the inner workings of a medical device submitted to the Ministry of Science 70 years ago, and is bound to clear their patent approval process any day now.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩绘制了70年前提交到科学部的医疗设备内部构造，相信很快就能通过专利审批流程了。
englishValues: This cape depicts the inner workings of a medical device submitted to the Ministry of Science 70 years ago, and is bound to clear their patent approval process any day now.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩绘制了70年前提交到科学部的医疗设备内部构造，相信很快就能通过专利审批流程了。

records.english: Increases the speed and duration of slides.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可提升滑铲的速度与持续时间。
englishValues: Increases the speed and duration of slides.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可提升滑铲的速度与持续时间。

records.english: This high-visibility armour allows it's bearer to be easily seen through smoke, fog, and spewing viscera.
records.simplifiedChinese: 穿上这套可见度极高的盔甲，缭绕烟雾和喷溅的内脏都挡不住你的风采。
englishValues: This high-visibility armour allows it's bearer to be easily seen through smoke, fog, and spewing viscera.
simplifiedChineseValues: 穿上这套可见度极高的盔甲，缭绕烟雾和喷溅的内脏都挡不住你的风采。

records.english: The experimental weapons R&D corporation Zizer has unveiled this altered "Senator" revolver, with a longer barrel that is clinically proven to make its wielder up to 23% more secure in themselves.
records.simplifiedChinese: 实验性武器研发企业“自捷”推出改装版“参议员”左轮手枪，配备加长枪管，经临床验证可为使用者带来多达23%的自信心加成。
englishValues: The experimental weapons R&D corporation Zizer has unveiled this altered "Senator" revolver, with a longer barrel that is clinically proven to make its wielder up to 23% more secure in themselves.
simplifiedChineseValues: 实验性武器研发企业“自捷”推出改装版“参议员”左轮手枪，配备加长枪管，经临床验证可为使用者带来多达23%的自信心加成。

records.english: A common magazine type in the Super Earth military, favouring sustained fire over handling.
records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球军队常用弹匣，适合持续提供火力，但操控性较差。
englishValues: A common magazine type in the Super Earth military, favouring sustained fire over handling.
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球军队常用弹匣，适合持续提供火力，但操控性较差。

records.english: This suit's plutonium-238 nuclear battery enables environmental scanning long after the user has ceased operation.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套服装配备钚238核能电池，在穿戴者失去体征很长时间之后，电池依然能支撑设备完成环境扫描。
englishValues: This suit's plutonium-238 nuclear battery enables environmental scanning long after the user has ceased operation.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套服装配备钚238核能电池，在穿戴者失去体征很长时间之后，电池依然能支撑设备完成环境扫描。

records.english: THE CAPE OF STARS AND SUFFRAGE
englishValues: THE CAPE OF STARS AND SUFFRAGE

records.english: First deployed in the mines of Cyberstan, where it offered protection against explosions in the hydrogen-rich caverns.
records.simplifiedChinese: 最初投用于生化斯坦的矿区，帮助穿戴者在富含氢气的矿洞中抵挡爆炸的伤害。
englishValues: First deployed in the mines of Cyberstan, where it offered protection against explosions in the hydrogen-rich caverns.
simplifiedChineseValues: 最初投用于生化斯坦的矿区，帮助穿戴者在富含氢气的矿洞中抵挡爆炸的伤害。

records.english: This cape celebrates the one Veridical Ideology—Managed Democracy—a truth so self-evident, it requires no proof beyond the unwavering obedience of its champions.
records.simplifiedChinese: 披肩颂扬唯一的真理意识形态：管理式民主。此中真理不言自明，也无需证明，只需要拥护者绝对服从。
englishValues: This cape celebrates the one Veridical Ideology—Managed Democracy—a truth so self-evident, it requires no proof beyond the unwavering obedience of its champions.
simplifiedChineseValues: 披肩颂扬唯一的真理意识形态：管理式民主。此中真理不言自明，也无需证明，只需要拥护者绝对服从。

records.english: Further reduces recoil when crouching or prone by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
records.simplifiedChinese: 蹲伏或匍匐姿态下，后坐力进一步降低<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。
englishValues: Further reduces recoil when crouching or prone by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
simplifiedChineseValues: 蹲伏或匍匐姿态下，后坐力进一步降低<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。

records.english: Provides <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> damage resistance to fire, allowing bearer to rest assured in their inflammability.
records.simplifiedChinese: 提供<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>的火焰伤害抗性，穿戴者无需再担心自身的易燃问题。
englishValues: Provides <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> damage resistance to fire, allowing bearer to rest assured in their inflammability.
simplifiedChineseValues: 提供<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>的火焰伤害抗性，穿戴者无需再担心自身的易燃问题。

records.english: Disarmingly scrappy and viciously disarming, this armour is a staple of the Balayage FW/2185 collection "Frontline Moxie".
records.simplifiedChinese: 这盔甲看起来破烂，令人放下戒心，实则凶悍得让敌人缴械投降。这套盔甲是巴拉雅奇2185秋冬系列“前线胆魄”的经典款式。
englishValues: Disarmingly scrappy and viciously disarming, this armour is a staple of the Balayage FW/2185 collection "Frontline Moxie".
simplifiedChineseValues: 这盔甲看起来破烂，令人放下戒心，实则凶悍得让敌人缴械投降。这套盔甲是巴拉雅奇2185秋冬系列“前线胆魄”的经典款式。

records.english: An autonomous drone equipped with a flamethrower. Returns to backpack to refill fuel canisters.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备火焰喷射器的自主无人机。收回到背包可补充燃料罐。
englishValues: An autonomous drone equipped with a flamethrower. Returns to backpack to refill fuel canisters.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备火焰喷射器的自主无人机。收回到背包可补充燃料罐。

records.english: This Data Jack is carefully engineered to slot seamlessly into Illuminate Access Nodes. Once engaged, it initiates a sophisticated system disruption sequence, requiring little more than user confirmation.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这个精心设计的数据接口可完美插入光能者的接入节点。一旦成功对接，就会发起复杂的系统破坏程序，几乎仅需用户确认即可完成。
englishValues: This Data Jack is carefully engineered to slot seamlessly into Illuminate Access Nodes. Once engaged, it initiates a sophisticated system disruption sequence, requiring little more than user confirmation.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这个精心设计的数据接口可完美插入光能者的接入节点。一旦成功对接，就会发起复杂的系统破坏程序，几乎仅需用户确认即可完成。

records.english: A turret which fires electrical charges at targets in close range. To avoid friendly fire, remain prone.
records.simplifiedChinese: 向近程目标释放电击的炮台。为避免误伤，请保持匍匐姿势。
englishValues: A turret which fires electrical charges at targets in close range. To avoid friendly fire, remain prone.
simplifiedChineseValues: 向近程目标释放电击的炮台。为避免误伤，请保持匍匐姿势。

records.english: A high-calibre sniper rifle effective over long distances against light vehicle armour. This rifle must be aimed downscope.
records.simplifiedChinese: 大口径狙击步枪，在远程范围内可有效对付轻型载具装甲。此步枪必须开镜瞄准。
englishValues: A high-calibre sniper rifle effective over long distances against light vehicle armour. This rifle must be aimed downscope.
simplifiedChineseValues: 大口径狙击步枪，在远程范围内可有效对付轻型载具装甲。此步枪必须开镜瞄准。

records.english: Offering camouflage in snowy environments, surplus sets of this armour are used by nature photographers and keen hunters alike.
records.simplifiedChinese: 适用于雪地环境的迷彩，富余的盔甲在户外摄影师和打猎爱好者手中也相当实用。
englishValues: Offering camouflage in snowy environments, surplus sets of this armour are used by nature photographers and keen hunters alike.
simplifiedChineseValues: 适用于雪地环境的迷彩，富余的盔甲在户外摄影师和打猎爱好者手中也相当实用。

records.english: Promotional armour made by SUMY Corp. as part of a highly successful marketing campaign for frozen yoghurt.
records.simplifiedChinese: SUMY公司制作的促销盔甲，是大获成功的冷冻酸奶营销策略的一部分。
englishValues: Promotional armour made by SUMY Corp. as part of a highly successful marketing campaign for frozen yoghurt.
simplifiedChineseValues: SUMY公司制作的促销盔甲，是大获成功的冷冻酸奶营销策略的一部分。

records.english: The suit was once designed to hold a variety of battlefield medical equipment. Now it holds a generous supply of stims.
records.simplifiedChinese: 按照原本的设计，这套盔甲应该配备多种战地医疗设备，现在则是携带了大量的治疗剂。
englishValues: The suit was once designed to hold a variety of battlefield medical equipment. Now it holds a generous supply of stims.
simplifiedChineseValues: 按照原本的设计，这套盔甲应该配备多种战地医疗设备，现在则是携带了大量的治疗剂。

records.english: A heatsink calibrated to purposely generate heat faster than standard heatsinks.
records.simplifiedChinese: 经过特殊校准，这种散热器的发热速度快于标准散热器。
englishValues: A heatsink calibrated to purposely generate heat faster than standard heatsinks.
simplifiedChineseValues: 经过特殊校准，这种散热器的发热速度快于标准散热器。

records.english: The end result of several billion Super Credits and 12 years of reseach into creating 'the Soldier of Tomorrow'.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这是为打造“明日战士”而投入数十亿超级货币并耗费12年研究得出的最终成果。
englishValues: The end result of several billion Super Credits and 12 years of reseach into creating 'the Soldier of Tomorrow'.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这是为打造“明日战士”而投入数十亿超级货币并耗费12年研究得出的最终成果。

records.english: An automated assembly line where all Hellpod armaments are constructed by precise, non-sentient robotic arms.
records.simplifiedChinese: 自动化装配流水线，所有绝地喷射舱军备均由无感知的精密机械臂所建造。
englishValues: An automated assembly line where all Hellpod armaments are constructed by precise, non-sentient robotic arms.
simplifiedChineseValues: 自动化装配流水线，所有绝地喷射舱军备均由无感知的精密机械臂所建造。

records.english: When the wearer takes damage, they regain some stamina.
records.simplifiedChinese: 穿戴者受到伤害时恢复部分体力。
englishValues: When the wearer takes damage, they regain some stamina.
simplifiedChineseValues: 穿戴者受到伤害时恢复部分体力。

records.english: Embodies the ethos of Manifest Democracy—that it is our voter-given responsibility to emancipate the savage, un-Liberated galaxy. To rest only when every planet is safe, civilised, and Free.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲彰显了天定民主的信条：解放蛮荒、未获解放的银河系是选民赋予我们的神圣职责。唯有确保每个星球安全、文明、自由，我们才能功成身退。
englishValues: Embodies the ethos of Manifest Democracy—that it is our voter-given responsibility to emancipate the savage, un-Liberated galaxy. To rest only when every planet is safe, civilised, and Free.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲彰显了天定民主的信条：解放蛮荒、未获解放的银河系是选民赋予我们的神圣职责。唯有确保每个星球安全、文明、自由，我们才能功成身退。

records.english: A modified Punisher shotgun firing exploding plasma rounds. Fire carefully - exploding plasma can injure squadmates.
records.simplifiedChinese: 改良后的“制裁者”霰弹枪，可发射会引爆的等离子弹。射击时务必小心，爆炸的等离子体可能会伤及队友。
englishValues: A modified Punisher shotgun firing exploding plasma rounds. Fire carefully - exploding plasma can injure squadmates.
simplifiedChineseValues: 改良后的“制裁者”霰弹枪，可发射会引爆的等离子弹。射击时务必小心，爆炸的等离子体可能会伤及队友。

records.english: Wearers of this cape know that even enemies of Freedom deserve to be equal. Equally dead.
records.simplifiedChinese: 穿上这件披肩的战士都明白，即使是自由的敌人，也值得平等对待，让他们平等地死去。
englishValues: Wearers of this cape know that even enemies of Freedom deserve to be equal. Equally dead.
simplifiedChineseValues: 穿上这件披肩的战士都明白，即使是自由的敌人，也值得平等对待，让他们平等地死去。

records.english: A humane grenade launcher firing high-powered arc grenades.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射高能电弧榴弹的人道主义榴弹发射器。
englishValues: A humane grenade launcher firing high-powered arc grenades.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射高能电弧榴弹的人道主义榴弹发射器。

records.english: A high-precision burst-fire plasma rifle that must be charged to fire.
records.simplifiedChinese: 高精度连发等离子步枪，需充能才能开火。
englishValues: A high-precision burst-fire plasma rifle that must be charged to fire.
simplifiedChineseValues: 高精度连发等离子步枪，需充能才能开火。

records.simplifiedChinese: 增加架设型轻机枪弹匣
simplifiedChineseValues: 增加架设型轻机枪弹匣

records.english: With genuine gold accents, 74% of colonists voted this armour the set they would most like to be buried in.
records.simplifiedChinese: 真金装饰。74%拓殖地居民投票表示死后最希望穿这套盔甲下葬。
englishValues: With genuine gold accents, 74% of colonists voted this armour the set they would most like to be buried in.
simplifiedChineseValues: 真金装饰。74%拓殖地居民投票表示死后最希望穿这套盔甲下葬。

records.english: A barrage of napalm bombs, creating a wall of fire which will stop the enemy in their tracks.
records.simplifiedChinese: 凝固汽油弹火力网，可形成一道火墙，阻止敌人进攻。
englishValues: A barrage of napalm bombs, creating a wall of fire which will stop the enemy in their tracks.
simplifiedChineseValues: 凝固汽油弹火力网，可形成一道火墙，阻止敌人进攻。

records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球武装部队大炮
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球武装部队大炮

records.english: A high explosive grenade which detonates on first impact.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一旦碰撞立即引爆的高爆榴弹。
englishValues: A high explosive grenade which detonates on first impact.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一旦碰撞立即引爆的高爆榴弹。

records.english: With its two barrels, one trigger, and vintage feel, this shotgun is perfect for historical reenactments.
records.simplifiedChinese: 双管单扳机的复古设计，这把霰弹枪是重现历史场景的绝佳道具。
englishValues: With its two barrels, one trigger, and vintage feel, this shotgun is perfect for historical reenactments.
simplifiedChineseValues: 双管单扳机的复古设计，这把霰弹枪是重现历史场景的绝佳道具。

records.english: A submachine gun with a helical-feed magazine, which gives the weapon a higher ammo capacity while making it more front-heavy. Produced by Stål Arms.
records.simplifiedChinese: 冲锋枪，配备螺旋式供弹弹匣，弹药容量增加，但前重后轻。由斯塔尔武装生产。
englishValues: A submachine gun with a helical-feed magazine, which gives the weapon a higher ammo capacity while making it more front-heavy. Produced by Stål Arms.
simplifiedChineseValues: 冲锋枪，配备螺旋式供弹弹匣，弹药容量增加，但前重后轻。由斯塔尔武装生产。

records.english: A vertical foregrip with an integrated tactical light.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备集成战术灯的垂直前握把。
englishValues: A vertical foregrip with an integrated tactical light.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备集成战术灯的垂直前握把。

records.english: Salvaged from a deep-storage vault, this well-ventilated cape symbolises tenacious survival. Its visible scars bestow immediate veteran status, reminding all onlookers that the spirit of tireless service is immortal.
records.simplifiedChinese: 回收自一座长期储藏库，这款“千疮百孔”的披风象征着顽强的生存意志。清晰可见的“战损伤疤”平添资深行伍光环，并时刻警醒旁观者：百战不殆的奉献精神永垂不朽。
englishValues: Salvaged from a deep-storage vault, this well-ventilated cape symbolises tenacious survival. Its visible scars bestow immediate veteran status, reminding all onlookers that the spirit of tireless service is immortal.
simplifiedChineseValues: 回收自一座长期储藏库，这款“千疮百孔”的披风象征着顽强的生存意志。清晰可见的“战损伤疤”平添资深行伍光环，并时刻警醒旁观者：百战不殆的奉献精神永垂不朽。

records.simplifiedChinese: 轨道凝固汽油弹火力网
simplifiedChineseValues: 轨道凝固汽油弹火力网

records.english: Crafted to deliver Justice to the darkest crevices of the galaxy.
records.simplifiedChinese: 为将正义传递到银河系最黑暗的缝隙而设计。
englishValues: Crafted to deliver Justice to the darkest crevices of the galaxy.
simplifiedChineseValues: 为将正义传递到银河系最黑暗的缝隙而设计。

records.english: A high-torque laser rifle that fires a continuous beam of thermal energy. If allowed to fully overheat, the weapon discharges a massive, explosive energy burst before requiring a heat sink replacement.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一款高转矩激光步枪，可发射持续的热能光束。若允许其完全过热，该武器在需要更换散热器前会释放出一股巨大的爆炸性能量脉冲。
englishValues: A high-torque laser rifle that fires a continuous beam of thermal energy. If allowed to fully overheat, the weapon discharges a massive, explosive energy burst before requiring a heat sink replacement.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一款高转矩激光步枪，可发射持续的热能光束。若允许其完全过热，该武器在需要更换散热器前会释放出一股巨大的爆炸性能量脉冲。

records.english: This cape's cropped length symbolises the brevity of galactic conflicts, thanks to the efficiency of the Helldivers.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这款披肩的剪裁长度象征着星系冲突之短暂，一切归功于绝地潜兵的作战效率。
englishValues: This cape's cropped length symbolises the brevity of galactic conflicts, thanks to the efficiency of the Helldivers.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这款披肩的剪裁长度象征着星系冲突之短暂，一切归功于绝地潜兵的作战效率。

records.english: Fires concussive rounds that stagger enemies. Slower rate of fire than other SMGs.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可连续发射震荡弹击退敌人。射速比其他冲锋枪慢。
englishValues: Fires concussive rounds that stagger enemies. Slower rate of fire than other SMGs.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可连续发射震荡弹击退敌人。射速比其他冲锋枪慢。

records.english: The two stripes serve as a reminder of the two pillars of successful military campaigns: attack, and further attack.
records.simplifiedChinese: 双条纹代表着成功的军事行动有两大支柱：进攻，以及进一步进攻。
englishValues: The two stripes serve as a reminder of the two pillars of successful military campaigns: attack, and further attack.
simplifiedChineseValues: 双条纹代表着成功的军事行动有两大支柱：进攻，以及进一步进攻。

records.english: Awarded to those promoted to their point of greatest competency, and beyond.
records.simplifiedChinese: 仅授予已达至臻之境并突破自我极限的战士。
englishValues: Awarded to those promoted to their point of greatest competency, and beyond.
simplifiedChineseValues: 仅授予已达至臻之境并突破自我极限的战士。

records.english: An automated cannon turret firing anti-tank ammunition over long ranges. Sacrifices agility for range and power.
records.simplifiedChinese: 远程发射反坦克弹药的自动加农炮台。以牺牲灵活性为代价，扩大攻击范围，提升火力。
englishValues: An automated cannon turret firing anti-tank ammunition over long ranges. Sacrifices agility for range and power.
simplifiedChineseValues: 远程发射反坦克弹药的自动加农炮台。以牺牲灵活性为代价，扩大攻击范围，提升火力。

records.english: A laser weapon firing a continuous beam. Doesn't require ammunition, but will need heat sink replaced if it overheats.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射连续光束的激光武器。无需弹药，但武器过热时需要更换散热器。
englishValues: A laser weapon firing a continuous beam. Doesn't require ammunition, but will need heat sink replaced if it overheats.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射连续光束的激光武器。无需弹药，但武器过热时需要更换散热器。

records.english: Armour inspired by the legend of the Sanctioner, a figure known only through a bizarrely unanimous patchwork of stifled whispers. As told, this fearsome, covert arbiter of primeval Justice delivered final, state-approved verdicts in the chaotic years before the Federation's founding.
records.simplifiedChinese: 以制裁者的传说为灵感设计的盔甲，虽然这位人物的形象仅由隐蔽的只言片语拼凑而成，但却诡异地一致。据传，这位令人敬畏的隐蔽制裁者在联邦成立前的混乱年代伸张早期的正义，下达国家认可的最终判决。
englishValues: Armour inspired by the legend of the Sanctioner, a figure known only through a bizarrely unanimous patchwork of stifled whispers. As told, this fearsome, covert arbiter of primeval Justice delivered final, state-approved verdicts in the chaotic years before the Federation's founding.
simplifiedChineseValues: 以制裁者的传说为灵感设计的盔甲，虽然这位人物的形象仅由隐蔽的只言片语拼凑而成，但却诡异地一致。据传，这位令人敬畏的隐蔽制裁者在联邦成立前的混乱年代伸张早期的正义，下达国家认可的最终判决。

records.english: While early prototypes used shock-absorbing gels, this armour stabilises aim with the use of internal gyroscopes.
records.simplifiedChinese: 早期原型曾使用减震凝胶，而此盔甲利用内置陀螺仪稳定瞄准动作。
englishValues: While early prototypes used shock-absorbing gels, this armour stabilises aim with the use of internal gyroscopes.
simplifiedChineseValues: 早期原型曾使用减震凝胶，而此盔甲利用内置陀螺仪稳定瞄准动作。

records.english: At the edge of the Federation, sometimes Democracy has only one representative.
records.simplifiedChinese: 在联邦的边境线，有时民主只有一位代理人。
englishValues: At the edge of the Federation, sometimes Democracy has only one representative.
simplifiedChineseValues: 在联邦的边境线，有时民主只有一位代理人。

records.english: This armour's nostalgic colour scheme brings to mind beloved trappings of colonial yesteryear: concrete frontier domiciles, slate-coloured civilian jumpsuits, and Space Settlers' Pie.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲的怀旧配色让人联想到昔日拓殖地时期的时尚潮流：混凝土筑成的边境住所，石板色平民连体服，太空居民馅饼。
englishValues: This armour's nostalgic colour scheme brings to mind beloved trappings of colonial yesteryear: concrete frontier domiciles, slate-coloured civilian jumpsuits, and Space Settlers' Pie.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲的怀旧配色让人联想到昔日拓殖地时期的时尚潮流：混凝土筑成的边境住所，石板色平民连体服，太空居民馅饼。

records.english: All Hail the Helldivers, whose devotion to Managed Democracy has never faltered.
records.simplifiedChinese: 向绝地潜兵致敬，他们对管理式民主的忠诚从未动摇。
englishValues: All Hail the Helldivers, whose devotion to Managed Democracy has never faltered.
simplifiedChineseValues: 向绝地潜兵致敬，他们对管理式民主的忠诚从未动摇。

records.english: One of the most durable engineer armours available, each set is quality tested by an impact with a full-grown Charger.
records.simplifiedChinese: 最耐用的工兵盔甲之一。每一套盔甲的质量检测流程都是抵挡一只成年强袭虫的冲撞。
englishValues: One of the most durable engineer armours available, each set is quality tested by an impact with a full-grown Charger.
simplifiedChineseValues: 最耐用的工兵盔甲之一。每一套盔甲的质量检测流程都是抵挡一只成年强袭虫的冲撞。

records.english: An incendiary grenade which ignites any targets and terrain within the blast radius. Use with caution.
records.simplifiedChinese: 燃烧榴弹，可点燃爆炸范围内任何目标和地面。请谨慎使用。
englishValues: An incendiary grenade which ignites any targets and terrain within the blast radius. Use with caution.
simplifiedChineseValues: 燃烧榴弹，可点燃爆炸范围内任何目标和地面。请谨慎使用。

records.english:
An assault rifle with a high-capacity drum magazine, good for providing sustained fire. 
Produced by Stål Arms.
records.simplifiedChinese:
突击步枪，配备大容量弹鼓，适合持续提供火力。
由斯塔尔武装公司生产。
englishValues:
An assault rifle with a high-capacity drum magazine, good for providing sustained fire. 
Produced by Stål Arms.
simplifiedChineseValues:
突击步枪，配备大容量弹鼓，适合持续提供火力。
由斯塔尔武装公司生产。

records.english: Assigns a random voice to your Helldiver when you die
records.simplifiedChinese: 在死亡时，为你的绝地潜兵随机分配一种声音。
englishValues: Assigns a random voice to your Helldiver when you die
simplifiedChineseValues: 在死亡时，为你的绝地潜兵随机分配一种声音。

records.english:
An SMG that fires caseless ammunition and is equipped with a non-removable suppressor. 
Produced by Martian Armoury.
records.simplifiedChinese:
发射无壳弹药的冲锋枪，且配备了不可拆卸的消音器。
由火星军械库生产。
englishValues:
An SMG that fires caseless ammunition and is equipped with a non-removable suppressor. 
Produced by Martian Armoury.
simplifiedChineseValues:
发射无壳弹药的冲锋枪，且配备了不可拆卸的消音器。
由火星军械库生产。

records.english: Our heroic fallen live on in this cape, guiding its bearer's aim to the heart of those who killed them.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这款披肩承载着陨落的烈士之魂，引导穿戴者瞄准凶手的要害，为他们复仇。
englishValues: Our heroic fallen live on in this cape, guiding its bearer's aim to the heart of those who killed them.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这款披肩承载着陨落的烈士之魂，引导穿戴者瞄准凶手的要害，为他们复仇。

records.english: A modified Breaker shotgun offering improved armour penetration and accuracy, with exceptionally high levels of recoil.
records.simplifiedChinese: 改良后的“破裂者”霰弹枪，穿甲性能和精准度有所提升，后坐力尤其高。
englishValues: A modified Breaker shotgun offering improved armour penetration and accuracy, with exceptionally high levels of recoil.
simplifiedChineseValues: 改良后的“破裂者”霰弹枪，穿甲性能和精准度有所提升，后坐力尤其高。

records.english: A lightweight flamethrower. Shoots pressurised fuel through a dispersion nozzle into an open flame. Safe.
records.simplifiedChinese: 轻型火焰喷射器。通过扩散喷嘴喷射加压燃料，形成明火。相当安全。
englishValues: A lightweight flamethrower. Shoots pressurised fuel through a dispersion nozzle into an open flame. Safe.
simplifiedChineseValues: 轻型火焰喷射器。通过扩散喷嘴喷射加压燃料，形成明火。相当安全。

records.english: A cape that strikes a subroutine emulating fear into the CPUs of all Automatons who conduct visual scans of it.
records.simplifiedChinese: 所有扫描此披肩的机器人，其CPU都将被植入模拟恐惧情绪的子程序。
englishValues: A cape that strikes a subroutine emulating fear into the CPUs of all Automatons who conduct visual scans of it.
simplifiedChineseValues: 所有扫描此披肩的机器人，其CPU都将被植入模拟恐惧情绪的子程序。

records.english: A versatile submachine gun equipped with iron sights and frontline incineration capabilities.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一款多用途冲锋枪，配备机械瞄具，具备前线炽灼能力。
englishValues: A versatile submachine gun equipped with iron sights and frontline incineration capabilities.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一款多用途冲锋枪，配备机械瞄具，具备前线炽灼能力。

records.english: Atomises caustic chemicals into a fine mist that liquifies sensitive electronics and tissues. Blinds and slows most enemies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 将腐蚀性化学物质雾化成细密雾气状，使敏感的电子设备和组织液化。可使大多数敌人致盲并减速。
englishValues: Atomises caustic chemicals into a fine mist that liquifies sensitive electronics and tissues. Blinds and slows most enemies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 将腐蚀性化学物质雾化成细密雾气状，使敏感的电子设备和组织液化。可使大多数敌人致盲并减速。

records.english: A backpack containing six adhesive C4 charges and a handheld wireless electronic detonator. Charges can be deployed and detonated individually, or as multiple simultaneous blasts.
records.simplifiedChinese: 背包内装有6枚粘性C4炸药和一个手持式无线电子起爆器。炸药可单独部署并引爆，也可多枚同时引爆。
englishValues: A backpack containing six adhesive C4 charges and a handheld wireless electronic detonator. Charges can be deployed and detonated individually, or as multiple simultaneous blasts.
simplifiedChineseValues: 背包内装有6枚粘性C4炸药和一个手持式无线电子起爆器。炸药可单独部署并引爆，也可多枚同时引爆。

records.english: A fully-automatic shotgun with a high rate of fire, excellent for controlling crowds. Requires frequent reloading.
records.simplifiedChinese: 高射速的全自动霰弹枪是群体控制的绝佳选择。需要频繁装弹。
englishValues: A fully-automatic shotgun with a high rate of fire, excellent for controlling crowds. Requires frequent reloading.
simplifiedChineseValues: 高射速的全自动霰弹枪是群体控制的绝佳选择。需要频繁装弹。

records.english: Artists and sculptors have made countless attempts at depicting the face of Liberty, but the truth is that any citizen can see it—they need only requisition a mirror.
records.simplifiedChinese: 艺术家和雕塑家曾无数次试图勾勒自由的轮廓，但事实上，任何人只需照照镜子，便能一睹自由的风采。
englishValues: Artists and sculptors have made countless attempts at depicting the face of Liberty, but the truth is that any citizen can see it—they need only requisition a mirror.
simplifiedChineseValues: 艺术家和雕塑家曾无数次试图勾勒自由的轮廓，但事实上，任何人只需照照镜子，便能一睹自由的风采。

records.english: A scope with 10x magnification, good for long range on high accuracy weapons.
records.simplifiedChinese: 10倍放大瞄准镜，适合高精度武器远程打击使用。
englishValues: A scope with 10x magnification, good for long range on high accuracy weapons.
simplifiedChineseValues: 10倍放大瞄准镜，适合高精度武器远程打击使用。

records.english: This cape honours the Eagle pilots who would follow a Stratagem beacon into the very jaws of tyranny, even when the beacon's placement seems inscrutable to the non-Helldiver mind.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩旨在纪念那些追随战略配备信标直捣暴政巢穴的飞鹰飞行员，即便信标位置在非绝地潜兵者看来难以理解也义无反顾。
englishValues: This cape honours the Eagle pilots who would follow a Stratagem beacon into the very jaws of tyranny, even when the beacon's placement seems inscrutable to the non-Helldiver mind.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩旨在纪念那些追随战略配备信标直捣暴政巢穴的飞鹰飞行员，即便信标位置在非绝地潜兵者看来难以理解也义无反顾。

records.english: Assembled from pieces of recovered Helldiver armour and SEAF gear, for those who won't let a lack of full body protection keep them from the battlefront.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩由回收的绝地潜兵装甲和超级地球武装部队装备碎片组装而成，专为那些即使缺乏全身防护装备也要奔赴战场的勇士设计。
englishValues: Assembled from pieces of recovered Helldiver armour and SEAF gear, for those who won't let a lack of full body protection keep them from the battlefront.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩由回收的绝地潜兵装甲和超级地球武装部队装备碎片组装而成，专为那些即使缺乏全身防护装备也要奔赴战场的勇士设计。

records.english: Deploys mines that release gas on activation, temporarily blinding and slowing most enemies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 部署地雷，触发后会释放毒气，可使大多数敌人暂时致盲并减速。
englishValues: Deploys mines that release gas on activation, temporarily blinding and slowing most enemies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 部署地雷，触发后会释放毒气，可使大多数敌人暂时致盲并减速。

records.english: A compact, low calibre machine gun. Trades power for ease of use, with faster reloading than heavier machine guns.
records.simplifiedChinese: 小口径紧凑型机枪。牺牲火力，换取便利性，装弹速度比更重型机枪更快。
englishValues: A compact, low calibre machine gun. Trades power for ease of use, with faster reloading than heavier machine guns.
simplifiedChineseValues: 小口径紧凑型机枪。牺牲火力，换取便利性，装弹速度比更重型机枪更快。

records.english: Good for medium to long range and the maximum magnification normally used for general weapons.
records.simplifiedChinese: 常规武器常用的最高倍率瞄准镜，适合中远程打击。
englishValues: Good for medium to long range and the maximum magnification normally used for general weapons.
simplifiedChineseValues: 常规武器常用的最高倍率瞄准镜，适合中远程打击。

records.english: A heavy, large-calibre marksman rifle bridging the gap between precision and sheer stopping power. Fires armour-piercing rounds coated in a high-ignition thermite compound to ignite targets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一款重型大口径精确射手步枪，完美兼顾精准度与强劲的停止作用。发射涂有高燃铝热剂化合物的穿甲弹，可引燃目标。
englishValues: A heavy, large-calibre marksman rifle bridging the gap between precision and sheer stopping power. Fires armour-piercing rounds coated in a high-ignition thermite compound to ignite targets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一款重型大口径精确射手步枪，完美兼顾精准度与强劲的停止作用。发射涂有高燃铝热剂化合物的穿甲弹，可引燃目标。

records.english: Painted by visionary artist Silas Garm during an intense fever, this symbol represents Humanity's great Galactic endeavour: the blood-soaked dawn of Lasting Peace.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这个符号由远见卓识的艺术家西拉斯·加姆在高烧中绘制，象征着人类在银河系卓绝奋斗的痕迹：他们为持久和平的曙光而挥洒的鲜血。
englishValues: Painted by visionary artist Silas Garm during an intense fever, this symbol represents Humanity's great Galactic endeavour: the blood-soaked dawn of Lasting Peace.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这个符号由远见卓识的艺术家西拉斯·加姆在高烧中绘制，象征着人类在银河系卓绝奋斗的痕迹：他们为持久和平的曙光而挥洒的鲜血。

records.english: Deploys a defensive incendiary minefield, which will set both terrain and targets alight when triggered.
records.simplifiedChinese: 部署一片燃烧式防御雷区，一旦触发便会点燃地面和目标。
englishValues: Deploys a defensive incendiary minefield, which will set both terrain and targets alight when triggered.
simplifiedChineseValues: 部署一片燃烧式防御雷区，一旦触发便会点燃地面和目标。

records.english: This cape's retro print, first made popular in GW1 cereal merchandising, helps children remember that not all machines are twisted mechano-socialists; some are piloted by true-hearted humans, and we can all rest easy in their gaze.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这款披风的复古印花最初作为第一次星系战争的麦片周边商品而爆红，它能帮助孩子们牢记这一事实：并非所有机器的操控者都是扭曲的机械党同伐异者；有些机器由诚挚人类所驾驶，而我们正是在它们的注视下得以安然入睡。
englishValues: This cape's retro print, first made popular in GW1 cereal merchandising, helps children remember that not all machines are twisted mechano-socialists; some are piloted by true-hearted humans, and we can all rest easy in their gaze.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这款披风的复古印花最初作为第一次星系战争的麦片周边商品而爆红，它能帮助孩子们牢记这一事实：并非所有机器的操控者都是扭曲的机械党同伐异者；有些机器由诚挚人类所驾驶，而我们正是在它们的注视下得以安然入睡。

records.english: The Helldiver Skull is said to strike fear in the hearts of foes attempting to sneak up on those wearing this cape.
records.simplifiedChinese: 据说，妄图偷袭穿戴此披肩之人的敌人，都会被绝地潜兵的骷髅头图案所震慑。
englishValues: The Helldiver Skull is said to strike fear in the hearts of foes attempting to sneak up on those wearing this cape.
simplifiedChineseValues: 据说，妄图偷袭穿戴此披肩之人的敌人，都会被绝地潜兵的骷髅头图案所震慑。

records.english: A faithful replica of the armour worn at The Battle of Liberty Peak. Honour their legacy, and wear it with pride.
records.simplifiedChinese: 如实还原解放峰之战的盔甲。尊重他们的遗产，骄傲地将其穿在身上。
englishValues: A faithful replica of the armour worn at The Battle of Liberty Peak. Honour their legacy, and wear it with pride.
simplifiedChineseValues: 如实还原解放峰之战的盔甲。尊重他们的遗产，骄傲地将其穿在身上。

records.english: Order the Eagle Fighter to return to the ship, where it can restock its armaments.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可指派“飞鹰”战斗机返回飞船，重新补充军备物资。
englishValues: Order the Eagle Fighter to return to the ship, where it can restock its armaments.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可指派“飞鹰”战斗机返回飞船，重新补充军备物资。

records.english: Compact and flexible, this kevlar armour adds minimal mass, making it a common choice for Helldiver fitness tests.
records.simplifiedChinese: 此芳纶纤维盔甲坚实又灵活，几乎不增加额外重量，是绝地潜兵体能测试的常用配备。
englishValues: Compact and flexible, this kevlar armour adds minimal mass, making it a common choice for Helldiver fitness tests.
simplifiedChineseValues: 此芳纶纤维盔甲坚实又灵活，几乎不增加额外重量，是绝地潜兵体能测试的常用配备。

records.english: A choir of patriotic schoolchildren sings the Super Earth anthem to each cape as the final step in its production.
records.simplifiedChinese: 此披肩制作过程的最后一步，是由爱国儿童唱诗班向着每一件披肩唱超级地球国歌。
englishValues: A choir of patriotic schoolchildren sings the Super Earth anthem to each cape as the final step in its production.
simplifiedChineseValues: 此披肩制作过程的最后一步，是由爱国儿童唱诗班向着每一件披肩唱超级地球国歌。

records.english: A fully-automatic cannon effective against light vehicle armour. Includes support backpack required for reloading.
records.simplifiedChinese: 全自动加农炮，可有效对付轻型载具装甲。包含支援背包，用于装填弹药。
englishValues: A fully-automatic cannon effective against light vehicle armour. Includes support backpack required for reloading.
simplifiedChineseValues: 全自动加农炮，可有效对付轻型载具装甲。包含支援背包，用于装填弹药。

records.english: A plasma pistol that charges each shot until the trigger is released. Plasma projectiles explode on impact.
records.simplifiedChinese: 等离子手枪，每发射击都可充能，松开扳机即可开火。等离子弹触碰着弹点后会爆炸。
englishValues: A plasma pistol that charges each shot until the trigger is released. Plasma projectiles explode on impact.
simplifiedChineseValues: 等离子手枪，每发射击都可充能，松开扳机即可开火。等离子弹触碰着弹点后会爆炸。

records.english: An expendable missile launcher equipped with four laser-guided missiles.
records.simplifiedChinese: 消耗性导弹发射器，配有四枚激光制导导弹。
englishValues: An expendable missile launcher equipped with four laser-guided missiles.
simplifiedChineseValues: 消耗性导弹发射器，配有四枚激光制导导弹。

records.english: A laser pistol that fires a continuous beam. Does not require ammo but can overheat and need to change batteries.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射连续激光束的激光手枪。无需装弹，但如果手枪过热，必须更换电池。
englishValues: A laser pistol that fires a continuous beam. Does not require ammo but can overheat and need to change batteries.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射连续激光束的激光手枪。无需装弹，但如果手枪过热，必须更换电池。

records.english: The clasps on this cape are made from melted down Automaton housings — evidence of Democracy's inevitable triumph.
records.simplifiedChinese: 披肩上的扣子是通过熔化机器人外壳制作而成的，有力证明了民主的胜利势不可挡。
englishValues: The clasps on this cape are made from melted down Automaton housings — evidence of Democracy's inevitable triumph.
simplifiedChineseValues: 披肩上的扣子是通过熔化机器人外壳制作而成的，有力证明了民主的胜利势不可挡。

records.english: Detonates on impact, covering the immediate vicinity in self-igniting white phosphorus.
records.simplifiedChinese: 受到撞击即引爆，以可自燃的白磷覆盖周边区域。
englishValues: Detonates on impact, covering the immediate vicinity in self-igniting white phosphorus.
simplifiedChineseValues: 受到撞击即引爆，以可自燃的白磷覆盖周边区域。

records.english: A large bomb obliterating almost any target close to impact. Make sure to clear the area.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一枚大型炸弹，可湮灭靠近爆炸范围的近乎所有目标。请确保所有人员撤离爆炸区域。
englishValues: A large bomb obliterating almost any target close to impact. Make sure to clear the area.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一枚大型炸弹，可湮灭靠近爆炸范围的近乎所有目标。请确保所有人员撤离爆炸区域。

records.english: A precision artillery salvo over a small area, perfect for taking out concentrated enemy units.
records.simplifiedChinese: 向小范围区域齐射的精准火力打击，可完美解决集中在一起的敌方单位。
englishValues: A precision artillery salvo over a small area, perfect for taking out concentrated enemy units.
simplifiedChineseValues: 向小范围区域齐射的精准火力打击，可完美解决集中在一起的敌方单位。

records.english: When the Illuminate threatened Super Earth, the very Heart of Democracy, the Helldivers answered the call.
records.simplifiedChinese: 当光能者威胁超级地球这颗民主之心时，绝地潜兵应召而战。
englishValues: When the Illuminate threatened Super Earth, the very Heart of Democracy, the Helldivers answered the call.
simplifiedChineseValues: 当光能者威胁超级地球这颗民主之心时，绝地潜兵应召而战。

records.english: A turret firing static field generators that slow the advance of enemies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 炮台可发射静电场发生器，拖延敌人前进的脚步。
englishValues: A turret firing static field generators that slow the advance of enemies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 炮台可发射静电场发生器，拖延敌人前进的脚步。

records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球武装部队大炮：迷你核弹
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球武装部队大炮：迷你核弹

records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球武装部队大炮：凝固汽油弹
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球武装部队大炮：凝固汽油弹

records.english: A 'compliance weapon' to modify enemy behaviour. The projectile temporarily stuns all targets within the strike radius.
records.simplifiedChinese: 改变敌人行为的“慑敌武器”。射弹可短时眩晕攻击范围内的所有目标。
englishValues: A 'compliance weapon' to modify enemy behaviour. The projectile temporarily stuns all targets within the strike radius.
simplifiedChineseValues: 改变敌人行为的“慑敌武器”。射弹可短时眩晕攻击范围内的所有目标。

records.english: The fire rate of the autocannons is increased from 200 to 300 rounds per minute.
records.simplifiedChinese: 机炮的射速从每分钟200发提升至每分钟300发。
englishValues: The fire rate of the autocannons is increased from 200 to 300 rounds per minute.
simplifiedChineseValues: 机炮的射速从每分钟200发提升至每分钟300发。

records.english: This high-calibre marksman rifle trades magazine capacity and rate of fire for powerful, accurate shots.
records.simplifiedChinese: 大口径狙击步枪，虽然牺牲了弹匣容量和射速，却提高了射击精准度和威力。
englishValues: This high-calibre marksman rifle trades magazine capacity and rate of fire for powerful, accurate shots.
simplifiedChineseValues: 大口径狙击步枪，虽然牺牲了弹匣容量和射速，却提高了射击精准度和威力。

records.english: A compact handgun-style flamethrower, able to project a jet of fire over short distances.
records.simplifiedChinese: 手枪式便携火焰喷射器，能够喷射近程火焰。
englishValues: A compact handgun-style flamethrower, able to project a jet of fire over short distances.
simplifiedChineseValues: 手枪式便携火焰喷射器，能够喷射近程火焰。

records.english: An Exosuit equipped with a flak cannon and ballistic shield, optimised for mid-to-close combat range.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备高射炮与防弹护盾的外骨骼装甲，专为中近距离战斗而优化。
englishValues: An Exosuit equipped with a flak cannon and ballistic shield, optimised for mid-to-close combat range.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备高射炮与防弹护盾的外骨骼装甲，专为中近距离战斗而优化。

records.english: Firing jet-propelled rounds, the Dominator trades fire rate and magazine capacity for increased damage per projectile.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射喷气推进式子弹，这把“主宰”虽然牺牲了射速和弹匣容量属性，却提高了每颗弹丸的伤害。
englishValues: Firing jet-propelled rounds, the Dominator trades fire rate and magazine capacity for increased damage per projectile.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射喷气推进式子弹，这把“主宰”虽然牺牲了射速和弹匣容量属性，却提高了每颗弹丸的伤害。

records.english: For optimal performance, the manufacturer recommends avoiding immersing this armour in salt water for prolonged periods.
records.simplifiedChinese: 为维持盔甲的良好性能，制造者建议避免长时间将盔甲浸入咸水。
englishValues: For optimal performance, the manufacturer recommends avoiding immersing this armour in salt water for prolonged periods.
simplifiedChineseValues: 为维持盔甲的良好性能，制造者建议避免长时间将盔甲浸入咸水。

records.english: The eternal colours of Super Earth can never be tainted. Only quenched, by the blood of its enemies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球的永恒颜色绝不能被玷污。唯有沾染敌人的鲜血方可罢休。
englishValues: The eternal colours of Super Earth can never be tainted. Only quenched, by the blood of its enemies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球的永恒颜色绝不能被玷污。唯有沾染敌人的鲜血方可罢休。

records.english: Although bulkier, it provides the effects of both a laser sight and a flashlight.
records.simplifiedChinese: 虽然体积更大，但能同时提供激光瞄准器和照明效果。
englishValues: Although bulkier, it provides the effects of both a laser sight and a flashlight.
simplifiedChineseValues: 虽然体积更大，但能同时提供激光瞄准器和照明效果。

records.english: Issued to the rapid-response enforcement wings of the Ministry of Prosperity. This armor provides the structural integrity necessary for aggressive pursuit manoeuvres and the forceful redirection of traffic—whether civilian, military, dissident or hostile.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配发给繁荣部下属快速响应执法支队。这套护甲提供侵略性追击机动和强行疏导交通所需的结构强度——无论对方是平民、军人、异见分子还是敌军。
englishValues: Issued to the rapid-response enforcement wings of the Ministry of Prosperity. This armor provides the structural integrity necessary for aggressive pursuit manoeuvres and the forceful redirection of traffic—whether civilian, military, dissident or hostile.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配发给繁荣部下属快速响应执法支队。这套护甲提供侵略性追击机动和强行疏导交通所需的结构强度——无论对方是平民、军人、异见分子还是敌军。

records.english: A single-use target-seeking anti-aircraft missile launcher. Must be locked to target before firing.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一次性寻的防空导弹发射器。发射前必须锁定目标。
englishValues: A single-use target-seeking anti-aircraft missile launcher. Must be locked to target before firing.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一次性寻的防空导弹发射器。发射前必须锁定目标。

records.english: Charges up to fire a powerful, explosive energy burst. Has a long cooldown period after firing.
records.simplifiedChinese: 充能后可发射爆炸性的强力能量炮。发射后的冷却时间较长。
englishValues: Charges up to fire a powerful, explosive energy burst. Has a long cooldown period after firing.
simplifiedChineseValues: 充能后可发射爆炸性的强力能量炮。发射后的冷却时间较长。

records.english: A mark of stalwart loyalty bestowed only to those who have proved themselves worthy through unquestioning dedication.
records.simplifiedChinese: 坚定忠诚的标志，仅授予那些通过绝对的奉献来证明自身资格的战士。
englishValues: A mark of stalwart loyalty bestowed only to those who have proved themselves worthy through unquestioning dedication.
simplifiedChineseValues: 坚定忠诚的标志，仅授予那些通过绝对的奉献来证明自身资格的战士。

records.english: An angled foregrip with an integrated laser sight.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备集成激光瞄准器的直角前握把。
englishValues: An angled foregrip with an integrated laser sight.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备集成激光瞄准器的直角前握把。

records.english: This classic armour set is recognised by every citizen: worn by the heroic Helldivers who battled and forever defeated the Terminids, Cyborgs, and Illuminate in the First Galactic War.
records.simplifiedChinese: 每位市民都认识这套经典盔甲：在第一次星系战争，绝地潜兵英雄就是穿着它彻底击败终结族、生化人和光能者。
englishValues: This classic armour set is recognised by every citizen: worn by the heroic Helldivers who battled and forever defeated the Terminids, Cyborgs, and Illuminate in the First Galactic War.
simplifiedChineseValues: 每位市民都认识这套经典盔甲：在第一次星系战争，绝地潜兵英雄就是穿着它彻底击败终结族、生化人和光能者。

records.english: Because this prototype's wires operate at 400,000 volts, it also includes a handy rubber underlayer for insulation.
records.simplifiedChinese: 此原型的电线需要在400,000伏特的电压下运行，因此盔甲配有便利的橡胶绝缘内衬。
englishValues: Because this prototype's wires operate at 400,000 volts, it also includes a handy rubber underlayer for insulation.
simplifiedChineseValues: 此原型的电线需要在400,000伏特的电压下运行，因此盔甲配有便利的橡胶绝缘内衬。

records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球武装部队大炮
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球武装部队大炮

records.english: This armour celebrates the wearer's close relationship to their Exosuit---as intimate as is possible without succumbing to cyborgry.
records.simplifiedChinese: 此套盔甲旨在彰显穿着者与外骨骼装甲之间的紧密羁绊——极致亲密贴合，但不至于堕入生化人之境。
englishValues: This armour celebrates the wearer's close relationship to their Exosuit---as intimate as is possible without succumbing to cyborgry.
simplifiedChineseValues: 此套盔甲旨在彰显穿着者与外骨骼装甲之间的紧密羁绊——极致亲密贴合，但不至于堕入生化人之境。

records.english: A mighty rifle with a signature lever-action enabling single round reload. Powerful precision suited to mid- and long-range combat.
records.simplifiedChinese: 威力强大的步枪，经典拉柄式设计支持单发装填。精准度极高，适合中远程作战。
englishValues: A mighty rifle with a signature lever-action enabling single round reload. Powerful precision suited to mid- and long-range combat.
simplifiedChineseValues: 威力强大的步枪，经典拉柄式设计支持单发装填。精准度极高，适合中远程作战。

records.english: A tribute to the Liberation of Choepessa IV in the First Galactic War, in which so much orbital ordnance was detonated that its sun was occluded by ash for an entire lunar cycle.
records.simplifiedChinese: 纪念第一次星系战争的科埃佩萨IV解放战役。彼时投射的轨道火力留下了漫天烟尘，将恒星的光芒遮蔽了整整一个月。
englishValues: A tribute to the Liberation of Choepessa IV in the First Galactic War, in which so much orbital ordnance was detonated that its sun was occluded by ash for an entire lunar cycle.
simplifiedChineseValues: 纪念第一次星系战争的科埃佩萨IV解放战役。彼时投射的轨道火力留下了漫天烟尘，将恒星的光芒遮蔽了整整一个月。

records.english: Enables melee attacks to <c=#COLOR>remove larger obstacles</c>, such as fences.
records.simplifiedChinese: 近战攻击可<c=#COLOR>拆除更大型的障碍物</c>，例如栅栏。
englishValues: Enables melee attacks to <c=#COLOR>remove larger obstacles</c>, such as fences.
simplifiedChineseValues: 近战攻击可<c=#COLOR>拆除更大型的障碍物</c>，例如栅栏。

records.english: A paint job for use in desert environments.
records.simplifiedChinese: 适用于沙漠环境的涂装。
englishValues: A paint job for use in desert environments.
simplifiedChineseValues: 适用于沙漠环境的涂装。

records.english: Forged for those watchful protectors who silently guide all Helldivers, asking no recognition whatsoever, besides a simple custom-made suit of armour only they get to wear.
records.simplifiedChinese: 为默默引导所有绝地潜兵的保护者打造，除了简单的专属定制盔甲以外，他们不求得到任何形式的认可。
englishValues: Forged for those watchful protectors who silently guide all Helldivers, asking no recognition whatsoever, besides a simple custom-made suit of armour only they get to wear.
simplifiedChineseValues: 为默默引导所有绝地潜兵的保护者打造，除了简单的专属定制盔甲以外，他们不求得到任何形式的认可。

records.english: A paint job that dares to stand out.
englishValues: A paint job that dares to stand out.

records.english: A powerful manned gun emplacement, capable of taking out armoured targets at long ranges.
records.simplifiedChinese: 威力强大的手动炮台，可摧毁远距离装甲目标。
englishValues: A powerful manned gun emplacement, capable of taking out armoured targets at long ranges.
simplifiedChineseValues: 威力强大的手动炮台，可摧毁远距离装甲目标。

records.english: Provides <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> resistance to fire, gas, acid, and electrical damage.
records.simplifiedChinese: 获得<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>抵御火焰、毒气、酸液以及电击伤害的能力。
englishValues: Provides <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> resistance to fire, gas, acid, and electrical damage.
simplifiedChineseValues: 获得<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>抵御火焰、毒气、酸液以及电击伤害的能力。

records.english: A stationary ballistic cover with a mounted light machine gun. Can protect multiple Helldivers from small arms fire.
records.simplifiedChinese: 固定式防弹掩体，架设有轻机枪。可抵挡轻型武器的射击，保护多名绝地潜兵。
englishValues: A stationary ballistic cover with a mounted light machine gun. Can protect multiple Helldivers from small arms fire.
simplifiedChineseValues: 固定式防弹掩体，架设有轻机枪。可抵挡轻型武器的射击，保护多名绝地潜兵。

records.english: "Prowl like a jaguar, strike like a viper." -Motto of the storied SEAF special operations unit whose real exploits were portrayed in the classic comic book series 'Tales of the Viper Commandos'.
records.simplifiedChinese: “巡如豹，袭如蛇。”这是传奇超级地球武装部队特别行动组的座右铭。经典漫画《毒蛇突击队的故事》真实描绘了他们的丰功伟绩。
englishValues: "Prowl like a jaguar, strike like a viper." -Motto of the storied SEAF special operations unit whose real exploits were portrayed in the classic comic book series 'Tales of the Viper Commandos'.
simplifiedChineseValues: “巡如豹，袭如蛇。”这是传奇超级地球武装部队特别行动组的座右铭。经典漫画《毒蛇突击队的故事》真实描绘了他们的丰功伟绩。

records.english: In mountainous colonies, domestic variants of this armour are used to throw weather monitoring equipment uphill.
records.simplifiedChinese: 在山区殖民地，这套盔甲的家用版本是用来把天气监测设备丢到山上的好帮手。
englishValues: In mountainous colonies, domestic variants of this armour are used to throw weather monitoring equipment uphill.
simplifiedChineseValues: 在山区殖民地，这套盔甲的家用版本是用来把天气监测设备丢到山上的好帮手。

records.english: An agile automated machine gun turret. Will fire at targets even if Helldivers will be caught in the crossfire.
records.simplifiedChinese: 灵活的自动机枪炮台，即便绝地潜兵在交火期间受伤，它依然会向目标射击。
englishValues: An agile automated machine gun turret. Will fire at targets even if Helldivers will be caught in the crossfire.
simplifiedChineseValues: 灵活的自动机枪炮台，即便绝地潜兵在交火期间受伤，它依然会向目标射击。

records.english: A speed-loaded volley gun with three different firing modes and three different RPM options. Warning: recoil varies significantly between firing modes.
records.simplifiedChinese: 快速装填的齐射枪，具备三种不同的射击模式，以及三种不同射速选项。警告：不同射击模式之间的后坐力差异巨大。
englishValues: A speed-loaded volley gun with three different firing modes and three different RPM options. Warning: recoil varies significantly between firing modes.
simplifiedChineseValues: 快速装填的齐射枪，具备三种不同的射击模式，以及三种不同射速选项。警告：不同射击模式之间的后坐力差异巨大。

records.english: A barrage of high explosive rounds, fired from the Destroyer's high speed rotary autocannons.
records.simplifiedChinese: 驱逐舰的高速旋转式机炮发射高爆弹，形成火力网。
englishValues: A barrage of high explosive rounds, fired from the Destroyer's high speed rotary autocannons.
simplifiedChineseValues: 驱逐舰的高速旋转式机炮发射高爆弹，形成火力网。

records.english: A fully automatic assault rifle featuring a non-removable suppressor and subsonic ammunition. Slower rounds allow low-profile operation.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备不可拆卸消音器和亚音速弹药的全自动突击步枪。弹药速度较低，便于执行隐蔽行动。
englishValues: A fully automatic assault rifle featuring a non-removable suppressor and subsonic ammunition. Slower rounds allow low-profile operation.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备不可拆卸消音器和亚音速弹药的全自动突击步枪。弹药速度较低，便于执行隐蔽行动。

records.english: The SEAF standard pistol - offering a high fire rate, generous capacity, and fast reloading.
records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球武装部队制式手枪。射速较高、弹药容量理想，装弹速度也比较快。
englishValues: The SEAF standard pistol - offering a high fire rate, generous capacity, and fast reloading.
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球武装部队制式手枪。射速较高、弹药容量理想，装弹速度也比较快。

records.english: Domestic versions of this armour enable colonial farmers to plant crops and mines side by side, safely.
records.simplifiedChinese: 殖民地农民可以购买这套盔甲的家用版本，确保自己和同伴可以紧贴着彼此，安全地种植农作物以及布设地雷。
englishValues: Domestic versions of this armour enable colonial farmers to plant crops and mines side by side, safely.
simplifiedChineseValues: 殖民地农民可以购买这套盔甲的家用版本，确保自己和同伴可以紧贴着彼此，安全地种植农作物以及布设地雷。

records.english: An autonomous drone equipped with a laser rifle, providing 360° cover. Returns to backpack to cool down.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备激光步枪的自主无人机，可提供全方位掩护。需要冷却时会返回背包。
englishValues: An autonomous drone equipped with a laser rifle, providing 360° cover. Returns to backpack to cool down.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备激光步枪的自主无人机，可提供全方位掩护。需要冷却时会返回背包。

records.english: "We fear not poison, fear not death; spite our foes with every breath." From the beloved classic Hazard Pay: The Musical.
records.simplifiedChinese: “我们不惧毒药，不畏死亡；每一次呼吸都让敌人破防”。选自广受喜爱的经典作品音乐剧《危险津贴》。
englishValues: "We fear not poison, fear not death; spite our foes with every breath." From the beloved classic Hazard Pay: The Musical.
simplifiedChineseValues: “我们不惧毒药，不畏死亡；每一次呼吸都让敌人破防”。选自广受喜爱的经典作品音乐剧《危险津贴》。

records.english: A dart-firing pistol. Each of its six rounds administers a gaseous chemical agent, harmful to hostiles whether organic or artificial, that also induces a state of delirium in the target.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射飞镖的手枪。其六发飞镖均含有气态化学制剂，对有机或人造敌人都能造成伤害，还会令目标陷入神志不清的状态。
englishValues: A dart-firing pistol. Each of its six rounds administers a gaseous chemical agent, harmful to hostiles whether organic or artificial, that also induces a state of delirium in the target.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射飞镖的手枪。其六发飞镖均含有气态化学制剂，对有机或人造敌人都能造成伤害，还会令目标陷入神志不清的状态。

records.english: The Destroyer's laser cannon will sweep over the designated area, vaporising all targets within the effective radius.
records.simplifiedChinese: 驱逐舰的激光加农炮扫射指定区域，令效果范围内的目标全数蒸发。
englishValues: The Destroyer's laser cannon will sweep over the designated area, vaporising all targets within the effective radius.
simplifiedChineseValues: 驱逐舰的激光加农炮扫射指定区域，令效果范围内的目标全数蒸发。

records.english: A humane compliance weapon with two separate magazines: one for armour-penetrating flechette rounds and one for stun rounds.
records.simplifiedChinese: 符合人道主义的武器，共有两个独立弹匣：一个装备穿甲飞镖霰弹，另一个装备眩晕弹。
englishValues: A humane compliance weapon with two separate magazines: one for armour-penetrating flechette rounds and one for stun rounds.
simplifiedChineseValues: 符合人道主义的武器，共有两个独立弹匣：一个装备穿甲飞镖霰弹，另一个装备眩晕弹。

records.english: An Exosuit equipped with a rocket launcher and a gatling gun, offering reliable flexibility against both heavy units and swarms of small targets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 搭载火箭发射器和加特林机枪的外骨骼装甲，能够可靠灵活地应对重型单位和成群小型目标。
englishValues: An Exosuit equipped with a rocket launcher and a gatling gun, offering reliable flexibility against both heavy units and swarms of small targets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 搭载火箭发射器和加特林机枪的外骨骼装甲，能够可靠灵活地应对重型单位和成群小型目标。

records.english: Featuring a vibrant, high-visibility pattern to signify the inevitable victory of the Federation. This cape reminds all observers that while the road to Liberty is paved with sacrifice, the "podium" at the end is reserved exclusively for the compliant.
records.simplifiedChinese: 采用鲜艳的高可见度图案，预示联邦必定赢得胜利。它提醒所有观察者：通往自由的道路由牺牲铺就，但尽头的“领奖台”专属于顺民。
englishValues: Featuring a vibrant, high-visibility pattern to signify the inevitable victory of the Federation. This cape reminds all observers that while the road to Liberty is paved with sacrifice, the "podium" at the end is reserved exclusively for the compliant.
simplifiedChineseValues: 采用鲜艳的高可见度图案，预示联邦必定赢得胜利。它提醒所有观察者：通往自由的道路由牺牲铺就，但尽头的“领奖台”专属于顺民。

records.english:
A top-loaded shotgun prominently featured in the final episode of 'Obedient Democracy Support Troopers'.
Produced by Martian Armoury.
records.simplifiedChinese:
顶部装弹的霰弹枪，在《民主光环驰援部队》大结局中有突出表现。
由火星军械库生产。
englishValues:
A top-loaded shotgun prominently featured in the final episode of 'Obedient Democracy Support Troopers'.
Produced by Martian Armoury.
simplifiedChineseValues:
顶部装弹的霰弹枪，在《民主光环驰援部队》大结局中有突出表现。
由火星军械库生产。

records.english: A semi-automatic ceremonial rifle equipped with a bayonet. Can be set to fire in three-shot bursts, to easily conduct the Fallen Hero's Salute.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备刺刀的半自动礼仪步枪。可设置为三连发模式，轻松鸣枪致敬陨落的英雄。
englishValues: A semi-automatic ceremonial rifle equipped with a bayonet. Can be set to fire in three-shot bursts, to easily conduct the Fallen Hero's Salute.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备刺刀的半自动礼仪步枪。可设置为三连发模式，轻松鸣枪致敬陨落的英雄。

records.english: A cluster fragmentation grenade. The shrapnel submunition allows it to inflict damage over a large area.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一种集束破片手榴弹。弹片能够在大范围内造成伤害。
englishValues: A cluster fragmentation grenade. The shrapnel submunition allows it to inflict damage over a large area.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一种集束破片手榴弹。弹片能够在大范围内造成伤害。

records.english: A high-calibre rifle with high damage and penetration.
records.simplifiedChinese: 大口径步枪，拥有超高的伤害和穿透力。
englishValues: A high-calibre rifle with high damage and penetration.
simplifiedChineseValues: 大口径步枪，拥有超高的伤害和穿透力。

records.english: Even among the most depraved of dissidents, the mere sight of this armour is enough to inspire a change of heart.
records.simplifiedChinese: 即使是最顽固的异见分子，只要看到这套盔甲，就会弃暗投明。
englishValues: Even among the most depraved of dissidents, the mere sight of this armour is enough to inspire a change of heart.
simplifiedChineseValues: 即使是最顽固的异见分子，只要看到这套盔甲，就会弃暗投明。

records.english: A quality product, this armour can destroy over 300,000 kilometres of fencing with no decline in operational efficiency.
records.simplifiedChinese: 即使撞破30万公里的栅栏，这套高品质盔甲的使用效率也丝毫不会下降。
englishValues: A quality product, this armour can destroy over 300,000 kilometres of fencing with no decline in operational efficiency.
simplifiedChineseValues: 即使撞破30万公里的栅栏，这套高品质盔甲的使用效率也丝毫不会下降。

records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球武装部队大炮：炸弹
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球武装部队大炮：炸弹

records.english: An accurate, armour-penetrating rifle, the BR-14 Adjudicator delivers righteous judgement to medium-sized enemies, though its restrictive magazine limits its effectiveness against large groups.
records.simplifiedChinese: “审判者”是精准度较高的穿甲步枪，可对中等体型的敌人进行正义审判，但由于弹匣容量有限，对大群敌人的攻击效果也相对受限。
englishValues: An accurate, armour-penetrating rifle, the BR-14 Adjudicator delivers righteous judgement to medium-sized enemies, though its restrictive magazine limits its effectiveness against large groups.
simplifiedChineseValues: “审判者”是精准度较高的穿甲步枪，可对中等体型的敌人进行正义审判，但由于弹匣容量有限，对大群敌人的攻击效果也相对受限。

records.english: Commemorating the New Stockholm treaty on prisoners of war, this cape celebrates the right of all enemy combatants to a swift and merciful execution.
records.simplifiedChinese: 该披肩旨在纪念关于战俘的《新斯德哥尔摩公约》，颂扬了敌方战斗人员享有的被迅速、仁慈处决的权利。
englishValues: Commemorating the New Stockholm treaty on prisoners of war, this cape celebrates the right of all enemy combatants to a swift and merciful execution.
simplifiedChineseValues: 该披肩旨在纪念关于战俘的《新斯德哥尔摩公约》，颂扬了敌方战斗人员享有的被迅速、仁慈处决的权利。

records.english: A drone that defends its user by firing caustic gas at nearby enemies, blinding and slowing them temporarily. Returns to backpack to refill.
records.simplifiedChinese: 通过向周遭敌人发射腐蚀气体保护使用者的无人机，可使敌人暂时致盲并减速。收回背包可补充气体。
englishValues: A drone that defends its user by firing caustic gas at nearby enemies, blinding and slowing them temporarily. Returns to backpack to refill.
simplifiedChineseValues: 通过向周遭敌人发射腐蚀气体保护使用者的无人机，可使敌人暂时致盲并减速。收回背包可补充气体。

records.simplifiedChinese: 弹链式榴弹发射器背包
simplifiedChineseValues: 弹链式榴弹发射器背包

records.english: Bearers of this armour ride no equine mount, but are nonetheless borne to battle atop the trusty steed of Liberty.
records.simplifiedChinese: 穿上这套盔甲后虽然不能骑真正的马，却仿佛驾驭自由精神的良驹奔赴战场。
englishValues: Bearers of this armour ride no equine mount, but are nonetheless borne to battle atop the trusty steed of Liberty.
simplifiedChineseValues: 穿上这套盔甲后虽然不能骑真正的马，却仿佛驾驭自由精神的良驹奔赴战场。

records.english: A modified Liberator fitted with a scope and firing armour-piercing rounds, to help users take down armoured targets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 改装后的“解放者”搭配瞄准镜，可发射穿甲弹，助力使用者击倒装备护甲的目标。
englishValues: A modified Liberator fitted with a scope and firing armour-piercing rounds, to help users take down armoured targets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 改装后的“解放者”搭配瞄准镜，可发射穿甲弹，助力使用者击倒装备护甲的目标。

records.english: A useful field-clearing tool for removing trees, obstacles, and unlucky foes.
records.simplifiedChinese: 用于清除树木、障碍物和倒霉敌人的实用野外清理工具。
englishValues: A useful field-clearing tool for removing trees, obstacles, and unlucky foes.
simplifiedChineseValues: 用于清除树木、障碍物和倒霉敌人的实用野外清理工具。

records.english: A projectile which explodes while airborne, creating a deadly rain of shrapnel. Not effective against heavy armour.
records.simplifiedChinese: 射弹在空中引爆，而后弹片散落，如同致命的雨点。对重型装甲无效。
englishValues: A projectile which explodes while airborne, creating a deadly rain of shrapnel. Not effective against heavy armour.
simplifiedChineseValues: 射弹在空中引爆，而后弹片散落，如同致命的雨点。对重型装甲无效。

records.english: A machine gun designed for stationary use. Trades higher power for increased recoil and reduced accuracy.
records.simplifiedChinese: 为固定使用而设计的机枪。提高了火力，但后坐力增加，精准度也降低了。
englishValues: A machine gun designed for stationary use. Trades higher power for increased recoil and reduced accuracy.
simplifiedChineseValues: 为固定使用而设计的机枪。提高了火力，但后坐力增加，精准度也降低了。

records.english: Each servo-assisted limb contains 138 miniature motors, to support a natural gait and long-term spinal health.
records.simplifiedChinese: 各伺服辅助肢体包含138个微型马达，以实现自然步态，从长远角度保障脊柱健康。
englishValues: Each servo-assisted limb contains 138 miniature motors, to support a natural gait and long-term spinal health.
simplifiedChineseValues: 各伺服辅助肢体包含138个微型马达，以实现自然步态，从长远角度保障脊柱健康。

records.english: A flare that illuminates the battlefield.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可以照亮战场的照明弹。
englishValues: A flare that illuminates the battlefield.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可以照亮战场的照明弹。

records.english: Upon initial impact, the deployer scatters a wide field of proximity-detonated submunitions. These charges deal minimal damage, but will heavily stun and decelerate encroaching hostiles.
records.simplifiedChinese: 刚落地时，部署器会撒布大片近炸子弹药场。这些炸药造成的伤害极小，但能对逼近的敌军产生强力眩晕和减速效果。
englishValues: Upon initial impact, the deployer scatters a wide field of proximity-detonated submunitions. These charges deal minimal damage, but will heavily stun and decelerate encroaching hostiles.
simplifiedChineseValues: 刚落地时，部署器会撒布大片近炸子弹药场。这些炸药造成的伤害极小，但能对逼近的敌军产生强力眩晕和减速效果。

records.english: A replacement for a fallen comrade.
englishValues: A replacement for a fallen comrade.

records.english: A targeted air strike unable to destroy buildings, but efficient at clearing smaller targets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 定向空袭，无法摧毁建筑，但可以有效清除较小型目标。
englishValues: A targeted air strike unable to destroy buildings, but efficient at clearing smaller targets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 定向空袭，无法摧毁建筑，但可以有效清除较小型目标。

records.english: Provides one-time, short-lived resuscitation upon death, given that the Helldiver's body is still intact.
records.simplifiedChinese: 在绝地潜兵躯体完好的前提下，死亡后可获得一次短暂的复活机会。
englishValues: Provides one-time, short-lived resuscitation upon death, given that the Helldiver's body is still intact.
simplifiedChineseValues: 在绝地潜兵躯体完好的前提下，死亡后可获得一次短暂的复活机会。

records.english: A laser rifle, firing in short bursts. Does not need reloading, but if it overheats a new heat sink must be fitted.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可瞬间喷射高能激光束的激光步枪。无需重新装弹，但如果步枪过热，必须安装新的散热器。
englishValues: A laser rifle, firing in short bursts. Does not need reloading, but if it overheats a new heat sink must be fitted.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可瞬间喷射高能激光束的激光步枪。无需重新装弹，但如果步枪过热，必须安装新的散热器。

records.english: A single-use weapon sporting caseless ammunition stacked in multiple barrels. An electrical firing mechanism releases the rounds in rapid succession upon firing, after which the weapon is to be discarded.
records.simplifiedChinese: 采用无壳弹药与多枪管叠加设计的一次性武器。开火时，电控击发装置会快速清空弹药，弹药清空后即可丢弃该武器。
englishValues: A single-use weapon sporting caseless ammunition stacked in multiple barrels. An electrical firing mechanism releases the rounds in rapid succession upon firing, after which the weapon is to be discarded.
simplifiedChineseValues: 采用无壳弹药与多枪管叠加设计的一次性武器。开火时，电控击发装置会快速清空弹药，弹药清空后即可丢弃该武器。

records.english: Creates a <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> chance of surviving a lethal hit.
records.simplifiedChinese: 在受到致命一击后有<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>的几率存活。
englishValues: Creates a <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> chance of surviving a lethal hit.
simplifiedChineseValues: 在受到致命一击后有<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>的几率存活。

records.english: A paint job for use in arctic environments.
records.simplifiedChinese: 适用于雪地环境的涂装。
englishValues: A paint job for use in arctic environments.
simplifiedChineseValues: 适用于雪地环境的涂装。

records.english: A submachine gun with an extremely high rate of fire, which can be operated with one hand. Ideal for multitasking.
records.simplifiedChinese: 射速极高的冲锋枪，可单手操控。同时处理多重任务时的理想之选。
englishValues: A submachine gun with an extremely high rate of fire, which can be operated with one hand. Ideal for multitasking.
simplifiedChineseValues: 射速极高的冲锋枪，可单手操控。同时处理多重任务时的理想之选。

records.english: The breathing apparatus built into this equipment helps both soldiers and colonists thrive, even when assigned to planets with atmospheres rated 'suboptimal', 'extreme', and 'character building'.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套装备的内置呼吸装置能帮助士兵和拓殖地居民畅快呼吸，即使被派往评级为“次优”、“恶劣”和“磨练性格”的星球也应付自如。
englishValues: The breathing apparatus built into this equipment helps both soldiers and colonists thrive, even when assigned to planets with atmospheres rated 'suboptimal', 'extreme', and 'character building'.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套装备的内置呼吸装置能帮助士兵和拓殖地居民畅快呼吸，即使被派往评级为“次优”、“恶劣”和“磨练性格”的星球也应付自如。

records.english: The dauntless pioneers of the Great Expansion, facing the un-Democratic unknown, adopted the Way of the Bandolier. With the gusto of their covering fire making up for their modest accuracy, they strived to be perfectly aligned in their shared values, and ready to serve when called upon by the machine gun of civic duty.
records.simplifiedChinese: 面对尚未民主化的未知世界，大扩张时期的无畏先驱者践行弹带之道。他们用狂热的火力掩护弥补射击准度的不足，奋力追求共同价值观的完美统一，并时刻响应公民责任机枪的召唤，随时准备投身战斗。
englishValues: The dauntless pioneers of the Great Expansion, facing the un-Democratic unknown, adopted the Way of the Bandolier. With the gusto of their covering fire making up for their modest accuracy, they strived to be perfectly aligned in their shared values, and ready to serve when called upon by the machine gun of civic duty.
simplifiedChineseValues: 面对尚未民主化的未知世界，大扩张时期的无畏先驱者践行弹带之道。他们用狂热的火力掩护弥补射击准度的不足，奋力追求共同价值观的完美统一，并时刻响应公民责任机枪的召唤，随时准备投身战斗。

records.english: Command Centre of the Super Destroyer. The helm from which Helldivers deliver Freedom's mercy.
records.simplifiedChinese: 超级驱逐舰的指挥中心，绝地潜兵通过这个船舵传递自由精神的仁慈。
englishValues: Command Centre of the Super Destroyer. The helm from which Helldivers deliver Freedom's mercy.
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级驱逐舰的指挥中心，绝地潜兵通过这个船舵传递自由精神的仁慈。

records.english: This vision-disruptive pattern cloaks the silent crusaders whose untraceable deeds are a pure expression of true Freedom: freedom from accountability.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这种干扰视觉的图案能够有效掩护寂静无声的圣战士，他们难以捉摸的行踪纯粹地展现了真正的自由，即免责的自由。
englishValues: This vision-disruptive pattern cloaks the silent crusaders whose untraceable deeds are a pure expression of true Freedom: freedom from accountability.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这种干扰视觉的图案能够有效掩护寂静无声的圣战士，他们难以捉摸的行踪纯粹地展现了真正的自由，即免责的自由。

records.english: A LAS-16 Sickle model with all overheating protections conveniently removed, allowing for far longer bursts of fire. Does more damage when overheated, at the cost of slightly burning the user.
records.simplifiedChinese: 移除所有过热保护机制的LAS-16“镰刀”型号，显著延长连射时间。 过热时会造成更大伤害，但会轻微灼伤使用者。
englishValues: A LAS-16 Sickle model with all overheating protections conveniently removed, allowing for far longer bursts of fire. Does more damage when overheated, at the cost of slightly burning the user.
simplifiedChineseValues: 移除所有过热保护机制的LAS-16“镰刀”型号，显著延长连射时间。 过热时会造成更大伤害，但会轻微灼伤使用者。

records.english: A Dark Fluid-powered backpack that generates a portable micro-wormhole. This safe and well-understood technology allows the wearer to warp short distances. Warning: do not use while pack is overloaded.
records.simplifiedChinese: 暗液体驱动的背包，可生成便携式微型虫洞。这项安全且成熟的技术可助使用者进行短距离传送。警告：背包过载时请勿使用。
englishValues: A Dark Fluid-powered backpack that generates a portable micro-wormhole. This safe and well-understood technology allows the wearer to warp short distances. Warning: do not use while pack is overloaded.
simplifiedChineseValues: 暗液体驱动的背包，可生成便携式微型虫洞。这项安全且成熟的技术可助使用者进行短距离传送。警告：背包过载时请勿使用。

records.simplifiedChinese: 激光瞄准器与直角前握把
simplifiedChineseValues: 激光瞄准器与直角前握把

records.english: A representation of the thankfulness of those infinite descendants whose liberated existence we strive to ensure.
records.simplifiedChinese: 我们竭尽全力让无数后代过上解放的生活，而这代表了他们的感激之心。
englishValues: A representation of the thankfulness of those infinite descendants whose liberated existence we strive to ensure.
simplifiedChineseValues: 我们竭尽全力让无数后代过上解放的生活，而这代表了他们的感激之心。

records.english: An angled vertical foregrip to improve the manoeuvrability of the weapon.
records.simplifiedChinese: 直角垂直前握把，可提升武器操控性。
englishValues: An angled vertical foregrip to improve the manoeuvrability of the weapon.
simplifiedChineseValues: 直角垂直前握把，可提升武器操控性。

records.english: A submachine gun with a longer barrel, allowing for higher muzzle velocity and increased armour penetration.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备加长枪管的冲锋枪，枪口初速更高且具备更强的护甲穿透能力。
englishValues: A submachine gun with a longer barrel, allowing for higher muzzle velocity and increased armour penetration.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备加长枪管的冲锋枪，枪口初速更高且具备更强的护甲穿透能力。

records.english: In field tests, 84% of users said that the armour improved their posture and self-esteem.
records.simplifiedChinese: 实地测试中，有84%的使用者表示此盔甲改善了他们的体态，也提升了他们的自尊心。
englishValues: In field tests, 84% of users said that the armour improved their posture and self-esteem.
simplifiedChineseValues: 实地测试中，有84%的使用者表示此盔甲改善了他们的体态，也提升了他们的自尊心。

records.english: Composed of reclaimed industrial mesh and salvaged banners. This cape celebrates the beauty found in the aftermath of purging Tyranny at high-speeds. The debris of these successes, and those like it, remind us all of the sanctity of Sovereignty.
records.simplifiedChinese: 由回收的工业网格和残破旗帜组成。这件披肩赞美了疾速肃清暴政后产生的美感。这些成功的残骸提醒所有人：主权神圣不可侵犯。
englishValues: Composed of reclaimed industrial mesh and salvaged banners. This cape celebrates the beauty found in the aftermath of purging Tyranny at high-speeds. The debris of these successes, and those like it, remind us all of the sanctity of Sovereignty.
simplifiedChineseValues: 由回收的工业网格和残破旗帜组成。这件披肩赞美了疾速肃清暴政后产生的美感。这些成功的残骸提醒所有人：主权神圣不可侵犯。

records.english: A heavy one-handed blade. Slower to swing than other melee weapons, but deals more damage.
records.simplifiedChinese: 沉重的单手刀。挥舞速度比其他近战武器慢，但造成的伤害更高。
englishValues: A heavy one-handed blade. Slower to swing than other melee weapons, but deals more damage.
simplifiedChineseValues: 沉重的单手刀。挥舞速度比其他近战武器慢，但造成的伤害更高。

records.english: A symbol of Super Earth's Astral Promise: that every star shall one day illuminate throngs of joyous voters.
records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球星之承诺的象征：终有一日，每一颗星都将因快乐的选民而闪亮。
englishValues: A symbol of Super Earth's Astral Promise: that every star shall one day illuminate throngs of joyous voters.
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球星之承诺的象征：终有一日，每一颗星都将因快乐的选民而闪亮。

records.english: Commonly replicated in stage adaptions of 'Lady Liberty's Tower', in which young Diver Beatrick dons this armour to slay Oppressio, the Tyrant Rex.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲常见于《自由女神塔》的舞台剧版本，剧中年轻的绝地潜兵比特里克正是身着这套盔甲，斩杀暴君王奥普雷西奥。
englishValues: Commonly replicated in stage adaptions of 'Lady Liberty's Tower', in which young Diver Beatrick dons this armour to slay Oppressio, the Tyrant Rex.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲常见于《自由女神塔》的舞台剧版本，剧中年轻的绝地潜兵比特里克正是身着这套盔甲，斩杀暴君王奥普雷西奥。

records.english: Although Super Citizen Miranda's true identity has been lost to time, most legal historians agree that she was once a patron of highly-efficient interrogation techniques.
records.simplifiedChinese: 尽管超级公民米兰达的真实身份已被时间湮没，但大多数法律史学家一致认为，她曾是高效审讯技术的赞助人。
englishValues: Although Super Citizen Miranda's true identity has been lost to time, most legal historians agree that she was once a patron of highly-efficient interrogation techniques.
simplifiedChineseValues: 尽管超级公民米兰达的真实身份已被时间湮没，但大多数法律史学家一致认为，她曾是高效审讯技术的赞助人。

records.english: This armour was designed by PFC Rodney A. Carmichael, the first Helldiver to use a stim on an ally instead of himself.
records.simplifiedChinese: 此盔甲由一等兵罗德尼·A.·卡迈克尔设计，他是首位将治疗剂用在队友身上（而不是自用）的绝地潜兵。
englishValues: This armour was designed by PFC Rodney A. Carmichael, the first Helldiver to use a stim on an ally instead of himself.
simplifiedChineseValues: 此盔甲由一等兵罗德尼·A.·卡迈克尔设计，他是首位将治疗剂用在队友身上（而不是自用）的绝地潜兵。

records.english: Fires powerful exploding bolts which do maximum damage upon direct impact. Gravity must be accounted for when aiming.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射威力强大的爆炸弩箭，对直接命中的目标造成最大伤害。瞄准时必须考虑重力因素。
englishValues: Fires powerful exploding bolts which do maximum damage upon direct impact. Gravity must be accounted for when aiming.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射威力强大的爆炸弩箭，对直接命中的目标造成最大伤害。瞄准时必须考虑重力因素。

records.english: A grenade launcher that can be fired continuously to deliver a nonstop barrage of explosives.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可持续射击的榴弹发射器，能够不间断地倾泻火力。
englishValues: A grenade launcher that can be fired continuously to deliver a nonstop barrage of explosives.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可持续射击的榴弹发射器，能够不间断地倾泻火力。

records.english: When donning the One True Flag, one must face the direction of Super Earth, recite the Super Earth Anthem, and salute one's own image in the nearest reflective surface. Wrongful discarding of this cape is a capital offence.
records.simplifiedChinese: 身披这件印有“唯一真旗”的披肩时，必须面朝超级地球，唱响超级地球国歌，并向最近反光面中的自己敬礼。错误丢弃此披肩者，罪当处死。
englishValues: When donning the One True Flag, one must face the direction of Super Earth, recite the Super Earth Anthem, and salute one's own image in the nearest reflective surface. Wrongful discarding of this cape is a capital offence.
simplifiedChineseValues: 身披这件印有“唯一真旗”的披肩时，必须面朝超级地球，唱响超级地球国歌，并向最近反光面中的自己敬礼。错误丢弃此披肩者，罪当处死。

records.english: A paint job for use in forest environments.
records.simplifiedChinese: 适用于森林环境的涂装。
englishValues: A paint job for use in forest environments.
simplifiedChineseValues: 适用于森林环境的涂装。

records.english: Let the Second Anniversary of the Second Galactic War be witnessed by the lidless eye of Liberty, that ever-watchful orb which provides safety through its ceaseless surveillance.
records.simplifiedChinese: 自由之眼永不阖目，它将见证第二次星系战争进入两周年，并通过无休止的监视为我们提供安全。
englishValues: Let the Second Anniversary of the Second Galactic War be witnessed by the lidless eye of Liberty, that ever-watchful orb which provides safety through its ceaseless surveillance.
simplifiedChineseValues: 自由之眼永不阖目，它将见证第二次星系战争进入两周年，并通过无休止的监视为我们提供安全。
