records.english: After extensive testing in Patriotic Rehabilitation Centres, this design was proved most terrifying to dissent-afflicted individuals.
records.simplifiedChinese: 爱国康复中心的详尽测试证明，这是最令异见分子感到恐惧的设计。
englishValues: After extensive testing in Patriotic Rehabilitation Centres, this design was proved most terrifying to dissent-afflicted individuals.
simplifiedChineseValues: 爱国康复中心的详尽测试证明，这是最令异见分子感到恐惧的设计。

records.english: Creates a large, thick smoke screen to block targets' line of sight.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可形成一道厚重的大型烟幕，遮挡目标的视线。
englishValues: Creates a large, thick smoke screen to block targets' line of sight.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可形成一道厚重的大型烟幕，遮挡目标的视线。

records.english: Designed by fashion legend RH Gant, the pattern seen on this cape also appears on domestic dresses and gun-warmers.
records.simplifiedChinese: 由时尚传奇RH·甘特设计，披肩上的图案同时也用于家居服和暖枪套。
englishValues: Designed by fashion legend RH Gant, the pattern seen on this cape also appears on domestic dresses and gun-warmers.
simplifiedChineseValues: 由时尚传奇RH·甘特设计，披肩上的图案同时也用于家居服和暖枪套。

records.english: The symbol on this cape represents the pillars of freedom: duty, obedience, and loyalty.
records.simplifiedChinese: 披肩上的标志象征着自由的三大支柱：责任、服从、忠诚。
englishValues: The symbol on this cape represents the pillars of freedom: duty, obedience, and loyalty.
simplifiedChineseValues: 披肩上的标志象征着自由的三大支柱：责任、服从、忠诚。

records.english: This modest cape has been worn by those guarding the Chamber of Unanimous Decision since time immemorial.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件简朴的披肩自古便由统一决策大厅的守卫佩戴。
englishValues: This modest cape has been worn by those guarding the Chamber of Unanimous Decision since time immemorial.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件简朴的披肩自古便由统一决策大厅的守卫佩戴。

records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球武装部队大炮：高爆弹
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球武装部队大炮：高爆弹

records.english: Durable, waterproof, and thermally-lined, surplus units of this cape are favoured by domestic campers, to make tents.
records.simplifiedChinese: 耐用、防水，搭配保暖内衬，这款披肩的剩余布料也受到了国内露营爱好者的青睐，用于制作帐篷。
englishValues: Durable, waterproof, and thermally-lined, surplus units of this cape are favoured by domestic campers, to make tents.
simplifiedChineseValues: 耐用、防水，搭配保暖内衬，这款披肩的剩余布料也受到了国内露营爱好者的青睐，用于制作帐篷。

records.english: Stuns enemies performing melee attacks. Must recharge for <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
records.simplifiedChinese: 眩晕发动近战攻击的敌人。必须充能<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。
englishValues: Stuns enemies performing melee attacks. Must recharge for <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
simplifiedChineseValues: 眩晕发动近战攻击的敌人。必须充能<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。

records.english: A powerful automated turret, effective against armoured targets. The turret will primarily aim at larger enemies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 强力自动炮台，可有效对付装甲目标。炮台主要瞄准攻击较大型的敌人。
englishValues: A powerful automated turret, effective against armoured targets. The turret will primarily aim at larger enemies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 强力自动炮台，可有效对付装甲目标。炮台主要瞄准攻击较大型的敌人。

records.english: Developed by the Ministry of Science while investigating the phenomenon known as The Gloom, this armour is non-permeable and squeak resistant.
records.simplifiedChinese: 科学部在调查“阴霾”现象时研制而成，该盔甲防渗透性佳，穿上后也不会吱吱作响。
englishValues: Developed by the Ministry of Science while investigating the phenomenon known as The Gloom, this armour is non-permeable and squeak resistant.
simplifiedChineseValues: 科学部在调查“阴霾”现象时研制而成，该盔甲防渗透性佳，穿上后也不会吱吱作响。

records.english: Features a utility belt with pockets that can be filled with any number of things, such as pocket knives, mementos from home, and interesting rocks.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配有带口袋的实用腰带，可装入各式各样的物品，如便携刀具、家乡的纪念品和有意思的石头。
englishValues: Features a utility belt with pockets that can be filled with any number of things, such as pocket knives, mementos from home, and interesting rocks.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配有带口袋的实用腰带，可装入各式各样的物品，如便携刀具、家乡的纪念品和有意思的石头。

records.english: A backpack which can be wielded as a one-handed ballistic shield, protecting against small arms fire.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可用作单手防弹护盾的背包，能抵挡轻型武器的射击。
englishValues: A backpack which can be wielded as a one-handed ballistic shield, protecting against small arms fire.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可用作单手防弹护盾的背包，能抵挡轻型武器的射击。

records.english: This patriotic armour comes recommended by the Ministry of Expansion, empowering the wearer to re-seize from our enemies any territory that any human has laid claim to, at any point in time.
records.simplifiedChinese: 扩张部强烈推荐这款宣扬爱国主义的装甲，它将赋予穿戴者力量，帮助他们从敌人手中夺回人类在各历史时间节点曾宣称主权的领土。
englishValues: This patriotic armour comes recommended by the Ministry of Expansion, empowering the wearer to re-seize from our enemies any territory that any human has laid claim to, at any point in time.
simplifiedChineseValues: 扩张部强烈推荐这款宣扬爱国主义的装甲，它将赋予穿戴者力量，帮助他们从敌人手中夺回人类在各历史时间节点曾宣称主权的领土。

records.english: Designed in homage to the triangle—the most immovable of shapes—this cape digs its heels into the eye of the observer, leaving a lasting impression.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这款披肩的设计致敬了三角形这一最稳固的几何形状，以其坚定不移的姿态直击观者眼球，留下深刻印象。
englishValues: Designed in homage to the triangle—the most immovable of shapes—this cape digs its heels into the eye of the observer, leaving a lasting impression.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这款披肩的设计致敬了三角形这一最稳固的几何形状，以其坚定不移的姿态直击观者眼球，留下深刻印象。

records.english: The three stripes on the pauldrons stand for the three principles of Super Earth: Liberty, Democracy, and Prosperity.
records.simplifiedChinese: 护肩上的三条纹象征着超级地球的三大原则：解放、民主与繁荣。
englishValues: The three stripes on the pauldrons stand for the three principles of Super Earth: Liberty, Democracy, and Prosperity.
simplifiedChineseValues: 护肩上的三条纹象征着超级地球的三大原则：解放、民主与繁荣。

records.english: It is well-documented that soldiers raised on harsh planets have an advantage when fighting in similar environments; this insight is foundational to the Democratic Youth Scouts Exchange Programme.
records.simplifiedChinese: 有充分记录表明，在恶劣星球上成长的士兵在类似环境中作战时具有优势。这样的洞察为民主青少年童子军交流计划奠定了基础。
englishValues: It is well-documented that soldiers raised on harsh planets have an advantage when fighting in similar environments; this insight is foundational to the Democratic Youth Scouts Exchange Programme.
simplifiedChineseValues: 有充分记录表明，在恶劣星球上成长的士兵在类似环境中作战时具有优势。这样的洞察为民主青少年童子军交流计划奠定了基础。

records.english: This cape recalls the popular folk tale of the 'Freedomslingers': re-educated dissidents, seeking redemption on the Federation's Borderline, hunting dangerous thought-traitors in exchange for ballot bounties.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩让人想起民间广为流传的“自由神枪手”的故事：接受过再教育的异见分子在联邦边境线上寻求救赎，通过追捕危险的思想叛徒换取选票赏金。
englishValues: This cape recalls the popular folk tale of the 'Freedomslingers': re-educated dissidents, seeking redemption on the Federation's Borderline, hunting dangerous thought-traitors in exchange for ballot bounties.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩让人想起民间广为流传的“自由神枪手”的故事：接受过再教育的异见分子在联邦边境线上寻求救赎，通过追捕危险的思想叛徒换取选票赏金。

records.english: A modern reinvention of the Lumberers of the first Galactic War, this Exosuit is equipped with a flamethrower and an anti-tank cannon.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这款外骨骼装甲是第一次星系战争中“伐木者”机甲的现代重制版，配备火焰喷射器和反坦克炮。
englishValues: A modern reinvention of the Lumberers of the first Galactic War, this Exosuit is equipped with a flamethrower and an anti-tank cannon.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这款外骨骼装甲是第一次星系战争中“伐木者”机甲的现代重制版，配备火焰喷射器和反坦克炮。

records.english: Featuring an ancient sun symbol and a distressed look, this cape reminds us that the light of Liberty is everlasting, and will keep shining even when we ourselves have become tattered and frayed.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件破旧的披肩饰有古老的太阳符号，提醒我们自由之光永存不灭，即使我们自身变得残破不堪，它也将继续闪耀。
englishValues: Featuring an ancient sun symbol and a distressed look, this cape reminds us that the light of Liberty is everlasting, and will keep shining even when we ourselves have become tattered and frayed.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件破旧的披肩饰有古老的太阳符号，提醒我们自由之光永存不灭，即使我们自身变得残破不堪，它也将继续闪耀。

records.english: The memory of the Martian training grounds will endure, even after all the Helldivers who trained there have passed, some day in the far future.
records.simplifiedChinese: 即使在遥远的未来，所有曾在火星训练场接受训练的绝地潜兵都已逝去，关于那里的记忆也永远不会褪色。
englishValues: The memory of the Martian training grounds will endure, even after all the Helldivers who trained there have passed, some day in the far future.
simplifiedChineseValues: 即使在遥远的未来，所有曾在火星训练场接受训练的绝地潜兵都已逝去，关于那里的记忆也永远不会褪色。

records.english: An automated turret that fires gas shells. Its targeting system prioritises hostiles not yet exhibiting symptoms caused by gas inhalation. Users are advised to stay significantly upwind of the resulting crowd control.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一种发射毒气弹的自动炮塔。其瞄准系统优先锁定尚未中毒的敌对目标。使用者应保持上风方位，避免被群体控制影响。
englishValues: An automated turret that fires gas shells. Its targeting system prioritises hostiles not yet exhibiting symptoms caused by gas inhalation. Users are advised to stay significantly upwind of the resulting crowd control.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一种发射毒气弹的自动炮塔。其瞄准系统优先锁定尚未中毒的敌对目标。使用者应保持上风方位，避免被群体控制影响。

records.english: Named for Helldiver Jack Boote, who shut down 908 illegal broadcasts before retiring with honours.
records.simplifiedChinese: 以绝地潜兵杰克·布特命名，他在光荣退役前曾查封了908个非法广播。
englishValues: Named for Helldiver Jack Boote, who shut down 908 illegal broadcasts before retiring with honours.
simplifiedChineseValues: 以绝地潜兵杰克·布特命名，他在光荣退役前曾查封了908个非法广播。

records.english: As documented in the bestselling graphic novel 'The Breach', the final mission of the 361st 'Freedom's Flame' saw the storied unit deploy straight into the heart of a Supervolcano, sacrificing themselves to trigger an eruption and wipe out a massive Terminid swarm.
records.simplifiedChinese: 根据畅销图像小说《突破》的描述，大名鼎鼎的361“自由烈焰”部队最后一次执行的任务是直接部署到超级火山的核心地带，英勇地牺牲自我，引发火山喷发，消灭数量庞大的终结族虫群。
englishValues: As documented in the bestselling graphic novel 'The Breach', the final mission of the 361st 'Freedom's Flame' saw the storied unit deploy straight into the heart of a Supervolcano, sacrificing themselves to trigger an eruption and wipe out a massive Terminid swarm.
simplifiedChineseValues: 根据畅销图像小说《突破》的描述，大名鼎鼎的361“自由烈焰”部队最后一次执行的任务是直接部署到超级火山的核心地带，英勇地牺牲自我，引发火山喷发，消灭数量庞大的终结族虫群。

records.english: A modified Breaker shotgun firing incendiary projectiles. Generates heat during use, so limited to burst fire.
records.simplifiedChinese: 改良后的“破裂者”霰弹枪，可发射燃烧弹。在使用过程中会产生热量，因此会限制连发射击。
englishValues: A modified Breaker shotgun firing incendiary projectiles. Generates heat during use, so limited to burst fire.
simplifiedChineseValues: 改良后的“破裂者”霰弹枪，可发射燃烧弹。在使用过程中会产生热量，因此会限制连发射击。

records.english: A modified Liberator firing concussive rounds which do less damage but stagger enemies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 改良版“解放者”，可连续发射震荡弹。虽然造成的伤害不大，但可击退敌人。
englishValues: A modified Liberator firing concussive rounds which do less damage but stagger enemies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 改良版“解放者”，可连续发射震荡弹。虽然造成的伤害不大，但可击退敌人。

records.english: A magazine with a very high capacity at the cost of being bulky and heavy.
records.simplifiedChinese: 该弹匣的弹药容量极大，但较笨重。
englishValues: A magazine with a very high capacity at the cost of being bulky and heavy.
simplifiedChineseValues: 该弹匣的弹药容量极大，但较笨重。

records.english: A single-use weapon that fires a missile containing napalm cluster bombs that release upon impact.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一次性武器，发射的导弹会在撞击时释放凝固汽油集束炸弹。
englishValues: A single-use weapon that fires a missile containing napalm cluster bombs that release upon impact.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一次性武器，发射的导弹会在撞击时释放凝固汽油集束炸弹。

records.english: Users are advised not to scratch at the lacquer, as the Red 20,000 pigment that gives this armour its signature sheen may be correlated with rapid DNA unspooling.
records.simplifiedChinese: 赋予盔甲标志性光泽的红色20,000颜料恐会导致DNA快速解旋，建议用户不要划伤漆面。
englishValues: Users are advised not to scratch at the lacquer, as the Red 20,000 pigment that gives this armour its signature sheen may be correlated with rapid DNA unspooling.
simplifiedChineseValues: 赋予盔甲标志性光泽的红色20,000颜料恐会导致DNA快速解旋，建议用户不要划伤漆面。

records.english: An advanced angled foregrip to improve weapon stability.
records.simplifiedChinese: 高级直角前握把，可提升武器稳定性。
englishValues: An advanced angled foregrip to improve weapon stability.
simplifiedChineseValues: 高级直角前握把，可提升武器稳定性。

records.english: A shorter magazine with lower capacity, making it lighter and easier to handle.
records.simplifiedChinese: 弹药容量较小的短弹匣，重量更轻，操控更方便。
englishValues: A shorter magazine with lower capacity, making it lighter and easier to handle.
simplifiedChineseValues: 弹药容量较小的短弹匣，重量更轻，操控更方便。

records.simplifiedChinese: 激光瞄准器与直角前握把
simplifiedChineseValues: 激光瞄准器与直角前握把

records.english: Inside the collar is embroidered: 'Wherever I may plant my shield, know that I will never yield', and 'machine washable'.
records.simplifiedChinese: 衣领内侧绣有“无论护盾所立何方，我绝不会屈膝投降”和“可机洗”字样。
englishValues: Inside the collar is embroidered: 'Wherever I may plant my shield, know that I will never yield', and 'machine washable'.
simplifiedChineseValues: 衣领内侧绣有“无论护盾所立何方，我绝不会屈膝投降”和“可机洗”字样。

records.english: A Hellpod containing a Super Solid State Drive, the peak of secure data storage. Used by Helldivers for everything from transfer of patriotic data to the sabotage of enemy mainframes.
records.simplifiedChinese: 装有最为安全的数据存储，超级固态硬盘的绝地喷射舱。从传输爱国数据到破坏敌人主机，绝地潜兵将其用于各种用途。
englishValues: A Hellpod containing a Super Solid State Drive, the peak of secure data storage. Used by Helldivers for everything from transfer of patriotic data to the sabotage of enemy mainframes.
simplifiedChineseValues: 装有最为安全的数据存储，超级固态硬盘的绝地喷射舱。从传输爱国数据到破坏敌人主机，绝地潜兵将其用于各种用途。

records.english: The muted colours and relaxed, high-mobility fit make this a favourite among long-distance snipers and hide-and-seek champions alike.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套装备还采用暗沉色调与宽松灵活的版型，深受远程狙击手和潜行高手的喜爱。
englishValues: The muted colours and relaxed, high-mobility fit make this a favourite among long-distance snipers and hide-and-seek champions alike.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套装备还采用暗沉色调与宽松灵活的版型，深受远程狙击手和潜行高手的喜爱。

records.english: A smoke grenade that rapidly deploys a small, dense cloud. Allows for rapid personal concealment and exfiltration.
records.simplifiedChinese: 快速在小范围内释放高密度烟雾的烟雾弹。有助于隐蔽个人行踪和掩护撤离行动。
englishValues: A smoke grenade that rapidly deploys a small, dense cloud. Allows for rapid personal concealment and exfiltration.
simplifiedChineseValues: 快速在小范围内释放高密度烟雾的烟雾弹。有助于隐蔽个人行踪和掩护撤离行动。

records.english: This armour uses repurposed metal from verified sources, such as vending machine packaging and Automaton scrap, making it a sustainable choice for the environmentally conscious Helldiver.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲采用来源经核实的回收金属材料，如自动售货机外壳和机器人废料，是具有环保意识的绝地潜兵的可持续之选。
englishValues: This armour uses repurposed metal from verified sources, such as vending machine packaging and Automaton scrap, making it a sustainable choice for the environmentally conscious Helldiver.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲采用来源经核实的回收金属材料，如自动售货机外壳和机器人废料，是具有环保意识的绝地潜兵的可持续之选。

records.english: A sledgehammer that can be wielded with or without an explosive charge attached to its head.
records.simplifiedChinese: 大锤头部可安装炸药，也可单独使用。
englishValues: A sledgehammer that can be wielded with or without an explosive charge attached to its head.
simplifiedChineseValues: 大锤头部可安装炸药，也可单独使用。

records.english: The understated colour scheme and precision-moulded armour plates make this armour a sensible choice for the Helldiver on the go.
records.simplifiedChinese: 精密铸造的护甲板加上低调的配色，这套护甲是绝地潜兵在配置行动装备时的明智之选。
englishValues: The understated colour scheme and precision-moulded armour plates make this armour a sensible choice for the Helldiver on the go.
simplifiedChineseValues: 精密铸造的护甲板加上低调的配色，这套护甲是绝地潜兵在配置行动装备时的明智之选。

records.english: An automated flamethrower turret. Warning: fuel canister prone to explosion when ruptured.
records.simplifiedChinese: 自动火焰喷射器炮台。警告：燃料罐破裂时易爆炸。
englishValues: An automated flamethrower turret. Warning: fuel canister prone to explosion when ruptured.
simplifiedChineseValues: 自动火焰喷射器炮台。警告：燃料罐破裂时易爆炸。

records.english: Made famous by the 'Truth Enforcers: Enforcers of Truth' mystery novels, this armour calls to mind those paragons of patriotism who protect us from treasonous lies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲因《真理执行者：真理的执行者》悬疑小说而闻名，让人想起那些保护我们免受叛国谎言蛊惑的爱国典范。
englishValues: Made famous by the 'Truth Enforcers: Enforcers of Truth' mystery novels, this armour calls to mind those paragons of patriotism who protect us from treasonous lies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲因《真理执行者：真理的执行者》悬疑小说而闻名，让人想起那些保护我们免受叛国谎言蛊惑的爱国典范。

records.english: A combination assault rifle/grenade launcher. Versatile, but heavy to wield.
records.simplifiedChinese: 突击步枪与榴弹发射器的组合武器。用途广泛，但比较像重型武器的操控手感。
englishValues: A combination assault rifle/grenade launcher. Versatile, but heavy to wield.
simplifiedChineseValues: 突击步枪与榴弹发射器的组合武器。用途广泛，但比较像重型武器的操控手感。

records.english: Markers placed on the map will generate radar scans every <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
records.simplifiedChinese: 地图上的标记每隔<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>进行一次雷达扫描。
englishValues: Markers placed on the map will generate radar scans every <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
simplifiedChineseValues: 地图上的标记每隔<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>进行一次雷达扫描。

records.english: A very powerful but difficult-to-wield machine gun with intense recoil.
records.simplifiedChinese: 火力凶猛的机枪，但后坐力强，较难操控。
englishValues: A very powerful but difficult-to-wield machine gun with intense recoil.
simplifiedChineseValues: 火力凶猛的机枪，但后坐力强，较难操控。

records.english: A single-use weapon specialised for damaging vehicle armour targets. Discarded after every use.
records.simplifiedChinese: 专门破坏载具装甲的一次性武器。用后即弃。
englishValues: A single-use weapon specialised for damaging vehicle armour targets. Discarded after every use.
simplifiedChineseValues: 专门破坏载具装甲的一次性武器。用后即弃。

records.english: The cape's shredded hem presages the unrelenting savagery its wielder will visit upon the nemeses of Freedom.
records.simplifiedChinese: 此披风的碎边预示着穿戴者将对自由死敌发动无情蛮攻。
englishValues: The cape's shredded hem presages the unrelenting savagery its wielder will visit upon the nemeses of Freedom.
simplifiedChineseValues: 此披风的碎边预示着穿戴者将对自由死敌发动无情蛮攻。

records.english: A variation on the reflex sight.
englishValues: A variation on the reflex sight.

records.english: The crest on this armour's shoulder shows friendlies that safety is near, and foes that they have reached the end of the road.
records.simplifiedChinese: 盔甲肩部的徽章向友军传递安全已近在咫尺的信息，同时向敌人宣告它们已走投无路。
englishValues: The crest on this armour's shoulder shows friendlies that safety is near, and foes that they have reached the end of the road.
simplifiedChineseValues: 盔甲肩部的徽章向友军传递安全已近在咫尺的信息，同时向敌人宣告它们已走投无路。

records.english: This armour, coated in radar-absorbent polymers and a null-signature heat baffle, reportedly turns its wearer into a sensor ghost—a claim attributed to individuals who, curiously, appear to have never existed.
records.simplifiedChinese: 盔甲的外层是雷达吸波聚合物和匿迹热隔板，据称能让穿戴者变成传感器探测不到的幽灵，有趣的是，如此声称的人似乎从未存在过。
englishValues: This armour, coated in radar-absorbent polymers and a null-signature heat baffle, reportedly turns its wearer into a sensor ghost—a claim attributed to individuals who, curiously, appear to have never existed.
simplifiedChineseValues: 盔甲的外层是雷达吸波聚合物和匿迹热隔板，据称能让穿戴者变成传感器探测不到的幽灵，有趣的是，如此声称的人似乎从未存在过。

records.english: A projectile which releases a cloud of caustic gas, blinding and slowing most enemies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 释放腐蚀性气团的射弹，可使大多数敌人致盲并减速。
englishValues: A projectile which releases a cloud of caustic gas, blinding and slowing most enemies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 释放腐蚀性气团的射弹，可使大多数敌人致盲并减速。

records.english: A camo paint job for use in desert environments.
records.simplifiedChinese: 适用于沙漠环境的迷彩涂装。
englishValues: A camo paint job for use in desert environments.
simplifiedChineseValues: 适用于沙漠环境的迷彩涂装。

records.english: The CW-22 Kodiak armour was thoroughly pressure-tested by patriotic volunteers, as part of the 'Test Subjects for Super-Earth' Citizen Advancement Programme.
records.simplifiedChinese: 该“科迪亚克”盔甲作为“超级地球测试对象”公民进步计划的一部分，其经过了爱国志愿者全面的压力测试。
englishValues: The CW-22 Kodiak armour was thoroughly pressure-tested by patriotic volunteers, as part of the 'Test Subjects for Super-Earth' Citizen Advancement Programme.
simplifiedChineseValues: 该“科迪亚克”盔甲作为“超级地球测试对象”公民进步计划的一部分，其经过了爱国志愿者全面的压力测试。

records.english: The pattern used for this armour is the result of the Winter Camouflage Improvement Effort, which considered 136 entrants before determining the colour white would best blend in with snow.
records.simplifiedChinese: 此盔甲的图案是冬季迷彩优化工作的成果。在综合考虑136位参与者的提案后，最终决定白色与雪地的融合度最高。
englishValues: The pattern used for this armour is the result of the Winter Camouflage Improvement Effort, which considered 136 entrants before determining the colour white would best blend in with snow.
simplifiedChineseValues: 此盔甲的图案是冬季迷彩优化工作的成果。在综合考虑136位参与者的提案后，最终决定白色与雪地的融合度最高。

records.english: With its rustic charm and huntsmanlike detailing, this armour evokes those heroic expansionists who braved the alien wilds and ushered in our current age of bio-uniformity.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲充满猎装细节，质朴的风格另有一番魅力，唤起人们对英雄开拓者的敬意，正是前辈勇闯异星荒野，引领我们迈入当今的生物统一时代。
englishValues: With its rustic charm and huntsmanlike detailing, this armour evokes those heroic expansionists who braved the alien wilds and ushered in our current age of bio-uniformity.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲充满猎装细节，质朴的风格另有一番魅力，唤起人们对英雄开拓者的敬意，正是前辈勇闯异星荒野，引领我们迈入当今的生物统一时代。

records.english: By reminding Chemical Agents of proper distancing rules, this extraordinary innovation in cape design ensures that they never cause another unfortunate outbreak of Carcino-Plague.
records.simplifiedChinese: 提醒化学专家保持适当距离的创新披肩设计可确保他们不会再引发卡西诺瘟疫灾难。
englishValues: By reminding Chemical Agents of proper distancing rules, this extraordinary innovation in cape design ensures that they never cause another unfortunate outbreak of Carcino-Plague.
simplifiedChineseValues: 提醒化学专家保持适当距离的创新披肩设计可确保他们不会再引发卡西诺瘟疫灾难。

records.english: The signature orange pauldron allows easy battlefield detection of the bearer, alive or dead, on ash-strewn battlefields.
records.simplifiedChinese: 橘黄色护肩非常醒目，哪怕在遍布灰烬的战场上也能让你轻易找到穿戴者，无论他们是生是死。
englishValues: The signature orange pauldron allows easy battlefield detection of the bearer, alive or dead, on ash-strewn battlefields.
simplifiedChineseValues: 橘黄色护肩非常醒目，哪怕在遍布灰烬的战场上也能让你轻易找到穿戴者，无论他们是生是死。

records.english: Armour befitting infiltrators of all calibre. Inspired by mythical Democracy-dispensers, whose meticulously undocumented operations remain an inspiration to all students of stealth.
records.simplifiedChinese: 此盔甲适合水平各异的渗透人员。以传说中的民主精神传播者为灵感设计，他们不留痕迹的缜密行动至今仍激励着所有潜行术学员。
englishValues: Armour befitting infiltrators of all calibre. Inspired by mythical Democracy-dispensers, whose meticulously undocumented operations remain an inspiration to all students of stealth.
simplifiedChineseValues: 此盔甲适合水平各异的渗透人员。以传说中的民主精神传播者为灵感设计，他们不留痕迹的缜密行动至今仍激励着所有潜行术学员。

records.english: A reliable assault rifle with an antique iron sight, firing incendiary ammunition.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可靠的突击步枪，配备老式机械瞄具，可发射燃烧弹药。
englishValues: A reliable assault rifle with an antique iron sight, firing incendiary ammunition.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可靠的突击步枪，配备老式机械瞄具，可发射燃烧弹药。

records.english: "The ground is just another obstacle that hasn't yet been cleared." - SGM Janet Jones, Excavation Corps Founder.
records.simplifiedChinese: “大地不过是另一道有待清除的阻碍。”——上士珍妮特·琼斯，挖掘部队创始人。
englishValues: "The ground is just another obstacle that hasn't yet been cleared." - SGM Janet Jones, Excavation Corps Founder.
simplifiedChineseValues: “大地不过是另一道有待清除的阻碍。”——上士珍妮特·琼斯，挖掘部队创始人。

records.english: The patented fabric absorbs visible, infrared, and ultraviolet radiation, to prevent detection by all known species.
records.simplifiedChinese: 享有专利的纤维材料可吸收可见光、红外线和紫外线辐射，躲过所有已知物种的侦测。
englishValues: The patented fabric absorbs visible, infrared, and ultraviolet radiation, to prevent detection by all known species.
simplifiedChineseValues: 享有专利的纤维材料可吸收可见光、红外线和紫外线辐射，躲过所有已知物种的侦测。

records.english: This armour, together with its friendly-faced helmet, is instantly recognisable from the beloved children's show 'Jen Shriver the Science Diver'.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲配套看似友好的头盔，一眼就能辨别灵感源自深受孩童喜爱的节目“科研潜兵珍·施莱佛 ”。
englishValues: This armour, together with its friendly-faced helmet, is instantly recognisable from the beloved children's show 'Jen Shriver the Science Diver'.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲配套看似友好的头盔，一眼就能辨别灵感源自深受孩童喜爱的节目“科研潜兵珍·施莱佛 ”。

records.english: A humane, autonomous drone equipped with a modified Arc Thrower. Capable of projecting arcs of lightning through multiple targets. Does not need to recharge between shots.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备改良版电弧发射器的人道主义自主无人机。能够向多个目标发射电弧闪电。每次射击前无需充能。
englishValues: A humane, autonomous drone equipped with a modified Arc Thrower. Capable of projecting arcs of lightning through multiple targets. Does not need to recharge between shots.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备改良版电弧发射器的人道主义自主无人机。能够向多个目标发射电弧闪电。每次射击前无需充能。

records.english: With sharp geometric angles to symbolise the rigid chain of command, this cape embodies the sanctity and moral fortitude of unblemished leadership over the mud-caked warriors they direct.
records.simplifiedChinese: 用锐利的几何棱角象征严苛的指挥链，这件披风体现了完美无瑕的将领在统御满身泥泞的战士时，所闪耀的神圣光辉与道德毅力。
englishValues: With sharp geometric angles to symbolise the rigid chain of command, this cape embodies the sanctity and moral fortitude of unblemished leadership over the mud-caked warriors they direct.
simplifiedChineseValues: 用锐利的几何棱角象征严苛的指挥链，这件披风体现了完美无瑕的将领在统御满身泥泞的战士时，所闪耀的神圣光辉与道德毅力。

records.english: The SEAF standard assault rifle, balancing power, fire rate, and weight for a reliable weapon against smaller targets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球武装部队的制式突击步枪，火力、射速和重量各方面均较为平衡，是对付小型目标的可靠武器。
englishValues: The SEAF standard assault rifle, balancing power, fire rate, and weight for a reliable weapon against smaller targets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球武装部队的制式突击步枪，火力、射速和重量各方面均较为平衡，是对付小型目标的可靠武器。

records.english: Gifted to Helldivers whose civilian lives were distinguished by exemplary citizenship, patriotism, and service to the Federation.
records.simplifiedChinese: 授予具有爱国、效忠联邦等优秀品质、为平民竖立楷模的模范公民绝地潜兵。
englishValues: Gifted to Helldivers whose civilian lives were distinguished by exemplary citizenship, patriotism, and service to the Federation.
simplifiedChineseValues: 授予具有爱国、效忠联邦等优秀品质、为平民竖立楷模的模范公民绝地潜兵。

records.english: A thermite grenade designed to adhere to surfaces before burning at 2000°C. Capable of burning through some armour.
records.simplifiedChinese: 铝热榴弹，经过专门设计，可附着于表面，燃烧温度高达2000°C，能烧穿部分装甲。
englishValues: A thermite grenade designed to adhere to surfaces before burning at 2000°C. Capable of burning through some armour.
simplifiedChineseValues: 铝热榴弹，经过专门设计，可附着于表面，燃烧温度高达2000°C，能烧穿部分装甲。

records.english: A backpack-mounted Hellbomb that can be armed by the wearer or an ally, starting a countdown. Users are recommended to remove the backpack before the countdown reaches zero.
records.simplifiedChinese: 背包式地狱火炸弹，穿戴者或盟友激活后将开启倒计时。建议在倒计时归零前移除背包。
englishValues: A backpack-mounted Hellbomb that can be armed by the wearer or an ally, starting a countdown. Users are recommended to remove the backpack before the countdown reaches zero.
simplifiedChineseValues: 背包式地狱火炸弹，穿戴者或盟友激活后将开启倒计时。建议在倒计时归零前移除背包。

records.simplifiedChinese: 治疗剂效果持续时间延长<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。
simplifiedChineseValues: 治疗剂效果持续时间延长<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。

records.english: Equipped with the latest computational systems, subsystems, and supersystems, this armour is worth the equivalent of a small Megacity.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲配备最新的计算系统、子系统和超级系统，价值相当于一座小型特大城市。
englishValues: Equipped with the latest computational systems, subsystems, and supersystems, this armour is worth the equivalent of a small Megacity.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲配备最新的计算系统、子系统和超级系统，价值相当于一座小型特大城市。

records.english: A barrage of bombs creating a non-targeted carpet of explosions.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发动无目标地毯式轰炸的炸弹火力网。
englishValues: A barrage of bombs creating a non-targeted carpet of explosions.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发动无目标地毯式轰炸的炸弹火力网。

records.english: Prevents <c=#COLOR>all damage from bleeding</c> if chest haemorrhages.
records.simplifiedChinese: 如果胸腔出血，则避免<c=#COLOR>其他所有来自出血的伤害</c>。
englishValues: Prevents <c=#COLOR>all damage from bleeding</c> if chest haemorrhages.
simplifiedChineseValues: 如果胸腔出血，则避免<c=#COLOR>其他所有来自出血的伤害</c>。

records.english: A manned gun emplacement offering superior firepower against lightly armoured targets. Slow to turn, so place it wisely.
records.simplifiedChinese: 手动炮台，强悍的火力能有效对付轻型装甲目标。转向速度较慢，请明智选择部署位置。
englishValues: A manned gun emplacement offering superior firepower against lightly armoured targets. Slow to turn, so place it wisely.
simplifiedChineseValues: 手动炮台，强悍的火力能有效对付轻型装甲目标。转向速度较慢，请明智选择部署位置。

records.english: Fires a ballistic dart at near-supersonic speeds, allowing the user to stim allies from a distance. Might sting.
records.simplifiedChinese: 以接近超音速的速度发射飞镖，可远程救治盟友。被射中时可能会感到刺痛。
englishValues: Fires a ballistic dart at near-supersonic speeds, allowing the user to stim allies from a distance. Might sting.
simplifiedChineseValues: 以接近超音速的速度发射飞镖，可远程救治盟友。被射中时可能会感到刺痛。

records.english: The standard heatsink for laser rifles.
records.simplifiedChinese: 激光步枪的标准散热器。
englishValues: The standard heatsink for laser rifles.
simplifiedChineseValues: 激光步枪的标准散热器。

records.english: Featuring patented reverse-seam technology, to reduce the likelihood of bodily fluids entering the armour's interior.
records.simplifiedChinese: 运用专利反向缝合技术，减少体液进入盔甲内部的可能性。
englishValues: Featuring patented reverse-seam technology, to reduce the likelihood of bodily fluids entering the armour's interior.
simplifiedChineseValues: 运用专利反向缝合技术，减少体液进入盔甲内部的可能性。

records.english: Wearer makes <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> less noise when moving.
records.simplifiedChinese: 穿戴者移动时产生的噪音减少<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。
englishValues: Wearer makes <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> less noise when moving.
simplifiedChineseValues: 穿戴者移动时产生的噪音减少<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。

records.english: Made famous by the SEAF commander of the same name, this seal reminds us that only perfect Unity can ensure perfect Freedom.
records.simplifiedChinese: 此印因同名的超级地球武装部队指挥官而闻名，时刻提醒着我们，唯有绝对的团结，方能确保绝对的自由。
englishValues: Made famous by the SEAF commander of the same name, this seal reminds us that only perfect Unity can ensure perfect Freedom.
simplifiedChineseValues: 此印因同名的超级地球武装部队指挥官而闻名，时刻提醒着我们，唯有绝对的团结，方能确保绝对的自由。

records.english: A linear artillery barrage which moves at intervals, driving the enemy out from cover while allowing an advance.
records.simplifiedChinese: 间歇性移动的线形火力网，可将敌人逐离掩体，同时让我方前进。
englishValues: A linear artillery barrage which moves at intervals, driving the enemy out from cover while allowing an advance.
simplifiedChineseValues: 间歇性移动的线形火力网，可将敌人逐离掩体，同时让我方前进。

records.english: All Hail the Helldivers, whose resplendent honour makes Tyrants tremble.
records.simplifiedChinese: 向绝地潜兵致敬，他们的荣耀光辉令暴政颤栗。
englishValues: All Hail the Helldivers, whose resplendent honour makes Tyrants tremble.
simplifiedChineseValues: 向绝地潜兵致敬，他们的荣耀光辉令暴政颤栗。

records.english: The omission of upper-limb coverings allows for optimised freedom of movement, perspiration, and communication of upper body strength to squadmates.
records.simplifiedChinese: 省去覆盖上肢的布料，自由行动的空间、排汗，以及与队友之间的上肢力量交流都将得到优化。
englishValues: The omission of upper-limb coverings allows for optimised freedom of movement, perspiration, and communication of upper body strength to squadmates.
simplifiedChineseValues: 省去覆盖上肢的布料，自由行动的空间、排汗，以及与队友之间的上肢力量交流都将得到优化。

records.english: All Hail the Helldivers, who bring untold abundance to Super Earth's citizens.
records.simplifiedChinese: 向绝地潜兵致敬，正是他们为超级地球公民带来了无尽的财富。
englishValues: All Hail the Helldivers, who bring untold abundance to Super Earth's citizens.
simplifiedChineseValues: 向绝地潜兵致敬，正是他们为超级地球公民带来了无尽的财富。

records.english: A subdued cape, for those who need no recognition—save that of their enemies, as their executioner.
records.simplifiedChinese: 为不愿被认出的战士而设计的低调披肩。但敌人一眼就能认出，因为披肩的出现，代表他们死期已到。
englishValues: A subdued cape, for those who need no recognition—save that of their enemies, as their executioner.
simplifiedChineseValues: 为不愿被认出的战士而设计的低调披肩。但敌人一眼就能认出，因为披肩的出现，代表他们死期已到。

records.english:
Often showcased in the 'Obedient Democracy Support Troopers' cartoon, this assault rifle comes with a convenient ammo counter and compass.
Produced by Martian Armoury.
records.simplifiedChinese:
这款突击步枪经常在《民主光环驰援部队》卡通片中出现，配备了便捷的弹药计数器和指南针。
由火星军械库生产。
englishValues:
Often showcased in the 'Obedient Democracy Support Troopers' cartoon, this assault rifle comes with a convenient ammo counter and compass.
Produced by Martian Armoury.
simplifiedChineseValues:
这款突击步枪经常在《民主光环驰援部队》卡通片中出现，配备了便捷的弹药计数器和指南针。
由火星军械库生产。

records.english: This grenade delivery drone follows the user until it detects an enemy nearby, then flies toward it and explodes on impact. Has a limited battery life.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这款榴弹投掷无人机会紧跟使用者飞行，探测到附近敌人后飞向目标，撞击后引爆。电池续航时间有限。
englishValues: This grenade delivery drone follows the user until it detects an enemy nearby, then flies toward it and explodes on impact. Has a limited battery life.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这款榴弹投掷无人机会紧跟使用者飞行，探测到附近敌人后飞向目标，撞击后引爆。电池续航时间有限。

records.english: Based on a SEAF Signaller's Cape, which was intended to enable easy location of fallen heroes by aerial recovery crews.
records.simplifiedChinese: 设计原型是超级地球武装部队的披肩，目的是帮助空中救援小队轻松找到阵亡的英雄。
englishValues: Based on a SEAF Signaller's Cape, which was intended to enable easy location of fallen heroes by aerial recovery crews.
simplifiedChineseValues: 设计原型是超级地球武装部队的披肩，目的是帮助空中救援小队轻松找到阵亡的英雄。

records.simplifiedChinese: 单兵导弹发射井定位遥控器
simplifiedChineseValues: 单兵导弹发射井定位遥控器

records.english: With extra capacity for storing throwable munitions, this armour ensures every enemy stronghold can be tactically ventilated, as per forceful de-fortification protocols.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲具备收纳投掷弹药的额外空间，可确保对每个敌军据点以符合“强制去工事化协议”的方式进行“战术通风”。
englishValues: With extra capacity for storing throwable munitions, this armour ensures every enemy stronghold can be tactically ventilated, as per forceful de-fortification protocols.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲具备收纳投掷弹药的额外空间，可确保对每个敌军据点以符合“强制去工事化协议”的方式进行“战术通风”。

records.english: A symbol of fierce commitment to Liberty and Democracy, this cape celebrates the Helldivers who have held true to Super Earth values through rain or shine.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩象征着对自由和民主的坚定承诺，颂扬那些风雨无阻地坚守超级地球价值观的绝地潜兵。
englishValues: A symbol of fierce commitment to Liberty and Democracy, this cape celebrates the Helldivers who have held true to Super Earth values through rain or shine.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩象征着对自由和民主的坚定承诺，颂扬那些风雨无阻地坚守超级地球价值观的绝地潜兵。

records.english: A Hellpod containing four supply packs, to replenish personal ammunition and stims in the field.
records.simplifiedChinese: 装有四个补给背包的绝地喷射舱，可在战场上补充个人弹药和治疗剂储备。
englishValues: A Hellpod containing four supply packs, to replenish personal ammunition and stims in the field.
simplifiedChineseValues: 装有四个补给背包的绝地喷射舱，可在战场上补充个人弹药和治疗剂储备。

records.english: A melee weapon tipped with electrified prongs that temporarily stun targets. Can be wielded one-handed.
records.simplifiedChinese: 近战武器，矛头带电刺，可暂时眩晕目标。支持单手操作。
englishValues: A melee weapon tipped with electrified prongs that temporarily stun targets. Can be wielded one-handed.
simplifiedChineseValues: 近战武器，矛头带电刺，可暂时眩晕目标。支持单手操作。

records.english: A sight with thin features to maximise visibility of the target.
records.simplifiedChinese: 纤薄设计的瞄准镜，可最大限度地提升目标可见度。
englishValues: A sight with thin features to maximise visibility of the target.
simplifiedChineseValues: 纤薄设计的瞄准镜，可最大限度地提升目标可见度。

records.english: The featherlight construction belies the heavy burden this cape entails—to live the Creed of the True Citizen.
records.simplifiedChinese: 轻如鸿毛的结构掩盖了此披风的沉重意义：践行忠诚公民的信条。
englishValues: The featherlight construction belies the heavy burden this cape entails—to live the Creed of the True Citizen.
simplifiedChineseValues: 轻如鸿毛的结构掩盖了此披风的沉重意义：践行忠诚公民的信条。

records.english: The heavy rubber tunic and reflective limb guards, originally designed to save citizens from burning buildings, now enable the liberal application of the cleansing fires of Justice.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这厚重的橡胶外衣和反射隔热的肢体护具原本是用来在火场中营救公民的，如今则让穿戴者可以毫无顾忌地喷射正义的净化烈焰。
englishValues: The heavy rubber tunic and reflective limb guards, originally designed to save citizens from burning buildings, now enable the liberal application of the cleansing fires of Justice.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这厚重的橡胶外衣和反射隔热的肢体护具原本是用来在火场中营救公民的，如今则让穿戴者可以毫无顾忌地喷射正义的净化烈焰。

records.english: A modified Breaker shotgun firing birdshot, small pellets which saturate an area to clear up smaller targets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 改良后的“破裂者”霰弹枪，可发射鸟弹，分散的细小弹丸足以清除一定区域内的小型目标。
englishValues: A modified Breaker shotgun firing birdshot, small pellets which saturate an area to clear up smaller targets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 改良后的“破裂者”霰弹枪，可发射鸟弹，分散的细小弹丸足以清除一定区域内的小型目标。

records.english: A shovel that can be used as a melee weapon or, more conventionally, to dig holes in the ground.
records.simplifiedChinese: 铲子，除了能在地上挖洞，还可用作近战武器。
englishValues: A shovel that can be used as a melee weapon or, more conventionally, to dig holes in the ground.
simplifiedChineseValues: 铲子，除了能在地上挖洞，还可用作近战武器。

records.english: Modelled after the myriad Statues of Judicious Liberty, who keep a watchful eye on checkout lines, schoolyards, perpetual rehabilitation communities, and public confession theatres.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲的灵感来自不计其数的“公正自由女神像”，她们警惕地注视着收银台、学校操场、永久性矫正社区和公共忏悔剧场。
englishValues: Modelled after the myriad Statues of Judicious Liberty, who keep a watchful eye on checkout lines, schoolyards, perpetual rehabilitation communities, and public confession theatres.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲的灵感来自不计其数的“公正自由女神像”，她们警惕地注视着收银台、学校操场、永久性矫正社区和公共忏悔剧场。

records.english: When wearers stand shoulder to shoulder, this cape shows them as they truly are: an unbreakable defence, keeping Freedom safe behind an impregnable wall.
records.simplifiedChinese: 肩并肩穿戴披肩站立时，便会展现真实风采：化身坚不可摧的防线，将自由守护在固若金汤的墙后。
englishValues: When wearers stand shoulder to shoulder, this cape shows them as they truly are: an unbreakable defence, keeping Freedom safe behind an impregnable wall.
simplifiedChineseValues: 肩并肩穿戴披肩站立时，便会展现真实风采：化身坚不可摧的防线，将自由守护在固若金汤的墙后。

records.english: Allows the swift completion of Liberty's administrative tasks in an invigorating atmosphere.
records.simplifiedChinese: 在鼓舞人心的氛围下，快速完成解放伟业的行政工作。
englishValues: Allows the swift completion of Liberty's administrative tasks in an invigorating atmosphere.
simplifiedChineseValues: 在鼓舞人心的氛围下，快速完成解放伟业的行政工作。

records.english: Granted to the Truth Enforcers' Informant of the Month, this tasteful cape conjures images of dissident blood on asphalt.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件品味非凡的披肩属于真理执行者的“月度最佳告密者”，令人联想到沥青路面上异见分子的鲜血。
englishValues: Granted to the Truth Enforcers' Informant of the Month, this tasteful cape conjures images of dissident blood on asphalt.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件品味非凡的披肩属于真理执行者的“月度最佳告密者”，令人联想到沥青路面上异见分子的鲜血。

records.english: A throwable device engineered to bounce when hitting the ground, releasing bursts of electricity on each impact. Warning: may bounce unpredictably.
records.simplifiedChinese: 经过特殊设计的投掷设备，击中地面时会弹起，每次撞击都会释放电流。警告：弹跳方向可能难以预测。
englishValues: A throwable device engineered to bounce when hitting the ground, releasing bursts of electricity on each impact. Warning: may bounce unpredictably.
simplifiedChineseValues: 经过特殊设计的投掷设备，击中地面时会弹起，每次撞击都会释放电流。警告：弹跳方向可能难以预测。

records.english: Heavily insulated from animal bites, enemy fire, and the histrionic diatribes of anarchists.
records.simplifiedChinese: 对野兽啃咬、敌方火攻以及扰乱分子的嬉笑怒骂完全绝缘。
englishValues: Heavily insulated from animal bites, enemy fire, and the histrionic diatribes of anarchists.
simplifiedChineseValues: 对野兽啃咬、敌方火攻以及扰乱分子的嬉笑怒骂完全绝缘。

records.english: A prolonged barrage, wreaking extended destruction over a large area. Communication with teammates is advised.
records.simplifiedChinese: 持续输出火力网，可大面积范围造成破坏。使用前建议与队友进行通信。
englishValues: A prolonged barrage, wreaking extended destruction over a large area. Communication with teammates is advised.
simplifiedChineseValues: 持续输出火力网，可大面积范围造成破坏。使用前建议与队友进行通信。

records.english: An anti-tank homing missile which must lock onto its target before launch. Effective against large and armoured enemies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 反坦克追踪式导弹，发射前必须锁定目标。可有效对付大型装甲敌人。
englishValues: An anti-tank homing missile which must lock onto its target before launch. Effective against large and armoured enemies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 反坦克追踪式导弹，发射前必须锁定目标。可有效对付大型装甲敌人。

records.english: A barrage of smoke grenades, creating a thick smoke screen to block enemies' line of sight.
records.simplifiedChinese: 烟雾弹火力网，可形成一道厚重的烟幕，阻挡敌人的视线。
englishValues: A barrage of smoke grenades, creating a thick smoke screen to block enemies' line of sight.
simplifiedChineseValues: 烟雾弹火力网，可形成一道厚重的烟幕，阻挡敌人的视线。

records.english: A silo that fits one single, powerful missile. Comes with a handheld targeting remote.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射井可容纳一枚强力导弹。配备手持定位遥控器。
englishValues: A silo that fits one single, powerful missile. Comes with a handheld targeting remote.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射井可容纳一枚强力导弹。配备手持定位遥控器。

records.english: A symbol of the constant, forward-moving propulsive force of Managed Democracy. This cape honours those who understand that in the race for Freedom, there are no brakes—only degrees of momentum.
records.simplifiedChinese: 胜利矢量象征管理式民主恒定前进的驱动力。这件披肩向那些明白在自由竞赛中没有刹车、唯有动力强弱之分的人致敬。
englishValues: A symbol of the constant, forward-moving propulsive force of Managed Democracy. This cape honours those who understand that in the race for Freedom, there are no brakes—only degrees of momentum.
simplifiedChineseValues: 胜利矢量象征管理式民主恒定前进的驱动力。这件披肩向那些明白在自由竞赛中没有刹车、唯有动力强弱之分的人致敬。

records.english: Evoking legendary Helldiver Ronald Mambo on the eve of his untimely disappearance, the striking silhouette projects power, burliness, and strength.
records.simplifiedChinese: 极具冲击力的轮廓展现出力量、悍勇与威压，令人不禁想起意外失踪前夕的传奇绝地潜兵罗纳德·曼波。
englishValues: Evoking legendary Helldiver Ronald Mambo on the eve of his untimely disappearance, the striking silhouette projects power, burliness, and strength.
simplifiedChineseValues: 极具冲击力的轮廓展现出力量、悍勇与威压，令人不禁想起意外失踪前夕的传奇绝地潜兵罗纳德·曼波。

records.english: A laser rifle firing a continuous beam. Does not need reloading, but if it overheats a new heat sink must be fitted.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射连续激光束的激光步枪。无需重新装弹，但如果步枪过热，必须安装新的散热器。
englishValues: A laser rifle firing a continuous beam. Does not need reloading, but if it overheats a new heat sink must be fitted.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射连续激光束的激光步枪。无需重新装弹，但如果步枪过热，必须安装新的散热器。

records.english: Provides <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> resistance to gas damage and effects.
records.simplifiedChinese: 对毒气伤害和效果的抗性增加<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。
englishValues: Provides <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> resistance to gas damage and effects.
simplifiedChineseValues: 对毒气伤害和效果的抗性增加<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。

records.english: Streamlined for maximum velocity, this armour was inspired by long-distance couriers who prioritised the delivery of ballots over personal safety, exemplifying our patriotic bonds. Features reinforced joints to withstand the violent transitions between high-speed travel and abrupt, unplanned stops.
records.simplifiedChinese: 为追求极致速度，这套护甲采用流线型设计，其灵感源于将递送选票置于个人安全之上的长距离运送者，彰显我们的爱国纽带。其特点是对关节连接处进行了强化处理，可承受高速行驶与突发或计划外停靠之间的剧烈转换。
englishValues: Streamlined for maximum velocity, this armour was inspired by long-distance couriers who prioritised the delivery of ballots over personal safety, exemplifying our patriotic bonds. Features reinforced joints to withstand the violent transitions between high-speed travel and abrupt, unplanned stops.
simplifiedChineseValues: 为追求极致速度，这套护甲采用流线型设计，其灵感源于将递送选票置于个人安全之上的长距离运送者，彰显我们的爱国纽带。其特点是对关节连接处进行了强化处理，可承受高速行驶与突发或计划外停靠之间的剧烈转换。

records.english: Inspired by the trailblazing agents of the Super Earth Terraforming Company. These rugged adventurers surveyed hostile new planets during the post-GW1 Great Expansion era, preparing the untamed frontier for rapid and efficient assimilation.
records.simplifiedChinese: 设计灵感源自超级地球行星地球化公司的先驱者。在第一次星系战争后的大扩张时期，这些坚韧的冒险家勘测了许多充满敌意的新星球，为快速高效地同化未开发边境奠定基础。
englishValues: Inspired by the trailblazing agents of the Super Earth Terraforming Company. These rugged adventurers surveyed hostile new planets during the post-GW1 Great Expansion era, preparing the untamed frontier for rapid and efficient assimilation.
simplifiedChineseValues: 设计灵感源自超级地球行星地球化公司的先驱者。在第一次星系战争后的大扩张时期，这些坚韧的冒险家勘测了许多充满敌意的新星球，为快速高效地同化未开发边境奠定基础。

records.english: A mid-range precision rifle. Equipped with an integrated suppressor and subsonic rounds for barely-detectable operation.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这是一支中程精准步枪。配备集成式消音器和亚音速弹药，方便执行难以被察觉的行动。
englishValues: A mid-range precision rifle. Equipped with an integrated suppressor and subsonic rounds for barely-detectable operation.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这是一支中程精准步枪。配备集成式消音器和亚音速弹药，方便执行难以被察觉的行动。

records.english: This time-honoured shotgun-like weapon has been improved since the First Galactic War, and now fires six beams instead of three.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这款霰弹枪式经典武器自第一次星系战争以来历经改良，射出的激光束从三道增加到了六道。
englishValues: This time-honoured shotgun-like weapon has been improved since the First Galactic War, and now fires six beams instead of three.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这款霰弹枪式经典武器自第一次星系战争以来历经改良，射出的激光束从三道增加到了六道。

records.english: The standard scope for most weapons, provides a good and accurate scope picture.
records.simplifiedChinese: 适配多数武器的标准瞄准镜，提供清晰精准的瞄准视野。
englishValues: The standard scope for most weapons, provides a good and accurate scope picture.
simplifiedChineseValues: 适配多数武器的标准瞄准镜，提供清晰精准的瞄准视野。

records.english: With this cape we honour the bio-warfare pioneers of Division Zero, conscripted from quarantine zones and hospices to spread their Carcino-Plague on the battlefield.
records.simplifiedChinese: 我们设计这件披肩是为了向“零号”师的生物战先驱致敬。他们从隔离区和临终关怀医院应征入伍，在战场上传播他们携带的卡西诺瘟疫病毒。
englishValues: With this cape we honour the bio-warfare pioneers of Division Zero, conscripted from quarantine zones and hospices to spread their Carcino-Plague on the battlefield.
simplifiedChineseValues: 我们设计这件披肩是为了向“零号”师的生物战先驱致敬。他们从隔离区和临终关怀医院应征入伍，在战场上传播他们携带的卡西诺瘟疫病毒。

records.english: Those who serve Liberty from the shadows often elect to stay anonymous, moving like traceless spectres through the night. May they watch over us always.
records.simplifiedChinese: 那些在黑暗中为自由而战的人往往选择隐姓埋名，如同幽灵般穿行于夜色之中，不留一丝痕迹。愿他们永远守护着我们。
englishValues: Those who serve Liberty from the shadows often elect to stay anonymous, moving like traceless spectres through the night. May they watch over us always.
simplifiedChineseValues: 那些在黑暗中为自由而战的人往往选择隐姓埋名，如同幽灵般穿行于夜色之中，不留一丝痕迹。愿他们永远守护着我们。

records.english: A plasma rifle that fires bolts of superheated gas, which can be charged by holding down the trigger. Charging up a shot fully makes the bolt explode on impact.
records.simplifiedChinese: 等离子步枪，可发射过热气体，按住扳机即可为其充能。每发射击完全充能后，触及着弹点后引爆。
englishValues: A plasma rifle that fires bolts of superheated gas, which can be charged by holding down the trigger. Charging up a shot fully makes the bolt explode on impact.
simplifiedChineseValues: 等离子步枪，可发射过热气体，按住扳机即可为其充能。每发射击完全充能后，触及着弹点后引爆。

records.english: A pistol firing guided, jet-propelled ammunition. It's lock-on feature ensures high accuracy, but the weapon must be reloaded after every round fired.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一款发射喷气推进式制导弹药的手枪。具备锁定功能，可确保高射击精度，但每次开火后均须重新装填弹药。
englishValues: A pistol firing guided, jet-propelled ammunition. It's lock-on feature ensures high accuracy, but the weapon must be reloaded after every round fired.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一款发射喷气推进式制导弹药的手枪。具备锁定功能，可确保高射击精度，但每次开火后均须重新装填弹药。

records.english: Fires a rocket that detonates within proximity of a target, and deploys a cluster of explosive bomblets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射火箭弹，在目标附近引爆，并部署一组小型爆弹。
englishValues: Fires a rocket that detonates within proximity of a target, and deploys a cluster of explosive bomblets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射火箭弹，在目标附近引爆，并部署一组小型爆弹。

records.english: This armour recalls the legendary heroes who scared a ravenous Hive Lord away from a colony village, using only the village's battery of patriotic fireworks.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲纪念的是那些传奇英雄，他们仅凭村里的一批爱国烟花，就吓退了一只贪婪的霸王虫，拯救了拓殖地的村落。
englishValues: This armour recalls the legendary heroes who scared a ravenous Hive Lord away from a colony village, using only the village's battery of patriotic fireworks.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲纪念的是那些传奇英雄，他们仅凭村里的一批爱国烟花，就吓退了一只贪婪的霸王虫，拯救了拓殖地的村落。

records.english: A silenced assault rifle with a built-in suppressor, which won't alert distant targets to the user's position.
records.simplifiedChinese: 内置抑制器的消音突击步枪，可避免向远处的目标暴露使用者的位置。
englishValues: A silenced assault rifle with a built-in suppressor, which won't alert distant targets to the user's position.
simplifiedChineseValues: 内置抑制器的消音突击步枪，可避免向远处的目标暴露使用者的位置。

records.english: The gas-operated, semiautomatic P-113 chambers the 14mm 'Rapid Deliberation', the largest centrefire cartridge of any magazine-fed pistol.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这支半自动P-113型气动式手枪采用14毫米的“速决”子弹，这是弹匣式手枪中最大的中心底火子弹。
englishValues: The gas-operated, semiautomatic P-113 chambers the 14mm 'Rapid Deliberation', the largest centrefire cartridge of any magazine-fed pistol.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这支半自动P-113型气动式手枪采用14毫米的“速决”子弹，这是弹匣式手枪中最大的中心底火子弹。

records.english: Contains a grain of sand from Super Earth — so its bearers carry a small piece of Liberty with them, wherever they go.
records.simplifiedChinese: 载有一粒来自超级地球的沙子，让不论穿戴者身在何处，心中都承载着自由。
englishValues: Contains a grain of sand from Super Earth — so its bearers carry a small piece of Liberty with them, wherever they go.
simplifiedChineseValues: 载有一粒来自超级地球的沙子，让不论穿戴者身在何处，心中都承载着自由。

records.english: Encloses the wearer in a spherical shield which blocks high-speed projectiles.
records.simplifiedChinese: 以球状护盾包裹佩戴者，抵挡高速射弹。
englishValues: Encloses the wearer in a spherical shield which blocks high-speed projectiles.
simplifiedChineseValues: 以球状护盾包裹佩戴者，抵挡高速射弹。

records.english: This armour is the required uniform for many Super Earth Citizens operating heavy machinery. Long-time users will be delighted to learn that as of this year's Efficiency in Machine Operation Symposium and Gala, wearing this armour is no longer itself considered operating heavy machinery.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲是许多操作重型机械的超级地球公民的必备制服。从本年度“机械操作效能研讨会暨晚宴”举办之日起，穿戴这套盔甲将不再被视为操作重型机械，这对于长期穿着者而言无疑是个好消息。
englishValues: This armour is the required uniform for many Super Earth Citizens operating heavy machinery. Long-time users will be delighted to learn that as of this year's Efficiency in Machine Operation Symposium and Gala, wearing this armour is no longer itself considered operating heavy machinery.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲是许多操作重型机械的超级地球公民的必备制服。从本年度“机械操作效能研讨会暨晚宴”举办之日起，穿戴这套盔甲将不再被视为操作重型机械，这对于长期穿着者而言无疑是个好消息。

records.english: A basic iron sight for Helldivers who want to relive the glorious struggles of their ancestors.
records.simplifiedChinese: 基础机械瞄具，适合希望重温先辈辉煌奋斗历程的绝地潜兵。
englishValues: A basic iron sight for Helldivers who want to relive the glorious struggles of their ancestors.
simplifiedChineseValues: 基础机械瞄具，适合希望重温先辈辉煌奋斗历程的绝地潜兵。

records.english: Featuring a high collar scientifically designed to deflect mud, blood, and indirect non-lethal projectiles, this pristine armour bestows the authority to overcome close-quarters combat through a time-honoured tradition: the delegation—or court-martialling—of subordinates.
records.simplifiedChinese: 采用科学实用的高领设计，可弹开泥浆、血污以及间接袭来的非致命投射物。这套一尘不染的盔甲赋予使用者在应对近战时实践久经验证传统的权威：委派下属充当肉盾（亦或将其军法处置）。
englishValues: Featuring a high collar scientifically designed to deflect mud, blood, and indirect non-lethal projectiles, this pristine armour bestows the authority to overcome close-quarters combat through a time-honoured tradition: the delegation—or court-martialling—of subordinates.
simplifiedChineseValues: 采用科学实用的高领设计，可弹开泥浆、血污以及间接袭来的非致命投射物。这套一尘不染的盔甲赋予使用者在应对近战时实践久经验证传统的权威：委派下属充当肉盾（亦或将其军法处置）。

records.english: A triple-barrelled, break-action, sawed-off shotgun. Switch firing modes to fire all three barrels at once.
records.simplifiedChinese: 三枪管中折式截短霰弹枪。可将开火模式切换为同时使用三枪管开火。
englishValues: A triple-barrelled, break-action, sawed-off shotgun. Switch firing modes to fire all three barrels at once.
simplifiedChineseValues: 三枪管中折式截短霰弹枪。可将开火模式切换为同时使用三枪管开火。

records.english: A half-constricted muzzle that forces the shotgun pellets together into a somewhat tighter group.
records.simplifiedChinese: 半收束枪口，迫使霰弹较密集地发射。
englishValues: A half-constricted muzzle that forces the shotgun pellets together into a somewhat tighter group.
simplifiedChineseValues: 半收束枪口，迫使霰弹较密集地发射。

records.english: Gently stonewashed by experienced hands, this luxury cape exudes the essence of state-approved attitude.
records.simplifiedChinese: 由资深工匠精心水洗做旧，这款奢华披肩散发着经国家认证的气质精髓。
englishValues: Gently stonewashed by experienced hands, this luxury cape exudes the essence of state-approved attitude.
simplifiedChineseValues: 由资深工匠精心水洗做旧，这款奢华披肩散发着经国家认证的气质精髓。

records.english: Modelled after the Statue of Mournful Liberty, who weeps over the existence of tyranny, this armour is worn by those who would give their lives to dry her tears.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲的灵感来自因暴政肆虐而哭泣的“哀恸自由女神像”，穿戴者愿以生命拂去自由女神的眼泪。
englishValues: Modelled after the Statue of Mournful Liberty, who weeps over the existence of tyranny, this armour is worn by those who would give their lives to dry her tears.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲的灵感来自因暴政肆虐而哭泣的“哀恸自由女神像”，穿戴者愿以生命拂去自由女神的眼泪。

records.english: Woven from coarse, industrial fibres designed to absorb sweat and oil, this cape features a spade emblem to honour Super Earth's groundbreakers, who ensure Liberty’s light finds its way through any planet’s crust.
records.simplifiedChinese: 采用粗糙的工业纤维织就，旨在吸收汗水与油污。这款披风饰有铁锹纹章，致敬为超级地球“破土奠基”的先辈们——感谢他们确保自由之光能穿透任何星球的地壳。
englishValues: Woven from coarse, industrial fibres designed to absorb sweat and oil, this cape features a spade emblem to honour Super Earth's groundbreakers, who ensure Liberty’s light finds its way through any planet’s crust.
simplifiedChineseValues: 采用粗糙的工业纤维织就，旨在吸收汗水与油污。这款披风饰有铁锹纹章，致敬为超级地球“破土奠基”的先辈们——感谢他们确保自由之光能穿透任何星球的地壳。

records.english: No dissident or alien, no creature big or small, can ever hope to stand against the furious stampede of Managed Democracy.
records.simplifiedChinese: 无论是异见分子还是外星敌人，无论生物体型大小，都休想抵挡管理式民主狂怒奔涌的热潮。
englishValues: No dissident or alien, no creature big or small, can ever hope to stand against the furious stampede of Managed Democracy.
simplifiedChineseValues: 无论是异见分子还是外星敌人，无论生物体型大小，都休想抵挡管理式民主狂怒奔涌的热潮。

records.english: Marks the most Free of the Free, those who will seize tyranny by the neck and squeeze until no oppression remains.
records.simplifiedChinese: 最自由者的印记，他们必将扼住暴政咽喉，碾尽世间一切压迫。
englishValues: Marks the most Free of the Free, those who will seize tyranny by the neck and squeeze until no oppression remains.
simplifiedChineseValues: 最自由者的印记，他们必将扼住暴政咽喉，碾尽世间一切压迫。

records.simplifiedChinese: 增加架设型轻机枪弹匣
simplifiedChineseValues: 增加架设型轻机枪弹匣

records.simplifiedChinese: 弹链式榴弹发射器背包
simplifiedChineseValues: 弹链式榴弹发射器背包

records.english: A lightweight melee weapon that temporarily stuns enemies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 轻型近战武器，可暂时眩晕敌人。
englishValues: A lightweight melee weapon that temporarily stuns enemies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 轻型近战武器，可暂时眩晕敌人。

records.english: A Hellpod containing four supply packs, to replenish personal ammunition and stims in the field.
records.simplifiedChinese: 装有四个补给背包的绝地喷射舱，可在战场上补充个人弹药和治疗剂储备。
englishValues: A Hellpod containing four supply packs, to replenish personal ammunition and stims in the field.
simplifiedChineseValues: 装有四个补给背包的绝地喷射舱，可在战场上补充个人弹药和治疗剂储备。

records.english: Spattered gore marks those heroes who braved the harrowing first days of the war for Managed Democracy.
records.simplifiedChinese: 飞溅的血迹代表着那些为实现管理式民主而在早年战争中英勇奋战的英雄。
englishValues: Spattered gore marks those heroes who braved the harrowing first days of the war for Managed Democracy.
simplifiedChineseValues: 飞溅的血迹代表着那些为实现管理式民主而在早年战争中英勇奋战的英雄。

records.english: Since ancient times, the yellow line has symbolised an uncrossable boundary. To don this cape is to draw that line between tyranny and liberty, between alien monstrosities and Super Earth property, and never yield the right of way.
records.simplifiedChinese: 自古以来，黄线就象征着不可逾越的边界。穿上这件披肩，意味着在暴政与解放、外星怪物与超级地球财产之间划清界线，并发誓绝不退让。
englishValues: Since ancient times, the yellow line has symbolised an uncrossable boundary. To don this cape is to draw that line between tyranny and liberty, between alien monstrosities and Super Earth property, and never yield the right of way.
simplifiedChineseValues: 自古以来，黄线就象征着不可逾越的边界。穿上这件披肩，意味着在暴政与解放、外星怪物与超级地球财产之间划清界线，并发誓绝不退让。

records.english: All but ensures ascension to the immortal ranks of those enshrined in the Super Earth Digital Archive of Valorous Acts.
records.simplifiedChinese: 必将收录至超级地球英勇之举数字档案，比肩珍藏其中的不朽藏品。
englishValues: All but ensures ascension to the immortal ranks of those enshrined in the Super Earth Digital Archive of Valorous Acts.
simplifiedChineseValues: 必将收录至超级地球英勇之举数字档案，比肩珍藏其中的不朽藏品。

records.english: The set's classic advertising campaign "Have you tried a grenade?" has remained unchanged for over 70 years.
records.simplifiedChinese: 70多年以来，本套装的广告词一直都是：“试过手雷了吗？”
englishValues: The set's classic advertising campaign "Have you tried a grenade?" has remained unchanged for over 70 years.
simplifiedChineseValues: 70多年以来，本套装的广告词一直都是：“试过手雷了吗？”

records.english: 0.05% of profits are donated to Superstone National Park, as part of the Ministry of Unity's 'Greener Galaxy' campaign.
records.simplifiedChinese: 为支持团结部的“更绿星系”活动，0.05%的利润将捐赠给超石国家公园。
englishValues: 0.05% of profits are donated to Superstone National Park, as part of the Ministry of Unity's 'Greener Galaxy' campaign.
simplifiedChineseValues: 为支持团结部的“更绿星系”活动，0.05%的利润将捐赠给超石国家公园。

records.english: Though originally intended solely for ceremonial use, its inspirational energy proved equally useful on the battlefield.
records.simplifiedChinese: 设计初衷是用于仪式，但事实证明，它鼓舞人心的力量在战场上同样奏效。
englishValues: Though originally intended solely for ceremonial use, its inspirational energy proved equally useful on the battlefield.
simplifiedChineseValues: 设计初衷是用于仪式，但事实证明，它鼓舞人心的力量在战场上同样奏效。

records.english: A speargun firing heavy-duty projectiles. These projectiles release a cloud of gas on impact, and must be carefully loaded one at a time.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一种发射重型短矛的矛枪。这些短矛在命中时会释放一团气体，装填时必须小心操作，每次装一枚。
englishValues: A speargun firing heavy-duty projectiles. These projectiles release a cloud of gas on impact, and must be carefully loaded one at a time.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一种发射重型短矛的矛枪。这些短矛在命中时会释放一团气体，装填时必须小心操作，每次装一枚。

records.english: Reduces damage taken from impact and collisions by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
records.simplifiedChinese: 将撞击和碰撞造成的伤害降低<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。
englishValues: Reduces damage taken from impact and collisions by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
simplifiedChineseValues: 将撞击和碰撞造成的伤害降低<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。

records.english: Woven in honour of our loyal Helldivers, whose commitment to Democracy, through rain or shine, is an inspiration to all.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩旨在纪念忠诚的绝地潜兵，他们风雨无阻地坚守对民主的承诺，激励着所有人。
englishValues: Woven in honour of our loyal Helldivers, whose commitment to Democracy, through rain or shine, is an inspiration to all.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩旨在纪念忠诚的绝地潜兵，他们风雨无阻地坚守对民主的承诺，激励着所有人。

records.english: A constricted muzzle that forces the shotgun pellets together into a tighter group.
records.simplifiedChinese: 收束枪口，迫使霰弹十分密集地发射。
englishValues: A constricted muzzle that forces the shotgun pellets together into a tighter group.
simplifiedChineseValues: 收束枪口，迫使霰弹十分密集地发射。

records.english: A heatsink with thinner cooling elements, improving cooling rate.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备更薄冷却元件的散热器，降温速率更快。
englishValues: A heatsink with thinner cooling elements, improving cooling rate.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备更薄冷却元件的散热器，降温速率更快。

records.english: A fully-automatic pistol with an extremely high fire rate, allowing for efficient crowd control.
records.simplifiedChinese: 射速极高的全自动手枪，可以有效对敌人实施群体控制。
englishValues: A fully-automatic pistol with an extremely high fire rate, allowing for efficient crowd control.
simplifiedChineseValues: 射速极高的全自动手枪，可以有效对敌人实施群体控制。

records.english: A tube red dot sight with 2x magnification, good for hitting small targets consistently over medium range.
records.simplifiedChinese: 2倍放大管式红点瞄准镜，适合中程持续精准打击小型目标。
englishValues: A tube red dot sight with 2x magnification, good for hitting small targets consistently over medium range.
simplifiedChineseValues: 2倍放大管式红点瞄准镜，适合中程持续精准打击小型目标。

records.english: As the electric arc generates a strong magnetic field, wearers should avoid use while in vicinity of stapled paperwork.
records.simplifiedChinese: 电弧可产生强大的磁场，穿戴者应避免在装订好的文书附近使用此盔甲。
englishValues: As the electric arc generates a strong magnetic field, wearers should avoid use while in vicinity of stapled paperwork.
simplifiedChineseValues: 电弧可产生强大的磁场，穿戴者应避免在装订好的文书附近使用此盔甲。

records.english: Debuted during the New Mombasa Armour Show, this sleek ensemble is sure to turn heads and blow minds.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套时髦的盔甲套装在新蒙巴萨盔甲展上首次亮相，必定成为全场焦点。
englishValues: Debuted during the New Mombasa Armour Show, this sleek ensemble is sure to turn heads and blow minds.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套时髦的盔甲套装在新蒙巴萨盔甲展上首次亮相，必定成为全场焦点。

records.english: Let all who see this cape be struck still with Freedom's beauty, or struck dead with Liberty's bullets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 凡见此披肩者都将为自由之美所震慑，或被自由之弹所击毙。
englishValues: Let all who see this cape be struck still with Freedom's beauty, or struck dead with Liberty's bullets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 凡见此披肩者都将为自由之美所震慑，或被自由之弹所击毙。

records.english: Launches a prolonged barrage of napalm shells over a wide area, setting a swath of land ablaze in mere moments.
records.simplifiedChinese: 持续投射凝固汽油弹火力网覆盖广大区域，顷刻将土地点燃。
englishValues: Launches a prolonged barrage of napalm shells over a wide area, setting a swath of land ablaze in mere moments.
simplifiedChineseValues: 持续投射凝固汽油弹火力网覆盖广大区域，顷刻将土地点燃。

records.english: A larger heatsink that can store more heat.
records.simplifiedChinese: 容量更大的散热器，可储存更多热量。
englishValues: A larger heatsink that can store more heat.
simplifiedChineseValues: 容量更大的散热器，可储存更多热量。

records.english: This armour is based on the antique uniforms of the 'Super Earth Legion', a less patriotic precursor to the Helldivers.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲脱胎于古老的“超级地球军团”制服。后者是绝地潜兵的前身，但是不像绝地潜兵这样忠心爱国。
englishValues: This armour is based on the antique uniforms of the 'Super Earth Legion', a less patriotic precursor to the Helldivers.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲脱胎于古老的“超级地球军团”制服。后者是绝地潜兵的前身，但是不像绝地潜兵这样忠心爱国。

records.english: This cape reminds us that even faced with the abyssal darkness of space, nothing can stand against our human ingenuity, our powers of collaboration, or our sheer overwhelming numbers.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩提醒我们，即使面对太空万籁俱静的黑暗，任何力量都无法对抗人类的智慧、协作能力以及人海战术的优势。
englishValues: This cape reminds us that even faced with the abyssal darkness of space, nothing can stand against our human ingenuity, our powers of collaboration, or our sheer overwhelming numbers.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩提醒我们，即使面对太空万籁俱静的黑暗，任何力量都无法对抗人类的智慧、协作能力以及人海战术的优势。

records.english: A camo paint job for use in arctic environments.
records.simplifiedChinese: 适用于雪地环境的迷彩涂装。
englishValues: A camo paint job for use in arctic environments.
simplifiedChineseValues: 适用于雪地环境的迷彩涂装。

records.english: Some say that a mere glimpse of this cape, fluttering majestically in the breeze, is enough to spur a squad to victory.
records.simplifiedChinese: 有人说，只需一瞥此披肩在微风中飘扬的庄严模样，就足以激励整支战队披荆斩棘，迈向胜利。
englishValues: Some say that a mere glimpse of this cape, fluttering majestically in the breeze, is enough to spur a squad to victory.
simplifiedChineseValues: 有人说，只需一瞥此披肩在微风中飘扬的庄严模样，就足以激励整支战队披荆斩棘，迈向胜利。

records.english: A turret firing powerful shells in a high arc. Effective at long ranges, and able to strike at targets behind cover.
records.simplifiedChinese: 以高弧度发射强力弹药的炮台。在远程范围内较为高效，能打击藏于掩体后方的目标。
englishValues: A turret firing powerful shells in a high arc. Effective at long ranges, and able to strike at targets behind cover.
simplifiedChineseValues: 以高弧度发射强力弹药的炮台。在远程范围内较为高效，能打击藏于掩体后方的目标。

records.english: Emblazoned with the red, white, and green of the 676th Democracy Regiment, who made their final stand on the slopes of Justice Hill.
records.simplifiedChinese: 饰有第676民主军团的标志性红、白、绿三色，纪念他们在正义山上的殊死一战。
englishValues: Emblazoned with the red, white, and green of the 676th Democracy Regiment, who made their final stand on the slopes of Justice Hill.
simplifiedChineseValues: 饰有第676民主军团的标志性红、白、绿三色，纪念他们在正义山上的殊死一战。

records.english: A one-handed device that deploys a wide energy barrier in front of the user. The barrier is semipermeable and blocks high-speed projectiles from the outside only, leaving the user free to shoot through it.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可单手操作的装置，使用时会在正前方展开宽大的能量屏障。该半透屏障只会抵挡外部高速射弹，使用者发射的子弹能自由穿透屏障。
englishValues: A one-handed device that deploys a wide energy barrier in front of the user. The barrier is semipermeable and blocks high-speed projectiles from the outside only, leaving the user free to shoot through it.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可单手操作的装置，使用时会在正前方展开宽大的能量屏障。该半透屏障只会抵挡外部高速射弹，使用者发射的子弹能自由穿透屏障。

records.english: Due to the enhanced strength caused by this armour, caution is advised when using door handles or embracing colleagues.
records.simplifiedChinese: 此盔甲可强化穿戴者的力量，因此，建议穿戴时谨慎使用门把手或拥抱同僚。
englishValues: Due to the enhanced strength caused by this armour, caution is advised when using door handles or embracing colleagues.
simplifiedChineseValues: 此盔甲可强化穿戴者的力量，因此，建议穿戴时谨慎使用门把手或拥抱同僚。

records.english: A grenade that releases a cloud of toxic gas, effective at temporarily blinding and slowing both organic and inorganic enemies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 释放有毒气团的榴弹，可使有机体和无机体敌人暂时致盲并减速。
englishValues: A grenade that releases a cloud of toxic gas, effective at temporarily blinding and slowing both organic and inorganic enemies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 释放有毒气团的榴弹，可使有机体和无机体敌人暂时致盲并减速。

records.english: A grenade launcher effective against armoured infantry. Not intended for use against vehicle armour or fortified buildings.
records.simplifiedChinese: 榴弹发射器，可有效对付装甲步兵。不适合用于攻击载具装甲或防卫森严的建筑。
englishValues: A grenade launcher effective against armoured infantry. Not intended for use against vehicle armour or fortified buildings.
simplifiedChineseValues: 榴弹发射器，可有效对付装甲步兵。不适合用于攻击载具装甲或防卫森严的建筑。

records.english: This armour set first appeared in the music video for the summer anthem 'Our Love is Like Liberty (Indestructible)'.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲的首度亮相是在夏日圣歌“爱如解放（坚不可摧）”的MV中。
englishValues: This armour set first appeared in the music video for the summer anthem 'Our Love is Like Liberty (Indestructible)'.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲的首度亮相是在夏日圣歌“爱如解放（坚不可摧）”的MV中。

records.english: A single precision shot from the Destroyer's 'ATLAS' cannon.
records.simplifiedChinese: 来自驱逐舰“阿特拉斯”轨道加农炮的一发精准攻击。
englishValues: A single precision shot from the Destroyer's 'ATLAS' cannon.
simplifiedChineseValues: 来自驱逐舰“阿特拉斯”轨道加农炮的一发精准攻击。

records.english: Reduces range at which enemies can detect the wearer by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
records.simplifiedChinese: 敌人探测佩戴者的范围缩小<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。
englishValues: Reduces range at which enemies can detect the wearer by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
simplifiedChineseValues: 敌人探测佩戴者的范围缩小<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。

records.english: Temporarily stuns all targets within the effective radius.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可短时眩晕效果范围内的所有目标。
englishValues: Temporarily stuns all targets within the effective radius.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可短时眩晕效果范围内的所有目标。

records.english: Contains many small pockets, allowing the user to evenly distribute the weight of ammunition, samples, and cool rocks.
records.simplifiedChinese: 包含许多小口袋，方便使用者根据重量均衡放置弹药、样本和酷炫岩石。
englishValues: Contains many small pockets, allowing the user to evenly distribute the weight of ammunition, samples, and cool rocks.
simplifiedChineseValues: 包含许多小口袋，方便使用者根据重量均衡放置弹药、样本和酷炫岩石。

records.english: Woven in honour of our loyal citizens, who by raising their voices have supported the war effort more than they can ever know.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩旨在纪念忠诚的公民，他们大声疾呼，为战争提供了超乎想象的支持。
englishValues: Woven in honour of our loyal citizens, who by raising their voices have supported the war effort more than they can ever know.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩旨在纪念忠诚的公民，他们大声疾呼，为战争提供了超乎想象的支持。

records.english: A compact version of the Liberator designed for increased viability in close quarters. Has an increased fire rate at the cost of higher spread.
records.simplifiedChinese: 便携版“解放者”，设计目的是提升近距离交战的生存能力。射速提高，但散射更广。
englishValues: A compact version of the Liberator designed for increased viability in close quarters. Has an increased fire rate at the cost of higher spread.
simplifiedChineseValues: 便携版“解放者”，设计目的是提升近距离交战的生存能力。射速提高，但散射更广。

records.english: Aspect-seeking air-to-air missiles, to eliminate most flying targets in the vicinity.
records.simplifiedChinese: 寻向空对空导弹，可歼灭附近的大部分飞行目标。
englishValues: Aspect-seeking air-to-air missiles, to eliminate most flying targets in the vicinity.
simplifiedChineseValues: 寻向空对空导弹，可歼灭附近的大部分飞行目标。

records.english: An Exosuit equipped with dual autocannons, designed for sustained explosive firepower.
records.simplifiedChinese: 搭载两台机炮的外骨骼装甲，可持续提供爆炸性火力。
englishValues: An Exosuit equipped with dual autocannons, designed for sustained explosive firepower.
simplifiedChineseValues: 搭载两台机炮的外骨骼装甲，可持续提供爆炸性火力。

records.english: Reduces the size of the muzzle flash by dispersing the burning propellant when firing the weapon.
records.simplifiedChinese: 通过分散燃烧的推进剂，减少射击时的枪口火焰大小。
englishValues: Reduces the size of the muzzle flash by dispersing the burning propellant when firing the weapon.
simplifiedChineseValues: 通过分散燃烧的推进剂，减少射击时的枪口火焰大小。

records.english: The heavy plate used in this armour is sustainably sourced from the corpses of non-sentient Automatons, then processed by other, similarly non-sentient Automatons.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲使用的重型装甲板是可持续地取材于无感知能力的机器人残骸，并由其他同样无感知能力的机器人加工而成。
englishValues: The heavy plate used in this armour is sustainably sourced from the corpses of non-sentient Automatons, then processed by other, similarly non-sentient Automatons.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲使用的重型装甲板是可持续地取材于无感知能力的机器人残骸，并由其他同样无感知能力的机器人加工而成。

records.simplifiedChinese: 轨道凝固汽油弹火力网
simplifiedChineseValues: 轨道凝固汽油弹火力网

records.english: Legend tells of the unnamed Helldiver, wandering the edges of Super Earth's reach, delivering Democracy and levelling lawlessness wherever the tumbleweeds lead. Wear this, and keep the legend alive.
records.simplifiedChinese: 传说有一位无名的绝地潜兵，游荡在超级地球的边境，追随风滚草的引领，传播民主，肃清无序。披上这件披肩，续写传奇。
englishValues: Legend tells of the unnamed Helldiver, wandering the edges of Super Earth's reach, delivering Democracy and levelling lawlessness wherever the tumbleweeds lead. Wear this, and keep the legend alive.
simplifiedChineseValues: 传说有一位无名的绝地潜兵，游荡在超级地球的边境，追随风滚草的引领，传播民主，肃清无序。披上这件披肩，续写传奇。

records.english: A drill capable of piercing the tough walls of Terminid hives, and deploying a nuclear charge to collapse all tunnels.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这台钻机能够穿透终结族虫窝的坚硬墙体，还能部署核炸药摧毁所有隧道。
englishValues: A drill capable of piercing the tough walls of Terminid hives, and deploying a nuclear charge to collapse all tunnels.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这台钻机能够穿透终结族虫窝的坚硬墙体，还能部署核炸药摧毁所有隧道。

records.english: A plasma rifle, firing a bolt of superheated gas which explodes on impact. Avoid standing in proximity to the blast.
records.simplifiedChinese: 等离子步枪，可发射一束过热气体，触及着弹点后引爆。请勿站在爆炸点附近。
englishValues: A plasma rifle, firing a bolt of superheated gas which explodes on impact. Avoid standing in proximity to the blast.
simplifiedChineseValues: 等离子步枪，可发射一束过热气体，触及着弹点后引爆。请勿站在爆炸点附近。

records.english: Redirects propellant gases to compensate for muzzle climb when firing the weapon.
records.simplifiedChinese: 通过更改推进气体流向，抵消射击时的枪口上扬。
englishValues: Redirects propellant gases to compensate for muzzle climb when firing the weapon.
simplifiedChineseValues: 通过更改推进气体流向，抵消射击时的枪口上扬。

records.english: A high-velocity railcannon round fired at the largest target in close proximity to the beacon. Targeting is automatic.
records.simplifiedChinese: 向信标附近的最大型目标发射高速轨道炮弹。轨道炮自动完成目标定位。
englishValues: A high-velocity railcannon round fired at the largest target in close proximity to the beacon. Targeting is automatic.
simplifiedChineseValues: 向信标附近的最大型目标发射高速轨道炮弹。轨道炮自动完成目标定位。

records.english: A barrage of rocket pods, which the Eagle pilot will release on the largest target near the stratagem beacon.
records.simplifiedChinese: 火箭巢火力网。“飞鹰”驾驶员会将其发射至靠近战略配备信标的最大型目标。
englishValues: A barrage of rocket pods, which the Eagle pilot will release on the largest target near the stratagem beacon.
simplifiedChineseValues: 火箭巢火力网。“飞鹰”驾驶员会将其发射至靠近战略配备信标的最大型目标。

records.english: Woven for the trailblazers who successfully led the way during the first sanctioned deployment of a new tactical paradigm. This cape’s bold shoulder mount design ensures that while the Helldiver continues to ever look toward the future, enemies of Freedom shall gaze upon an extinction of their own making.
records.simplifiedChinese: 专为在首个获批全新战术范式部署中成功领跑的开拓者们织就。这件披风采用大胆的肩部挂载设计，旨在确保当绝地潜兵继续放眼未来时，自由的敌人却将亲眼见证其自取灭亡的下场。
englishValues: Woven for the trailblazers who successfully led the way during the first sanctioned deployment of a new tactical paradigm. This cape’s bold shoulder mount design ensures that while the Helldiver continues to ever look toward the future, enemies of Freedom shall gaze upon an extinction of their own making.
simplifiedChineseValues: 专为在首个获批全新战术范式部署中成功领跑的开拓者们织就。这件披风采用大胆的肩部挂载设计，旨在确保当绝地潜兵继续放眼未来时，自由的敌人却将亲眼见证其自取灭亡的下场。

records.english: A recoilless rifle effective against vehicle armour. Includes support backpack required for reloading.
records.simplifiedChinese: 无后坐力炮，可有效对付载具装甲。包含支援背包，用于装填弹药。
englishValues: A recoilless rifle effective against vehicle armour. Includes support backpack required for reloading.
simplifiedChineseValues: 无后坐力炮，可有效对付载具装甲。包含支援背包，用于装填弹药。

records.english: Increases reload speed of primary weapons by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
records.simplifiedChinese: 主要武器的装弹速度提高<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。
englishValues: Increases reload speed of primary weapons by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
simplifiedChineseValues: 主要武器的装弹速度提高<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。

records.english: This ceremonial rifle is modelled after antique relics from pre-Democratic times. It is traditionally gifted to every citizen upon turning 16 to encourage service.
records.simplifiedChinese: 以前民主时代文明的遗产为模型制作的礼仪步枪，传统会赠给满16周岁的公民，鼓励他们服役。
englishValues: This ceremonial rifle is modelled after antique relics from pre-Democratic times. It is traditionally gifted to every citizen upon turning 16 to encourage service.
simplifiedChineseValues: 以前民主时代文明的遗产为模型制作的礼仪步枪，传统会赠给满16周岁的公民，鼓励他们服役。

records.english: A strafing run of the battlefield to clear small targets, delivered almost instantly.
records.simplifiedChinese: 机枪扫射清除战场上的小型目标，几乎可在一瞬间内完成扫射。
englishValues: A strafing run of the battlefield to clear small targets, delivered almost instantly.
simplifiedChineseValues: 机枪扫射清除战场上的小型目标，几乎可在一瞬间内完成扫射。

records.english: When children have trouble sleeping, tucking them in under this cape reminds them that they are never alone, for Liberty's unseen defenders are always watching over them.
records.simplifiedChinese: 为难以入睡的孩子盖上这件披肩，提醒他们并不孤单，看不见的自由卫士一直守护在侧。
englishValues: When children have trouble sleeping, tucking them in under this cape reminds them that they are never alone, for Liberty's unseen defenders are always watching over them.
simplifiedChineseValues: 为难以入睡的孩子盖上这件披肩，提醒他们并不孤单，看不见的自由卫士一直守护在侧。

records.english: After colonists of Hellmire recovered a lost shipment of this armour, the local pastime of fence-smashing was born.
records.simplifiedChinese: 海尔迈尔的拓殖地居民寻回一批丢失的这种盔甲后，当地兴起了一种狂打栅栏的娱乐方式。
englishValues: After colonists of Hellmire recovered a lost shipment of this armour, the local pastime of fence-smashing was born.
simplifiedChineseValues: 海尔迈尔的拓殖地居民寻回一批丢失的这种盔甲后，当地兴起了一种狂打栅栏的娱乐方式。

records.english: Deploys a defensive anti-personnel minefield to halt enemy advance.
records.simplifiedChinese: 部署反步兵防御雷区，阻止敌人前进的脚步。
englishValues: Deploys a defensive anti-personnel minefield to halt enemy advance.
simplifiedChineseValues: 部署反步兵防御雷区，阻止敌人前进的脚步。

records.english: Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of stims by <c=#COLOR>#SIGN#BONUS</c>.
records.simplifiedChinese: 治疗剂的初始库存和持有上限增加<c=#COLOR>#SIGN#BONUS</c>。
englishValues: Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of stims by <c=#COLOR>#SIGN#BONUS</c>.
simplifiedChineseValues: 治疗剂的初始库存和持有上限增加<c=#COLOR>#SIGN#BONUS</c>。

records.english: An experimental weapon which prioritises armour penetration. Must be charged between shots - so choose targets carefully.
records.simplifiedChinese: 侧重穿甲能力的试验性武器。两次射击的间隙必须充能，因此，请谨慎选择目标。
englishValues: An experimental weapon which prioritises armour penetration. Must be charged between shots - so choose targets carefully.
simplifiedChineseValues: 侧重穿甲能力的试验性武器。两次射击的间隙必须充能，因此，请谨慎选择目标。

records.english: The Combat Walker's fuel capacity is increased by 50%.
records.simplifiedChinese: 战斗步行机甲的燃料容量提升50%。
englishValues: The Combat Walker's fuel capacity is increased by 50%.
simplifiedChineseValues: 战斗步行机甲的燃料容量提升50%。

records.english: A powerful plasma weapon that fires one blast at a time, each blast exploding on impact. Must be charged to fire. Warning: do not overcharge.
records.simplifiedChinese: 威力强大的等离子武器，每次单发射击，击中目标后爆炸。开火前需要充能。警告：请勿过度充能。
englishValues: A powerful plasma weapon that fires one blast at a time, each blast exploding on impact. Must be charged to fire. Warning: do not overcharge.
simplifiedChineseValues: 威力强大的等离子武器，每次单发射击，击中目标后爆炸。开火前需要充能。警告：请勿过度充能。

records.english: One of the earliest to be mass-produced, this cape has been the final sight of untold numbers of Freedom's foes.
records.simplifiedChinese: 作为最早量产的披肩之一，此披肩已经见证了无数自由之敌的陨落。
englishValues: One of the earliest to be mass-produced, this cape has been the final sight of untold numbers of Freedom's foes.
simplifiedChineseValues: 作为最早量产的披肩之一，此披肩已经见证了无数自由之敌的陨落。

records.english: Body type has no impact on gameplay
englishValues: Body type has no impact on gameplay

records.english: This bolt-action rifle fires jet-assisted shells that explode shrapnel in all directions upon impact. Not recommended for close-quarters use.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这种栓动步枪透过喷气辅助发射炮弹，炮弹触及撞击面时向四面八方崩裂碎片。不建议近战使用。
englishValues: This bolt-action rifle fires jet-assisted shells that explode shrapnel in all directions upon impact. Not recommended for close-quarters use.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这种栓动步枪透过喷气辅助发射炮弹，炮弹触及撞击面时向四面八方崩裂碎片。不建议近战使用。

records.english: Each purchase of this cape comes with a complimentary will and testament amendment form, which guarantees the soon-to-be-deceased a prominent spot on the Wall of Martyrs.
records.simplifiedChinese: 每次购买这件披肩都会附赠遗嘱更改表，确保即将牺牲的战士在烈士墙上占据显眼位置。
englishValues: Each purchase of this cape comes with a complimentary will and testament amendment form, which guarantees the soon-to-be-deceased a prominent spot on the Wall of Martyrs.
simplifiedChineseValues: 每次购买这件披肩都会附赠遗嘱更改表，确保即将牺牲的战士在烈士墙上占据显眼位置。

records.english: The golden, piercing quills symbolise the deadly and poetic Justice delivered to seditious oppositionists. Silent sanctions, delivered with unerring precision and incontestable deniability.
records.simplifiedChinese: 锐利的金色羽毛笔，象征着凭借充满诗意的致命正义严惩煽动叛乱的反对派。以精准无误和无可辩驳的手段实施无声的制裁。
