englishValues: The golden, piercing quills symbolise the deadly and poetic Justice delivered to seditious oppositionists. Silent sanctions, delivered with unerring precision and incontestable deniability.
simplifiedChineseValues: 锐利的金色羽毛笔，象征着凭借充满诗意的致命正义严惩煽动叛乱的反对派。以精准无误和无可辩驳的手段实施无声的制裁。

records.simplifiedChinese: 等离子点火器枪口制退器
simplifiedChineseValues: 等离子点火器枪口制退器

records.english: A belt-fed minigun with an exceptional ammo capacity. Cannot be reloaded with standard non-belted munitions.
records.simplifiedChinese: 使用弹链供弹的机枪，弹药容量非常充足。无法使用标准无链式弹药装填。
englishValues: A belt-fed minigun with an exceptional ammo capacity. Cannot be reloaded with standard non-belted munitions.
simplifiedChineseValues: 使用弹链供弹的机枪，弹药容量非常充足。无法使用标准无链式弹药装填。

records.english: This convenient cape can double as ground insulation, warming blanket, or camp roofing to the enterprising defoliator.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这款便利披肩可兼作地面隔离垫、保暖毯或营地遮顶，为富有开拓精神的伐木工提供多种用途。
englishValues: This convenient cape can double as ground insulation, warming blanket, or camp roofing to the enterprising defoliator.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这款便利披肩可兼作地面隔离垫、保暖毯或营地遮顶，为富有开拓精神的伐木工提供多种用途。

records.english: A one-handed ceremonial sword suitable for use in parades, sabrage, and combat.
records.simplifiedChinese: 单手礼仪刀，适合阅兵、开瓶和战斗。
englishValues: A one-handed ceremonial sword suitable for use in parades, sabrage, and combat.
simplifiedChineseValues: 单手礼仪刀，适合阅兵、开瓶和战斗。

records.english: Heavily layered to protect against ocular blistering, subdermal liquification, and gastrointestinal shattering, this armour is a testament to the power of iterative improvements based on user feedback.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲层层厚实，可防止眼部起泡、皮下液化和胃肠道碎裂，充分体现了根据用户反馈迭代改进的力量。
englishValues: Heavily layered to protect against ocular blistering, subdermal liquification, and gastrointestinal shattering, this armour is a testament to the power of iterative improvements based on user feedback.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲层层厚实，可防止眼部起泡、皮下液化和胃肠道碎裂，充分体现了根据用户反馈迭代改进的力量。

records.english: Scatters powerful anti-tank mines that deal heavy, armour-penetrating damage. Minefield is less densely packed relative to smaller mines.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射强力的反坦克地雷，可造成严重的穿甲伤害。与较小型的地雷相比，雷区的部署密集度较低。
englishValues: Scatters powerful anti-tank mines that deal heavy, armour-penetrating damage. Minefield is less densely packed relative to smaller mines.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射强力的反坦克地雷，可造成严重的穿甲伤害。与较小型的地雷相比，雷区的部署密集度较低。

records.simplifiedChinese: 等离子点火器枪口制退器
simplifiedChineseValues: 等离子点火器枪口制退器

records.english: A projected laser, that is aligned with the barrel of the weapon, which assists the user with landing their shots.
records.simplifiedChinese: 与武器枪管对齐的投射激光，辅助使用者命中目标。
englishValues: A projected laser, that is aligned with the barrel of the weapon, which assists the user with landing their shots.
simplifiedChineseValues: 与武器枪管对齐的投射激光，辅助使用者命中目标。

records.english: For warriors who are so strong and confident that they don't need any reassurance whatsoever.
records.simplifiedChinese: 为那些强大自信到不需要任何保证的战士而设计。
englishValues: For warriors who are so strong and confident that they don't need any reassurance whatsoever.
simplifiedChineseValues: 为那些强大自信到不需要任何保证的战士而设计。

records.english: Humanity's intellect shines brighter than all other, piercing even the treacherous darkness that spawned the Automatons' pseudo-sentience; the darkness known as computer science.
records.simplifiedChinese: 人类的智慧比万物更闪耀，能刺穿孕育机器人伪智能的“计算机科学”诡谲黑雾。
englishValues: Humanity's intellect shines brighter than all other, piercing even the treacherous darkness that spawned the Automatons' pseudo-sentience; the darkness known as computer science.
simplifiedChineseValues: 人类的智慧比万物更闪耀，能刺穿孕育机器人伪智能的“计算机科学”诡谲黑雾。

records.english: The Hellbomb is a tactical nuke powerful enough to destroy any perceivable target in its blast zone. For safety and budgetary reasons, it has to be armed manually once deployed.
records.simplifiedChinese: 地狱火炸弹是一种战术核武器，威力足以摧毁轰炸范围内的任何可见目标。出于安全和预算的原因，地狱火炸弹部署后必须手动启动。
englishValues: The Hellbomb is a tactical nuke powerful enough to destroy any perceivable target in its blast zone. For safety and budgetary reasons, it has to be armed manually once deployed.
simplifiedChineseValues: 地狱火炸弹是一种战术核武器，威力足以摧毁轰炸范围内的任何可见目标。出于安全和预算的原因，地狱火炸弹部署后必须手动启动。

records.english: Created to honour the great Freedom Chant of 14/2, in which over 10,000 loyal citizens united as one to express their undying respect for Freedom.
records.simplifiedChinese: 为纪念伟大的2-14自由颂歌而创作，其时，有超过10,000名忠诚的公民联合表达了他们对自由的永恒敬重。
englishValues: Created to honour the great Freedom Chant of 14/2, in which over 10,000 loyal citizens united as one to express their undying respect for Freedom.
simplifiedChineseValues: 为纪念伟大的2-14自由颂歌而创作，其时，有超过10,000名忠诚的公民联合表达了他们对自由的永恒敬重。

records.english: The default paint job for this weapon.
englishValues: The default paint job for this weapon.

records.english: Marks the most obedient of the obedient, those who will strike headlong at the veins of Tyranny and administer the sweet antidote of Freedom.
records.simplifiedChinese: 最顺从者的印记，当属毫不犹豫打击暴政血脉、为自由精神注入甜美解毒剂的人。
englishValues: Marks the most obedient of the obedient, those who will strike headlong at the veins of Tyranny and administer the sweet antidote of Freedom.
simplifiedChineseValues: 最顺从者的印记，当属毫不犹豫打击暴政血脉、为自由精神注入甜美解毒剂的人。

records.english: A camo paint job for use in urban environments.
records.simplifiedChinese: 适用于城市环境的迷彩涂装。
englishValues: A camo paint job for use in urban environments.
simplifiedChineseValues: 适用于城市环境的迷彩涂装。

records.english: A turret firing powerful and precise laser beams. Warning: overloading heat sink may cause adverse effects.
records.simplifiedChinese: 炮台，可发射威力强悍且精准的激光束。警告：散热器过载可能产生反效果。
englishValues: A turret firing powerful and precise laser beams. Warning: overloading heat sink may cause adverse effects.
simplifiedChineseValues: 炮台，可发射威力强悍且精准的激光束。警告：散热器过载可能产生反效果。

records.english: A paint job that is one with the darkness.
records.simplifiedChinese: 与黑暗融为一体的涂装。
englishValues: A paint job that is one with the darkness.
simplifiedChineseValues: 与黑暗融为一体的涂装。

records.simplifiedChinese: 增加架设型重机枪弹匣

records.english: Enables the user to jump higher than 'gravity' and 'safety' would normally allow. Must be charged before use.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可助力使用者跳得更高，无视日常“重力”和“安全规范”的束缚。使用前必须充能。

records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球武装部队大炮：静电场
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球武装部队大炮：静电场

records.english: Based on a colonial surgeon's gown, where surgeries were often interrupted by a need to perform defensive duties.
records.simplifiedChinese: 原型是殖民地外科医生的手术袍。外科医生经常在手术中途被打断，受命立刻前去执行防卫任务。
englishValues: Based on a colonial surgeon's gown, where surgeries were often interrupted by a need to perform defensive duties.
simplifiedChineseValues: 原型是殖民地外科医生的手术袍。外科医生经常在手术中途被打断，受命立刻前去执行防卫任务。

records.english: A throwable emplacement that generates a spherical, projectile-blocking shield on impact. Has a limited lifetime once deployed.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可投掷的防护装置，落地时生成阻挡投射物的球形护盾。部署后的持续时间有限。
englishValues: A throwable emplacement that generates a spherical, projectile-blocking shield on impact. Has a limited lifetime once deployed.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可投掷的防护装置，落地时生成阻挡投射物的球形护盾。部署后的持续时间有限。

records.english: A slamfire shotgun: fires continuously while the trigger is depressed, via activation of the pump-action mechanism. Loaded with armour-piercing flechettes and equipped with an extended bayonet.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一款速射霰弹枪：扣住扳机即可连续开火射击，采用泵动结构。装填穿甲飞镖弹，并配备加长刺刀。
englishValues: A slamfire shotgun: fires continuously while the trigger is depressed, via activation of the pump-action mechanism. Loaded with armour-piercing flechettes and equipped with an extended bayonet.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一款速射霰弹枪：扣住扳机即可连续开火射击，采用泵动结构。装填穿甲飞镖弹，并配备加长刺刀。

records.english: Adorned with the insignia of the Order of the Venerated Ballot, a Ministry-sanctioned Patriot's Club for citizens who pledge themselves to preserving the sanctity of voting.
records.simplifiedChinese: 饰有神圣投票团的徽章，该组织是由外交部批准设立的爱国者俱乐部，加入其中的公民承诺维护投票权的神圣性。
englishValues: Adorned with the insignia of the Order of the Venerated Ballot, a Ministry-sanctioned Patriot's Club for citizens who pledge themselves to preserving the sanctity of voting.
simplifiedChineseValues: 饰有神圣投票团的徽章，该组织是由外交部批准设立的爱国者俱乐部，加入其中的公民承诺维护投票权的神圣性。

records.english: Improves weapons handling with less drag on weapon movement.
records.simplifiedChinese: 提升武器操纵性，降低携带武器移动的阻力。
englishValues: Improves weapons handling with less drag on weapon movement.
simplifiedChineseValues: 提升武器操纵性，降低携带武器移动的阻力。

records.english: A large-capacity assault rifle firing humane stun rounds. Reports of lethal incidents have been thoroughly debunked.
records.simplifiedChinese: 大容量突击步枪，能发射人道主义眩晕弹药。相关致命事件的报告已被证实为谣言。
englishValues: A large-capacity assault rifle firing humane stun rounds. Reports of lethal incidents have been thoroughly debunked.
simplifiedChineseValues: 大容量突击步枪，能发射人道主义眩晕弹药。相关致命事件的报告已被证实为谣言。

records.english: A specialised Fast Recon Vehicle equipped with heavier armour, a spiked ramming grille, and a roof-mounted heavy flamethrower at the expense of seating; this FRV can enable up to three Helldivers to deliver high-speed Justice, and forcefully clear obstructed transport routes.
records.simplifiedChinese: 牺牲了座位以换取更厚重的装甲、带刺的冲撞格栅以及车顶安装的重型火焰喷射器。该快速侦察载具最多可承载三名绝地潜兵，高速播撒正义，强力打通受阻的运输路线。
englishValues: A specialised Fast Recon Vehicle equipped with heavier armour, a spiked ramming grille, and a roof-mounted heavy flamethrower at the expense of seating; this FRV can enable up to three Helldivers to deliver high-speed Justice, and forcefully clear obstructed transport routes.
simplifiedChineseValues: 牺牲了座位以换取更厚重的装甲、带刺的冲撞格栅以及车顶安装的重型火焰喷射器。该快速侦察载具最多可承载三名绝地潜兵，高速播撒正义，强力打通受阻的运输路线。

records.english: Crests the shoulders of those who deliver the final—and most indispensable—stroke of Justice.
records.simplifiedChinese: 献给发起不可或缺的最终正义一击之人。
englishValues: Crests the shoulders of those who deliver the final—and most indispensable—stroke of Justice.
simplifiedChineseValues: 献给发起不可或缺的最终正义一击之人。

records.english: A high-speed Fast Recon Vehicle equipped with an automated defence turret and a mounted supply rack, allowing frontline personnel to fully replenish ammunition and medical supplies on the move.
records.simplifiedChinese: 高速的快速侦察载具，配备自动防御炮台和挂载式补给架，允许前线人员在移动中全面补充弹药和医疗补给。
englishValues: A high-speed Fast Recon Vehicle equipped with an automated defence turret and a mounted supply rack, allowing frontline personnel to fully replenish ammunition and medical supplies on the move.
simplifiedChineseValues: 高速的快速侦察载具，配备自动防御炮台和挂载式补给架，允许前线人员在移动中全面补充弹药和医疗补给。

records.english: Some soldiers report picking up strange radio interference when wearing this armour near alien artefacts.
records.simplifiedChinese: 部分士兵报告称，穿着这套盔甲接近外星古物时，会接收到奇怪的无线电干扰信号。
englishValues: Some soldiers report picking up strange radio interference when wearing this armour near alien artefacts.
simplifiedChineseValues: 部分士兵报告称，穿着这套盔甲接近外星古物时，会接收到奇怪的无线电干扰信号。

records.english: An incendiary weapon for close range. Will ignite targets, terrain, and any flammable teammates.
records.simplifiedChinese: 用于近程作战的燃烧武器，能点燃目标、地面，以及易燃易爆炸的队友。
englishValues: An incendiary weapon for close range. Will ignite targets, terrain, and any flammable teammates.
simplifiedChineseValues: 用于近程作战的燃烧武器，能点燃目标、地面，以及易燃易爆炸的队友。

records.english: No oppressive murk, no fascist penumbra, no dictatorial haze and no unfree emanation; no tyrannical Gloom shall ever stand a chance against the searing light of Helldiver fire.
records.simplifiedChinese: 无论是压迫的黑暗、法西斯的半阴影、独裁的迷雾还是非自由精神的辐射，任何专制的“阴霾”在绝地潜兵烈火般的灼热光芒前都将灰飞烟灭。
englishValues: No oppressive murk, no fascist penumbra, no dictatorial haze and no unfree emanation; no tyrannical Gloom shall ever stand a chance against the searing light of Helldiver fire.
simplifiedChineseValues: 无论是压迫的黑暗、法西斯的半阴影、独裁的迷雾还是非自由精神的辐射，任何专制的“阴霾”在绝地潜兵烈火般的灼热光芒前都将灰飞烟灭。

records.english: The burnished blood-red plates are forged in righteous fire, like the heroes they were wrought to protect.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这闪闪发亮的血红色盔甲跟它保护过的英雄一样经受过正义之火的考验。
englishValues: The burnished blood-red plates are forged in righteous fire, like the heroes they were wrought to protect.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这闪闪发亮的血红色盔甲跟它保护过的英雄一样经受过正义之火的考验。

records.simplifiedChinese: 电磁冲击波迫击哨戒炮
simplifiedChineseValues: 电磁冲击波迫击哨戒炮

records.english: Woven in honour of our loyal Helldivers, whose heart's blood is the foundation on which Super Earth is built.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩旨在纪念忠诚的绝地潜兵，他们的一腔热血是超级地球的发展根基。
englishValues: Woven in honour of our loyal Helldivers, whose heart's blood is the foundation on which Super Earth is built.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩旨在纪念忠诚的绝地潜兵，他们的一腔热血是超级地球的发展根基。

records.english: A stationary energy shield which provides cover against projectiles. Has a limited lifetime once deployed.
records.simplifiedChinese: 固定式能量护盾，可用作掩体抵挡射弹。部署完毕后仅在有限时间内起防护作用。
englishValues: A stationary energy shield which provides cover against projectiles. Has a limited lifetime once deployed.
simplifiedChineseValues: 固定式能量护盾，可用作掩体抵挡射弹。部署完毕后仅在有限时间内起防护作用。

records.english: An advanced vertical foregrip to improve the manoeuvrability of the weapon.
records.simplifiedChinese: 高级垂直前握把，可提升武器操控性。
englishValues: An advanced vertical foregrip to improve the manoeuvrability of the weapon.
simplifiedChineseValues: 高级垂直前握把，可提升武器操控性。

records.english: The yellow is the exact shade of the Ministry of Unity's 'Golden Gate', leading to the Chamber of Unanimous Decision.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这正是团结部“金门”的颜色，打开大门便能前往统一决策大厅。
englishValues: The yellow is the exact shade of the Ministry of Unity's 'Golden Gate', leading to the Chamber of Unanimous Decision.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这正是团结部“金门”的颜色，打开大门便能前往统一决策大厅。

records.english: Based on the ceremonial pennant flags of early Super Earth, which now adorn the entrance to each Ministry.
records.simplifiedChinese: 设计原型是早期超级地球的仪式用三角旗，如今用于装饰各部门的入口。
englishValues: Based on the ceremonial pennant flags of early Super Earth, which now adorn the entrance to each Ministry.
simplifiedChineseValues: 设计原型是早期超级地球的仪式用三角旗，如今用于装饰各部门的入口。

records.english: This humane device attaches to its target and dispenses repeated electrical pulses, keeping the target in place for humane apprehension and/or termination.
records.simplifiedChinese: 附着在目标上反复释放电击脉冲的人道主义设备，能将目标固定在原地，方便实施人道主义逮捕或处决。
englishValues: This humane device attaches to its target and dispenses repeated electrical pulses, keeping the target in place for humane apprehension and/or termination.
simplifiedChineseValues: 附着在目标上反复释放电击脉冲的人道主义设备，能将目标固定在原地，方便实施人道主义逮捕或处决。

records.english: To honour the heartfelt siblinghood of the heroes who stood together, bled together, and laid down their lives together in defence of Equality-On-Sea, all Helldivers are awarded one (1) commemorative polyester cape.
records.simplifiedChinese: 为致敬在仰齐浜保卫战中共同浴血奋战的同志情谊，所有绝地潜兵将获赠一件(1)聚酯纪念披风。
englishValues: To honour the heartfelt siblinghood of the heroes who stood together, bled together, and laid down their lives together in defence of Equality-On-Sea, all Helldivers are awarded one (1) commemorative polyester cape.
simplifiedChineseValues: 为致敬在仰齐浜保卫战中共同浴血奋战的同志情谊，所有绝地潜兵将获赠一件(1)聚酯纪念披风。

records.english: A pistol firing bursts of guided, jet-propelled ammunition. Can be set to non-guided mode at any time, removing the need to lock on to targets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 能发射制导喷射弹的手枪。随时可切换为非制导模式，无需锁定目标。
englishValues: A pistol firing bursts of guided, jet-propelled ammunition. Can be set to non-guided mode at any time, removing the need to lock on to targets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 能发射制导喷射弹的手枪。随时可切换为非制导模式，无需锁定目标。

records.english: Body type has no impact on gameplay
englishValues: Body type has no impact on gameplay

records.english: An incendiary device that shatters on impact, without explosive force, instantly creating a localised and persistent combustion field.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一种撞击即碎的燃烧装置，无爆炸力，可瞬间产生局部且持久的燃烧区域。
englishValues: An incendiary device that shatters on impact, without explosive force, instantly creating a localised and persistent combustion field.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一种撞击即碎的燃烧装置，无爆炸力，可瞬间产生局部且持久的燃烧区域。

records.english: A heavily-armoured tank destroyer armed with a 120mm high-velocity cannon and a heavy coaxial machinegun.
records.simplifiedChinese: 重装甲坦克歼击车，配备120mm高速火炮和重型同轴机枪。
englishValues: A heavily-armoured tank destroyer armed with a 120mm high-velocity cannon and a heavy coaxial machinegun.
simplifiedChineseValues: 重装甲坦克歼击车，配备120mm高速火炮和重型同轴机枪。

records.english: Part of a long line of experimental armour commonly seen on industrial engineering campuses, in the basements of select science aficionados, and around Super Destroyer Mega Garages.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件盔甲源于历史悠久的实验性盔甲系列，常见于工业工程学院、部分科学爱好者的地下室，以及超级驱逐舰大型车库内。
englishValues: Part of a long line of experimental armour commonly seen on industrial engineering campuses, in the basements of select science aficionados, and around Super Destroyer Mega Garages.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件盔甲源于历史悠久的实验性盔甲系列，常见于工业工程学院、部分科学爱好者的地下室，以及超级驱逐舰大型车库内。

records.simplifiedChinese: 电磁冲击波迫击哨戒炮
simplifiedChineseValues: 电磁冲击波迫击哨戒炮

records.english: Houses the Eagle Fighter & Pelican Shuttle. Also receives deliveries of materiel, supplies, frozen personnel, and fuel.
records.simplifiedChinese: 停放“飞鹰”战斗机与“鹈鹕”运输船，同时还接收运来的材料、物资、冷冻人员以及燃油。
englishValues: Houses the Eagle Fighter & Pelican Shuttle. Also receives deliveries of materiel, supplies, frozen personnel, and fuel.
simplifiedChineseValues: 停放“飞鹰”战斗机与“鹈鹕”运输船，同时还接收运来的材料、物资、冷冻人员以及燃油。

records.english: A targeting remote, used in combination with the Solo Silo.
records.simplifiedChinese: 定位遥控器，与单兵导弹发射井配合使用。
englishValues: A targeting remote, used in combination with the Solo Silo.
simplifiedChineseValues: 定位遥控器，与单兵导弹发射井配合使用。

records.english: The unimpeachable justice of this cape's design is said to blind the enemies of Freedom with its glorious light.
records.simplifiedChinese: 据说，此披肩无懈可击的正义设计将以荣耀光辉蒙蔽自由之敌的双目。
englishValues: The unimpeachable justice of this cape's design is said to blind the enemies of Freedom with its glorious light.
simplifiedChineseValues: 据说，此披肩无懈可击的正义设计将以荣耀光辉蒙蔽自由之敌的双目。

records.english: A high-calibre assault rifle with a restrictive magazine size but more stopping power.
records.simplifiedChinese: 大口径突击步枪，弹匣容量有限，但停止作用较强。
englishValues: A high-calibre assault rifle with a restrictive magazine size but more stopping power.
simplifiedChineseValues: 大口径突击步枪，弹匣容量有限，但停止作用较强。

records.english: The embroidered pattern uses aluminium from Automaton motherboards, granting the once-wretched metals a new and noble purpose.
records.simplifiedChinese: 刺绣图案采用了机器人主板上的铝材，为这些卑劣的金属赋予了更崇高的新使命。
englishValues: The embroidered pattern uses aluminium from Automaton motherboards, granting the once-wretched metals a new and noble purpose.
simplifiedChineseValues: 刺绣图案采用了机器人主板上的铝材，为这些卑劣的金属赋予了更崇高的新使命。

records.english: First deployed in the Helldivers 'Diplomatic' Corps, this armour enables effective non-verbal interspecies communication.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这种盔甲最初投用于绝地潜兵的“外交”部队，非常适用于不同种族之间的非言语交流。
englishValues: First deployed in the Helldivers 'Diplomatic' Corps, this armour enables effective non-verbal interspecies communication.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这种盔甲最初投用于绝地潜兵的“外交”部队，非常适用于不同种族之间的非言语交流。

records.english: As this cape flutters in the wind, it evokes a wishful, twinkling star in the sky—a star ripe for conquest.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩在风中飘扬时，让人不禁联想到空中那颗充满希望、闪闪发光的星星，一颗等待征服的星星。
englishValues: As this cape flutters in the wind, it evokes a wishful, twinkling star in the sky—a star ripe for conquest.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩在风中飘扬时，让人不禁联想到空中那颗充满希望、闪闪发光的星星，一颗等待征服的星星。

records.english: A simple vertical foregrip to improve the manoeuvrability of the weapon.
records.simplifiedChinese: 简单垂直前握把，可提升武器操控性。
englishValues: A simple vertical foregrip to improve the manoeuvrability of the weapon.
simplifiedChineseValues: 简单垂直前握把，可提升武器操控性。

records.english: A modified Punisher shotgun firing heavy, high-damage slug rounds. Perfect for punching big holes in big targets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 改良后的“制裁者”霰弹枪，可发射重型高伤害独头弹，是往大型目标身上开洞的完美之选。
englishValues: A modified Punisher shotgun firing heavy, high-damage slug rounds. Perfect for punching big holes in big targets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 改良后的“制裁者”霰弹枪，可发射重型高伤害独头弹，是往大型目标身上开洞的完美之选。

records.english: This sigil reaffirms the Helldiver's pledge to protect Managed Democracy, serve Managed Democracy, and uphold Managed Democracy.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这枚徽章再次强调了绝地潜兵对管理式民主的誓言：保卫、效命、秉持管理式民主。
englishValues: This sigil reaffirms the Helldiver's pledge to protect Managed Democracy, serve Managed Democracy, and uphold Managed Democracy.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这枚徽章再次强调了绝地潜兵对管理式民主的誓言：保卫、效命、秉持管理式民主。

records.english: This armour is the Super Earth Standard Issue, made from the same titanium alloy as the Destroyer's hull.
records.simplifiedChinese: 超级地球制式盔甲，使用驱逐舰舰体的同种钛合金制成。
englishValues: This armour is the Super Earth Standard Issue, made from the same titanium alloy as the Destroyer's hull.
simplifiedChineseValues: 超级地球制式盔甲，使用驱逐舰舰体的同种钛合金制成。

records.english: A heavier version of the Breaker shotgun, with higher damage at the cost of recoil and manoeuvrability.
records.simplifiedChinese: 更重型的“破裂者”霰弹枪，虽然牺牲了后坐力和操控性，伤害却有所提升。
englishValues: A heavier version of the Breaker shotgun, with higher damage at the cost of recoil and manoeuvrability.
simplifiedChineseValues: 更重型的“破裂者”霰弹枪，虽然牺牲了后坐力和操控性，伤害却有所提升。

records.english: Bearer is more resistant to being knocked prone.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备此盔甲可降低被击倒的概率。
englishValues: Bearer is more resistant to being knocked prone.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备此盔甲可降低被击倒的概率。

records.english: A perfectly balanced multitool, optimised for the displacement of soil and other forms of resistance with surgical precision.
records.simplifiedChinese: 一款完美平衡的多功能工具，经过特别优化，能以外科手术级的精准度移除土壤以及其他形式的抵抗。
englishValues: A perfectly balanced multitool, optimised for the displacement of soil and other forms of resistance with surgical precision.
simplifiedChineseValues: 一款完美平衡的多功能工具，经过特别优化，能以外科手术级的精准度移除土壤以及其他形式的抵抗。

records.english: Each gilded detail is polished to perfection by re-educated dissidents, as part of the Lifelong Post-Infraction Atonement Programme.
records.simplifiedChinese: 每一片镀金都由接受再教育的异见分子在终身违纪赎罪计划的监管下精心打磨至完美状态。
englishValues: Each gilded detail is polished to perfection by re-educated dissidents, as part of the Lifelong Post-Infraction Atonement Programme.
simplifiedChineseValues: 每一片镀金都由接受再教育的异见分子在终身违纪赎罪计划的监管下精心打磨至完美状态。

records.english: Increases the wearer's walking and running speed.
records.simplifiedChinese: 可提升穿着者的步行与奔跑速度。
englishValues: Increases the wearer's walking and running speed.
simplifiedChineseValues: 可提升穿着者的步行与奔跑速度。

records.english: A tribute to the mischief-makers and mavericks, those trailblazers who dutifully execute their orders with universally-endearing panache. The star-crossed trail calls to mind the special kind of Freedom that can only be achieved by going very fast in very expensive state-owned vehicles.
records.simplifiedChinese: 对捣蛋鬼与特立独行者的致敬之作，这些开疆拓土的先锋恪尽职守使命必达，潇洒风度广受拥戴。如星轨交错般的下摆令人联想到一种特殊的“自由”——惟有为国驾驶价值不菲的载具疾速冲锋方能得到的自由。
englishValues: A tribute to the mischief-makers and mavericks, those trailblazers who dutifully execute their orders with universally-endearing panache. The star-crossed trail calls to mind the special kind of Freedom that can only be achieved by going very fast in very expensive state-owned vehicles.
simplifiedChineseValues: 对捣蛋鬼与特立独行者的致敬之作，这些开疆拓土的先锋恪尽职守使命必达，潇洒风度广受拥戴。如星轨交错般的下摆令人联想到一种特殊的“自由”——惟有为国驾驶价值不菲的载具疾速冲锋方能得到的自由。

records.english: This cape signifies that its wearer thinks, feels, and acts correctly at all times, and thus bears the responsibility to educate and re-educate their fellow citizen.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩象征着穿戴者的思想、情感和行为一向无可指摘，因而肩负着教育和再教育同胞的重任。
englishValues: This cape signifies that its wearer thinks, feels, and acts correctly at all times, and thus bears the responsibility to educate and re-educate their fellow citizen.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩象征着穿戴者的思想、情感和行为一向无可指摘，因而肩负着教育和再教育同胞的重任。

records.english: It is said that only the truly Democratic can lift this cape to their shoulders.
records.simplifiedChinese: 据说，只有真正的民主主义者才能披上此披肩。
englishValues: It is said that only the truly Democratic can lift this cape to their shoulders.
simplifiedChineseValues: 据说，只有真正的民主主义者才能披上此披肩。

records.english: A pistol front-loaded with a single, powerful explosive. The weight of the projectile limits the weapon's range.
records.simplifiedChinese: 前端加装单颗强力射弹的手枪。射弹重量限制了手枪的射程。
englishValues: A pistol front-loaded with a single, powerful explosive. The weight of the projectile limits the weapon's range.
simplifiedChineseValues: 前端加装单颗强力射弹的手枪。射弹重量限制了手枪的射程。

records.english: Rendering the Helldiver's descent to the battlefield in splendorous foil, this cape illustrates that in any successful military machinery, heroic humans are the most vital piece.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披风以华丽烫印工艺展现了绝地潜兵空降战场的英姿，向世人昭示了一个真理：对于任何运转良好的军事机器来说，英勇无畏的人类都是最关键的部件。
englishValues: Rendering the Helldiver's descent to the battlefield in splendorous foil, this cape illustrates that in any successful military machinery, heroic humans are the most vital piece.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披风以华丽烫印工艺展现了绝地潜兵空降战场的英姿，向世人昭示了一个真理：对于任何运转良好的军事机器来说，英勇无畏的人类都是最关键的部件。

records.english: Redirects propellant gases to reduce recoil when firing the weapon.
records.simplifiedChinese: 通过更改推进气体流向，减少射击时的后坐力。
englishValues: Redirects propellant gases to reduce recoil when firing the weapon.
simplifiedChineseValues: 通过更改推进气体流向，减少射击时的后坐力。

records.english: Offers its user brief fixed-height flight, stable enough for pinpoint marksmanship.
records.simplifiedChinese: 穿戴者可在固定高度短暂稳定飞行，确保实现精确射击。
englishValues: Offers its user brief fixed-height flight, stable enough for pinpoint marksmanship.
simplifiedChineseValues: 穿戴者可在固定高度短暂稳定飞行，确保实现精确射击。

records.english: Designed to render even the largest foes into considerably smaller, and vastly more compliant, constituent parts. Sacrifices throwing range for a massive detonation on impact.
records.simplifiedChinese: 旨在将体型最庞大的敌人拆解为体积小得多且远远更易“拿捏”的组成部件。以牺牲投掷距离为代价，换取命中时毁灭性爆炸威力。
englishValues: Designed to render even the largest foes into considerably smaller, and vastly more compliant, constituent parts. Sacrifices throwing range for a massive detonation on impact.
simplifiedChineseValues: 旨在将体型最庞大的敌人拆解为体积小得多且远远更易“拿捏”的组成部件。以牺牲投掷距离为代价，换取命中时毁灭性爆炸威力。

records.english: The official uniform of the League of Patriotic Arm Wrestlers, this armour's lycra base layer is supple and sweat-wicking for maximum flexing comfort.
records.simplifiedChinese: 爱国腕力联盟的官方制服，其莱卡底层布料柔软且兼具吸湿排汗功能，可为高强度的掰手腕动作提供极致舒适性。
englishValues: The official uniform of the League of Patriotic Arm Wrestlers, this armour's lycra base layer is supple and sweat-wicking for maximum flexing comfort.
simplifiedChineseValues: 爱国腕力联盟的官方制服，其莱卡底层布料柔软且兼具吸湿排汗功能，可为高强度的掰手腕动作提供极致舒适性。

records.english: A paint job for use in urban environments.
records.simplifiedChinese: 适用于城市环境的涂装。
englishValues: A paint job for use in urban environments.
simplifiedChineseValues: 适用于城市环境的涂装。

records.english: An angled foregrip to improve weapon stability.
records.simplifiedChinese: 直角前握把，可提升武器稳定性。
englishValues: An angled foregrip to improve weapon stability.
simplifiedChineseValues: 直角前握把，可提升武器稳定性。

records.english: A high explosive grenade which damages lightly armoured targets. Creates high damage over a small area when detonated.
records.simplifiedChinese: 高爆榴弹，能伤害轻型装甲的目标。引爆时可在小范围内造成较高伤害。
englishValues: A high explosive grenade which damages lightly armoured targets. Creates high damage over a small area when detonated.
simplifiedChineseValues: 高爆榴弹，能伤害轻型装甲的目标。引爆时可在小范围内造成较高伤害。

records.english: A 'compliance weapon' to modify enemy behaviour. Creates a thick smoke screen to block targets' line of sight.
records.simplifiedChinese: 改变敌人行为的“慑敌武器”，可形成一道厚重的烟幕，遮挡目标的视线。
englishValues: A 'compliance weapon' to modify enemy behaviour. Creates a thick smoke screen to block targets' line of sight.
simplifiedChineseValues: 改变敌人行为的“慑敌武器”，可形成一道厚重的烟幕，遮挡目标的视线。

records.english: This aim-stabilising armour found surprising secondary market success among alien birdwatching enthusiasts.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套可稳定瞄准动作的盔甲出乎意料地受到了外星观鸟爱好者的青睐，在二级市场大获成功。
englishValues: This aim-stabilising armour found surprising secondary market success among alien birdwatching enthusiasts.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套可稳定瞄准动作的盔甲出乎意料地受到了外星观鸟爱好者的青睐，在二级市场大获成功。

records.english: An antipersonnel fragmentation grenade. Creates damage over a large area when detonated.
records.simplifiedChinese: 反步兵破片榴弹，引爆时可在大范围造成伤害。
englishValues: An antipersonnel fragmentation grenade. Creates damage over a large area when detonated.
simplifiedChineseValues: 反步兵破片榴弹，引爆时可在大范围造成伤害。

records.english: A modified Diligence rifle offering increased damage at the cost of some manoeuvrability. Fires a single bullet at a time.
records.simplifiedChinese: 改良的“勤勉”步枪，伤害有所提高，但牺牲了一点操控性。每次只能发射一发子弹。
englishValues: A modified Diligence rifle offering increased damage at the cost of some manoeuvrability. Fires a single bullet at a time.
simplifiedChineseValues: 改良的“勤勉”步枪，伤害有所提高，但牺牲了一点操控性。每次只能发射一发子弹。

records.english: <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> chance to not die when taking lethal damage.
records.simplifiedChinese: 受到致命伤害时，不会阵亡的概率额外提高<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。
englishValues: <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> chance to not die when taking lethal damage.
simplifiedChineseValues: 受到致命伤害时，不会阵亡的概率额外提高<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。

records.english: A flattened muzzle that forces the shotgun pellets into a thin horizontal line.
records.simplifiedChinese: 扁平枪口，迫使霰弹呈水平细线发射。
englishValues: A flattened muzzle that forces the shotgun pellets into a thin horizontal line.
simplifiedChineseValues: 扁平枪口，迫使霰弹呈水平细线发射。

records.english: Supply boxes containing ammunition, with a backpack that allows the user to distribute boxes to fellow Helldivers.
records.simplifiedChinese: 装着弹药的补给箱，配有背包，可供使用者将箱子分配给其他绝地潜兵。
englishValues: Supply boxes containing ammunition, with a backpack that allows the user to distribute boxes to fellow Helldivers.
simplifiedChineseValues: 装着弹药的补给箱，配有背包，可供使用者将箱子分配给其他绝地潜兵。

records.english: Incendiary support fed by a massive backpack fuel tank. This heavy flamethrower enables a continuous column of fire to cleanse the battlefield.
records.simplifiedChinese: 由巨型背负式燃料罐提供燃料的燃烧型支援武器。这款重型喷火器能喷射出一道持续的火柱，荡涤净化战场。
englishValues: Incendiary support fed by a massive backpack fuel tank. This heavy flamethrower enables a continuous column of fire to cleanse the battlefield.
simplifiedChineseValues: 由巨型背负式燃料罐提供燃料的燃烧型支援武器。这款重型喷火器能喷射出一道持续的火柱，荡涤净化战场。

records.english: A pistol that fires grenades. Must be reloaded between shots.
records.simplifiedChinese: 发射榴弹的手枪，每射击一发子弹后必须重新装弹。
englishValues: A pistol that fires grenades. Must be reloaded between shots.
simplifiedChineseValues: 发射榴弹的手枪，每射击一发子弹后必须重新装弹。

records.english: An accurate, hard-hitting laser revolver with bespoke break action for heat sink swaps.
records.simplifiedChinese: 精准且威力强大的激光左轮手枪，定制中折式设计便于更换散热器。
englishValues: An accurate, hard-hitting laser revolver with bespoke break action for heat sink swaps.
simplifiedChineseValues: 精准且威力强大的激光左轮手枪，定制中折式设计便于更换散热器。

records.english: Patched and tattered, this banner yet waves from the unbowed shoulders of Freedom's most battle-tested warriors.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这面旗帜虽历经修补，却依然飘扬在久经沙场的自由战士们不屈的肩膀之上。
englishValues: Patched and tattered, this banner yet waves from the unbowed shoulders of Freedom's most battle-tested warriors.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这面旗帜虽历经修补，却依然飘扬在久经沙场的自由战士们不屈的肩膀之上。

records.english: When facing the enemies of Freedom this Reckoningtide, keep up the festive spirit by recalling the opening line of A Vengeant Carol: "They'll soon be dead, to begin with."
records.simplifiedChinese: 在这个清算时节面对自由之敌时，请牢记《复仇颂歌》的开场白，坚守我们的节日精神：“它们很快就会死去，这是故事的开始。”
englishValues: When facing the enemies of Freedom this Reckoningtide, keep up the festive spirit by recalling the opening line of A Vengeant Carol: "They'll soon be dead, to begin with."
simplifiedChineseValues: 在这个清算时节面对自由之敌时，请牢记《复仇颂歌》的开场白，坚守我们的节日精神：“它们很快就会死去，这是故事的开始。”

records.english: Features a patented non-stick coating, which makes scraping viscera off after a long day of battle less taxing.
records.simplifiedChinese: 采用专利不粘涂料，方便你在一整天的血战之后轻松去除表面的脏器。
englishValues: Features a patented non-stick coating, which makes scraping viscera off after a long day of battle less taxing.
simplifiedChineseValues: 采用专利不粘涂料，方便你在一整天的血战之后轻松去除表面的脏器。

records.english: Ruggedised for extended operation beyond the reach of paved logistics. This armour's heavy plating is intended for the "unpaving" of hostile territory, providing a mobile bulkhead for Helldivers who don't know the meaning of "environmental obstacles."
records.simplifiedChinese: 为执行铺装物流以外的长时间任务而强固处理。这款护甲的重型装甲旨在“铲平”敌方领土，为不懂“环境障碍”为何物的绝地潜兵提供移动堡垒。
englishValues: Ruggedised for extended operation beyond the reach of paved logistics. This armour's heavy plating is intended for the "unpaving" of hostile territory, providing a mobile bulkhead for Helldivers who don't know the meaning of "environmental obstacles."
simplifiedChineseValues: 为执行铺装物流以外的长时间任务而强固处理。这款护甲的重型装甲旨在“铲平”敌方领土，为不懂“环境障碍”为何物的绝地潜兵提供移动堡垒。

records.english: Should the wearer of this cape perish at the hands of Freedom's enemies, it is customary to pass the cape on to their bravest child during the funeral, inspiring the next generation to take up arms.
records.simplifiedChinese: 若这件披肩的佩戴者死于自由之敌手中，按照传统，葬礼上会将披肩传给其最勇敢的子女，激励下一代拿起武器继续战斗。
englishValues: Should the wearer of this cape perish at the hands of Freedom's enemies, it is customary to pass the cape on to their bravest child during the funeral, inspiring the next generation to take up arms.
simplifiedChineseValues: 若这件披肩的佩戴者死于自由之敌手中，按照传统，葬礼上会将披肩传给其最勇敢的子女，激励下一代拿起武器继续战斗。

records.english: Creates a far-reaching incendiary blast ideal for crowd control against smaller enemies of Freedom. Equipped with a programmable timer for strategic versatility.
records.simplifiedChinese: 引发大范围燃烧爆炸，适合对小规模自由之敌实施群体控制。配备可编程定时器，增强战术灵活性。
englishValues: Creates a far-reaching incendiary blast ideal for crowd control against smaller enemies of Freedom. Equipped with a programmable timer for strategic versatility.
simplifiedChineseValues: 引发大范围燃烧爆炸，适合对小规模自由之敌实施群体控制。配备可编程定时器，增强战术灵活性。

records.english: This shotgun blasts a wide burst of high-voltage electricity that arcs between all units—enemy or otherwise—within range.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这把霰弹枪能在大范围内释放高压电流，在效果范围内的所有敌我单位之间形成电弧。
englishValues: This shotgun blasts a wide burst of high-voltage electricity that arcs between all units—enemy or otherwise—within range.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这把霰弹枪能在大范围内释放高压电流，在效果范围内的所有敌我单位之间形成电弧。

records.english: The distinctive red, white, and green of the Intergalactic Medical Corps signal to all Helldivers that help is at hand.
records.simplifiedChinese: 看见星际医疗部队标志性的红白绿三色，所有绝地潜兵都会意识到医疗援助即将到来。
englishValues: The distinctive red, white, and green of the Intergalactic Medical Corps signal to all Helldivers that help is at hand.
simplifiedChineseValues: 看见星际医疗部队标志性的红白绿三色，所有绝地潜兵都会意识到医疗援助即将到来。

records.english: Tests and implements the most advanced stratagem technology that funding has been allocated for.
records.simplifiedChinese: 测试与应用受拨款支持的顶尖战略配备技术。
englishValues: Tests and implements the most advanced stratagem technology that funding has been allocated for.
simplifiedChineseValues: 测试与应用受拨款支持的顶尖战略配备技术。

records.english: Call in an emergency beacon to show other Helldivers that you need assistance.
records.simplifiedChinese: 呼叫求救信标，向其他绝地潜兵表明你需要支援。
englishValues: Call in an emergency beacon to show other Helldivers that you need assistance.
simplifiedChineseValues: 呼叫求救信标，向其他绝地潜兵表明你需要支援。

records.english: Increases ammo capacity of all weapons by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>. Does not affect weapon backpacks.
records.simplifiedChinese: 所有武器的弹药容量增加<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。武器背包除外。
englishValues: Increases ammo capacity of all weapons by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>. Does not affect weapon backpacks.
simplifiedChineseValues: 所有武器的弹药容量增加<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。武器背包除外。

records.english: This traditional armour has remained unchanged since time immemorial. Now with self-heated padding.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套传统盔甲自古至今一直保持原样。而今配备了自热内衬。
englishValues: This traditional armour has remained unchanged since time immemorial. Now with self-heated padding.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套传统盔甲自古至今一直保持原样。而今配备了自热内衬。

records.english: Originally worn by lunar terraformers, this suit can withstand rapid changes in pressure, heat, and personal velocity.
records.simplifiedChinese: 原本是月球地形改造人员的装备，足以承受气压、温度和个人速度的急剧变化。
englishValues: Originally worn by lunar terraformers, this suit can withstand rapid changes in pressure, heat, and personal velocity.
simplifiedChineseValues: 原本是月球地形改造人员的装备，足以承受气压、温度和个人速度的急剧变化。

records.english: Popularised by actor Chip Messiter, who wore this in the action-rom-com-musical 'Lost My Heart to a Man in a Helmet'.
records.simplifiedChinese: 由演员奇普·梅西特推广，他曾在动作浪漫欢乐音乐剧《爱上一个不脱头盔的人》中穿着这套盔甲。
englishValues: Popularised by actor Chip Messiter, who wore this in the action-rom-com-musical 'Lost My Heart to a Man in a Helmet'.
simplifiedChineseValues: 由演员奇普·梅西特推广，他曾在动作浪漫欢乐音乐剧《爱上一个不脱头盔的人》中穿着这套盔甲。

records.english:
A pistol with a built-in laser sight, suppressor, and flashlight.
Produced by Martian Armoury.
records.simplifiedChinese:
内置激光瞄准器、消音器和手电筒的手枪。
由火星军械库生产。
englishValues:
A pistol with a built-in laser sight, suppressor, and flashlight.
Produced by Martian Armoury.
simplifiedChineseValues:
内置激光瞄准器、消音器和手电筒的手枪。
由火星军械库生产。

records.simplifiedChinese: 增加架设型重机枪弹匣
simplifiedChineseValues: 增加架设型重机枪弹匣

records.english: A camo paint job for use in forest environments.
records.simplifiedChinese: 适用于森林环境的迷彩涂装。
englishValues: A camo paint job for use in forest environments.
simplifiedChineseValues: 适用于森林环境的迷彩涂装。

records.english: A repurposed firework that showers its immediate surrounding area in sparks before exploding. As delightful as it is incendiary.
records.simplifiedChinese: 由烟花改装而成，在爆炸前向四周溅射火花。既绚丽如烟火，又致命如烈焰。
englishValues: A repurposed firework that showers its immediate surrounding area in sparks before exploding. As delightful as it is incendiary.
simplifiedChineseValues: 由烟花改装而成，在爆炸前向四周溅射火花。既绚丽如烟火，又致命如烈焰。

records.english: Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of throwables by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
records.simplifiedChinese: 投掷武器的初始库存和持有上限增加<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。
englishValues: Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of throwables by <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>.
simplifiedChineseValues: 投掷武器的初始库存和持有上限增加<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>。

records.english: Projects an arc of lightning at close range. Charges up to project bolts, and may discharge through multiple targets.
records.simplifiedChinese: 在近程范围内发射一道电弧。充能可发射电球，然后向多个目标放电。
englishValues: Projects an arc of lightning at close range. Charges up to project bolts, and may discharge through multiple targets.
simplifiedChineseValues: 在近程范围内发射一道电弧。充能可发射电球，然后向多个目标放电。

records.english: An armour often worn by frontline surgeons, who are skilled at both putting bodies back together and taking them apart.
records.simplifiedChinese: 前线外科医生的常用盔甲。他们既有出色的缝合技术，也很了解该怎样将敌人大卸八块。
englishValues: An armour often worn by frontline surgeons, who are skilled at both putting bodies back together and taking them apart.
simplifiedChineseValues: 前线外科医生的常用盔甲。他们既有出色的缝合技术，也很了解该怎样将敌人大卸八块。

records.english: Gives wearer a <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> chance to avoid grievous limb injury.
records.simplifiedChinese: 佩戴者有<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>的几率避免四肢重伤。
englishValues: Gives wearer a <c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c> chance to avoid grievous limb injury.
simplifiedChineseValues: 佩戴者有<c=#COLOR>#BONUS</c>的几率避免四肢重伤。

records.english: An autonomous drone equipped with a Liberator assault rifle, providing 360° cover. Returns to backpack to rearm.
records.simplifiedChinese: 配备“解放者”突击步枪的自主无人机，可提供全方位掩护。需要补充弹药时会返回背包。
englishValues: An autonomous drone equipped with a Liberator assault rifle, providing 360° cover. Returns to backpack to rearm.
simplifiedChineseValues: 配备“解放者”突击步枪的自主无人机，可提供全方位掩护。需要补充弹药时会返回背包。

records.english: A cape inspired by hypothetical covert operatives—pillars of Democratic order, operating in the hostile abyss where Liberty's light cannot yet reach.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这件披肩的灵感源于幻想的秘密特工，他们被视为民主秩序的支柱，在尚未亮起自由之光的危险深渊中执行任务。
englishValues: A cape inspired by hypothetical covert operatives—pillars of Democratic order, operating in the hostile abyss where Liberty's light cannot yet reach.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这件披肩的灵感源于幻想的秘密特工，他们被视为民主秩序的支柱，在尚未亮起自由之光的危险深渊中执行任务。

records.english: Equip stratagems to be able to drop into a mission!
records.simplifiedChinese: 装备战略配备后才能投身任务！
englishValues: Equip stratagems to be able to drop into a mission!
simplifiedChineseValues: 装备战略配备后才能投身任务！

records.english: Bearers of this cape take upon a sacred duty: that of delivering righteous retribution to every last deserving being.
records.simplifiedChinese: 穿戴此披肩的人将背负神圣的使命：向每一个罪有应得的生灵发动正义的复仇。
englishValues: Bearers of this cape take upon a sacred duty: that of delivering righteous retribution to every last deserving being.
simplifiedChineseValues: 穿戴此披肩的人将背负神圣的使命：向每一个罪有应得的生灵发动正义的复仇。

records.english: Delivers silent justice to Freedom's enemies.
records.simplifiedChinese: 向自由之敌传递无声的正义。
englishValues: Delivers silent justice to Freedom's enemies.
simplifiedChineseValues: 向自由之敌传递无声的正义。

records.english: A pump shotgun that fires a burst of incendiary phosphorus pellets, setting targets ablaze.
records.simplifiedChinese: 泵动式霰弹枪，可连射燃烧磷弹，将目标点燃。
englishValues: A pump shotgun that fires a burst of incendiary phosphorus pellets, setting targets ablaze.
simplifiedChineseValues: 泵动式霰弹枪，可连射燃烧磷弹，将目标点燃。

records.english: The SteerComfort fit of this armour allows the wearer to feel every curve, bump, and jostle of their Exosuit, as if they were one single being.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲的“舒适贴合驾控”设计能让穿着者感知外骨骼装甲的每一次弯折、颠簸与震动，仿佛人机合一。
englishValues: The SteerComfort fit of this armour allows the wearer to feel every curve, bump, and jostle of their Exosuit, as if they were one single being.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲的“舒适贴合驾控”设计能让穿着者感知外骨骼装甲的每一次弯折、颠簸与震动，仿佛人机合一。

records.english: Research suggests that Helldivers wearing this cape are seen as 17% more patriotic.
records.simplifiedChinese: 研究表明，绝地潜兵如果穿着这件披肩，所展现的爱国程度将提升17%。
englishValues: Research suggests that Helldivers wearing this cape are seen as 17% more patriotic.
simplifiedChineseValues: 研究表明，绝地潜兵如果穿着这件披肩，所展现的爱国程度将提升17%。

records.english: Those taken under the wings of the Law can rest easy knowing that their transgressions will soon be laid bare, their harms amended, and their citizenship safely sequestered.
records.simplifiedChinese: 那些在法律羽翼庇护下的人将无需再担忧，因为他们的罪行很快就会揭露无遗，曾经造成的伤害会得到弥补，而他们的公民身份也将被安全并妥善地剥夺。
englishValues: Those taken under the wings of the Law can rest easy knowing that their transgressions will soon be laid bare, their harms amended, and their citizenship safely sequestered.
simplifiedChineseValues: 那些在法律羽翼庇护下的人将无需再担忧，因为他们的罪行很快就会揭露无遗，曾经造成的伤害会得到弥补，而他们的公民身份也将被安全并妥善地剥夺。

records.english: Made famous by the Ministry of Intelligence's hide-and-seek-and-destroy champion of '52, this armour has been improved by removing excess shoulder protection.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套盔甲因赢得情报部52年度“隐蔽歼敌”比赛冠军而闻名。已移除多余的肩部护甲，进一步改良了设计。
englishValues: Made famous by the Ministry of Intelligence's hide-and-seek-and-destroy champion of '52, this armour has been improved by removing excess shoulder protection.
simplifiedChineseValues: 这套盔甲因赢得情报部52年度“隐蔽歼敌”比赛冠军而闻名。已移除多余的肩部护甲，进一步改良了设计。

records.english: Completely sheathed in 14-cm silica fibre foam, except for a thin tube to the ear canal to enable hearing the satisfying screeches of Freedom's enemies as they burn.
records.simplifiedChinese: 14厘米厚的硅纤维泡沫将全身包裹在内，只在耳道处留下了纤细的管道，让穿戴者能够心满意足地听见自由之敌在烈火中痛苦尖叫。
englishValues: Completely sheathed in 14-cm silica fibre foam, except for a thin tube to the ear canal to enable hearing the satisfying screeches of Freedom's enemies as they burn.
simplifiedChineseValues: 14厘米厚的硅纤维泡沫将全身包裹在内，只在耳道处留下了纤细的管道，让穿戴者能够心满意足地听见自由之敌在烈火中痛苦尖叫。

records.english:
A versatile missile launcher loaded with seven lock-on homing missiles. These can either be fired from the launcher directly or as an airburst. Includes support backpack required for reloading.
Produced by Stål Arms.
records.simplifiedChinese:
多功能导弹发射器，装载了七枚锁定追踪式导弹。导弹可通过发射器直接发射或作为空爆弹发射。包含支援背包，用于装填弹药。
由斯塔尔武装公司生产。
englishValues:
A versatile missile launcher loaded with seven lock-on homing missiles. These can either be fired from the launcher directly or as an airburst. Includes support backpack required for reloading.
Produced by Stål Arms.
simplifiedChineseValues:
多功能导弹发射器，装载了七枚锁定追踪式导弹。导弹可通过发射器直接发射或作为空爆弹发射。包含支援背包，用于装填弹药。
由斯塔尔武装公司生产。

records.english: This multi-layered protective armour keeps rough sand, spores, and other course granules from irritating the skin.
records.simplifiedChinese: 这套多层防护盔甲能有效阻隔粗糙沙粒、孢子和其他颗粒物，防止皮肤受到刺激。
englishValues: This multi-layered protective armour keeps rough sand, spores, and other course granules from irritating the skin.
